notes: REQUEST, NOT ACQUISITION. ACQUIRE.1 answers 'what bounded requests should a future acquisition engine receive?' and never 'go and obtain that evidence'. Nothing is read, traversed, listed, selected, indexed, searched, fetched, executed or written to produce a request, and the guardrail block records every one of those as not performed.

SOURCE CLASS IS NOT FILENAME. A request names abstract selectors - runtime_implementation, interface_definition, configuration, dependency_manifest, authoritative_architecture_doc, plugin_or_registration_surface, validation_test, historical_design_material, authoritative_external_source, supplied_context. Which files are of a given kind is a question about repository membership, and ACQUIRE.1 has no way to ask it. The DeepSeek dogfood request set contains no path and no filename at all.

ROLE DECIDES CLASS, DETERMINISTICALLY. implementation_authority maps to runtime and surrounding implementation; interface_contract to interface definitions; configuration_authority to configuration and dependency manifests; architecture_description to authoritative architecture material and registration surfaces; validation_evidence to validation tests; historical_context to historical design material; current_external_authority to authoritative external sources. The mapping is total over WAITER.2's role vocabulary and checked at import; hypothesis_support maps to nothing and fails the contract closed rather than inventing a class.

EVERY BUDGET IS FINITE, AND THERE IS NOWHERE TO WRITE OTHERWISE. A budget is a named profile - none, existing_context, external_bounded, secondary_verification, bounded, reconnaissance - whose four numeric ceilings are read out of a frozen table. AcquisitionBudget has exactly one field, so max_candidates cannot be None, cannot be negative, cannot be 'all' and cannot exceed the documented ceiling of 96 candidates and 32 initial sources. This is the DeepSeek anti-6087 regression: not a warning, a shape the schema cannot hold.

BUDGET FOLLOWS EVIDENCE, NOT WORKFLOW. The ceiling is chosen from the domain, the tier and the reach of the evidence. Commander is not a budget: the DeepSeek dogfood run over supplied context alone routes to CHAT and asks for a single existing-context reference, and the same rubric over the repository routes to COMMANDER and asks for a bounded reconnaissance. Nothing in the derivation reads the selected workflow at all.

BROAD IS NOT EVERYTHING. A broad_repository_reconnaissance request still names which classes it may reach - strictly fewer than all of them, with validation tests and historical material excluded from the primary set - carries a finite ceiling, and travels beside explicit exclusions. check_bounded_reconnaissance refuses a request set in which any of the three is missing.

TIERS SURVIVE TRANSLATION. required_primary becomes an initial request, required_secondary a smaller one, deferred a request whose acquisition budget is zero, and excluded_initially an exclusion rather than a request at all. A deferred request carrying an active budget cannot be constructed, an initially excluded tier cannot be a request, and a required request cannot carry an empty budget.

RESTATED MATERIAL IS UNREQUESTABLE. generated_artifact, snapshot, temporary_artifact and duplicate_rendering exist only as exclusions: AcquisitionRequest refuses to name one, so 'request the snapshots' is not a sentence this schema can form. Nothing is discovered to populate an exclusion - it is category-level policy for a future selector to enforce.

MONOTONIC IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. A request may refine a WAITER.2 requirement and may not widen one: a repository request the contract never licensed, a deferred requirement promoted to primary, or a request for an excluded class all produce acquisition_requirement_widened. Symmetrically, every requirement must have exactly one request carrying it at its own tier with a budget that permits the work, and an external requirement must keep its current-freshness expectation, or the contract fails closed with required_evidence_dropped.

A PATH IS PRESERVED, NEVER PRODUCED. An identifier the user wrote and INPUT.1 preserved survives as a target anchor whose source is explicit_input_evidence and whose serialisation states discovered=false and existence_verified=false. ACQUIRE.1 has no way to discover a path, and an anchor asserts nothing about whether the thing exists, can be read, can be written or is safe to reach.

WORKFLOW IMMUTABILITY. The workflow is copied from the evidence contract for traceability and compared against the routing decision; a disagreement produces workflow_mismatch. There is no branch that could produce a different workflow, so rerouting is not a failure mode this phase has, and a static test asserts the request modules contain no router symbol.

NO PLANNING. The request set is independent and unordered: there is no depends_on, no stage, no step and no sequence anywhere in the schema. Priority tiers are evidence priority, not an execution plan, and a regression asserts none of those words appears in a rendered contract.

NO MODEL, NO PROVIDER, NO COMPUTE. The record has no field for a provider, a model, local or cloud, a context window, a temperature, an endpoint, an API key or a fallback chain. ACQUIRE.1 asks for evidence sources, not compute resources, and regression tests render every contract and assert that no compute token survives outside the authority block that names those powers in order to deny them.

FAIL CLOSED ON ANYTHING THAT DOES NOT HANG TOGETHER. An evidence contract that is not specified produces not_evidence_ready with no requests. A decision that is not routed, a contract or completion decision that does not fingerprint to the ones the evidence contract was specified over, a workflow mismatch, a widened envelope, a lost capability, an unmappable role, a widened request and a dropped requirement all produce inconsistent_input. ACQUIRE.1 never re-routes, never regenerates the evidence contract and never reinterprets the raw prompt.

ZERO ACQUISITION AUTHORITY. evidence_acquisition_authority, repository_read_authority, repository_traversal_authority, repository_write_authority, external_search_authority, web_fetch_authority, context_selection_authority, indexing_authority, graph_authority, retrieval_authority, validation_authority, command_execution_authority, execution_authority, patch_authority, planning_authority, routing_authority, provider_selection_authority, model_selection_authority and project_evolution_authority are all false in every status, including ready. human_approval_required is true. status=ready says the request set is well formed and nothing else.

DETERMINISM. The same evidence contract over the same upstream records always produces the same requests and the same ceilings, on any machine, at any time, with any repository state and no network. The modules import no os, subprocess, socket, requests, urllib, pathlib, random or time, and no selector, index, manifest or graph. An English broad-analysis order and its Vietnamese equivalent produce identical acquisition contracts.

REPORT-ONLY AND UNWIRED. Nothing calls derive_acquisition_requests in a live path. CTX.SELECT, the Canonical Graph, the Activation Graph, the indexer, the repository manifest, web search, the browser, the planner, Instant Run, Commander, Project Evolution, Dream, the Workbench and Mixed Mode are all untouched, and a test walks the repository sources to assert no caller exists outside the tests. INPUT.1-3, WAITER.1 and WAITER.2 modules are forbidden to this phase; ACQUIRE.1 is built entirely around their public contracts.

RECOMMENDED NEXT PHASE. ACQUIRE.2 should enforce one Acquisition Request Contract against concrete source candidates under its own acquisition authority gate - classifying real repository members into the source classes a request names, honouring the ceilings and the exclusions, and obtaining nothing the request did not license.
phases.summary: First acquisition-track phase: a pure, deterministic layer that consumes one specified WAITER.2 Evidence Requirement Contract together with the frozen records it was specified over, and states what bounded requests a future acquisition engine should receive. It answers 'what should the shopping list say?' and never 'go to the shop'. The Acquisition Request Contract names an evidence domain, the roles a request must satisfy, abstract source classes, the tier it inherited, a named finite budget, a freshness expectation and any target anchor the user themselves wrote - and contains no discovered path, candidate list, query, address, retrieval result, stage, dependency, provider or compute choice. It fails closed when the evidence contract is not specified, when the supplied records do not fingerprint to the ones it was specified over, when the workflow disagrees with the route, when the capability envelope was widened or a required capability lost, when a request would widen a requirement, and when a required requirement would be dropped. Report-only, unwired, and holding no acquisition authority of any kind.

notes: CANDIDATE IS NOT EVIDENCE. A candidate may satisfy an acquisition request; evidence has been acquired and can support a claim. Every candidate serialises content_read=false, evidence_status=not_acquired and authority_status=expected_not_verified, and the vocabulary contains no value that says otherwise, so no code path can produce one. Regression tests assert that no rendered receipt claims anything was confirmed, proved, grounded or verified.

EXPLICIT-TARGET CLOSURE, FROZEN. target_anchor_match=true together with CANDIDATE_EXPLICIT_TARGET_MATCHED and CANDIDATE_INVENTORY_MEMBER is the target_artifact-equivalent representation already present in ACQUIRE.2. It requires both an explicit upstream target anchor and membership in the supplied authorized inventory; the same member without an anchor has no target status, an absent anchor invents no candidate, and exclusions still override it. Target status grants no source authority, evidence role, read permission, write permission or verified-current status. ACQUIRE.2 is CLOSED / FROZEN.

INVENTORY CONSUMED, NEVER BUILT. ACQUIRE.2 receives an already-authorized inventory snapshot from somebody who holds traversal authority. It calls no os.walk, refreshes no manifest, consults no index or graph and opens no file. A repository request with no inventory produces inventory_required and no pool; there is no fallback to traversal. Consuming supplied candidate metadata is not a repository read, and the guardrail block records both as not performed.

MEMBERSHIP IS THE ONLY DOOR. A concrete identifier enters the pool because the supplied snapshot contains it. A caller-invented path, a plausible-looking path and a path from a different repository are all refused, and an identifier the user wrote that the inventory does not contain is reported as an unmatched anchor rather than conjured into existence. Identity and fingerprint mismatches fail the receipt closed.

EXTENSION IS NOT AUTHORITY. Classification comes only from metadata somebody already established: a generated marker, a hard exclusion, a known test or snapshot or temporary or historical location, a known manifest or configuration name, the canonical parser's verdict that a member is code, or a class an authorized inventory builder declared. A plain .md is not architecture authority and a plain .py is not implementation authority; interface definitions, authoritative architecture description and registration surfaces have no location rule at all and require a declaration.

EVERY ASSIGNMENT NAMES ITS BASIS. Each source class a candidate carries records the bounded basis it was assigned from - explicit_target_anchor, inventory_declared_class, inventory_parser_support, inventory_generated_marker, inventory_duplicate_marker, inventory_hard_exclusion, known_test_location, known_manifest_name, known_configuration_name, known_snapshot_location, known_temporary_location, known_historical_location. There is no field for a sentence of reasoning.

UNKNOWN IS A SAFE ANSWER. A member nothing justifies is classified unknown, is eligible for no role, and cannot discharge a required one. An identifier the user named is admitted to the pool on membership alone and still carries no class and no role when nothing established what it is - borrowing the request's classes to fill the gap would be exactly the widening this phase exists to refuse.

EXCLUSIONS AND DEFERRALS ARE HARD FILTERS. Generated artifacts, snapshots, temporary artifacts and duplicate renderings cannot enter the active pool, an EligibleCandidate naming one cannot be constructed, and a selector cannot readmit one either. Deferred historical material is listed in its own pool with an acquisition budget of zero and current authority false, and a deferred candidate in the active pool is a construction error.

TIERS SURVIVE, AND TESTS ARE TASK-SENSITIVE. required_primary, required_secondary and deferred candidates live in separate pools and no candidate changes tier. Validation artifacts are secondary for an architecture reconnaissance and primary for a failing-test investigation, exactly as ACQUIRE.1 set them; nothing globally promotes or demotes tests.

MONOTONIC NARROWING, PROVED. The active pool never exceeds ACQUIRE.1's candidate ceiling, a candidate never carries a class or role the request did not license, and byte ceilings are enforced from supplied size metadata without opening anything. The receipt cannot be constructed with candidate_used above candidate_limit. The chain ACQUIRE.1 ceiling >= ACQUIRE.2 pool is a checkable inequality rather than an intention.

ANTI-6087, AT SCALE AND FOR FREE. A synthetic inventory of more than 6,087 members produces a pool bounded by the upstream ceiling, with no generated, snapshot, temporary or duplicated member in the active pool and no historical material either. The regression is metadata-only: it creates no file, reads no file and runs in about a second.

ORDERING IS DETERMINISTIC AND ROLE-FAIR. Identifiers the user wrote come first, then the pool cycles through the roles the request named so one abundant class cannot spend the whole ceiling and leave a required role unsatisfied. Order is a function of metadata alone: the same members supplied in a different sequence produce the same pool in the same order. There is no relevance score, no embedding, no vector search and no graph centrality anywhere in the phase.

NO REQUIRED-ROLE LOSS. A required role with no confidently eligible candidate is reported in unsatisfied_required_roles and the status becomes insufficient_candidates. Widening a classification until the roles come out satisfied is refused; zero candidates for a required primary role is a factual result and not a green light.

SELECTOR BRIDGE, NOT A SECOND SELECTOR. CTX.SELECT.1 already owns candidate discovery, filename ranking, actionability and read-set planning, and none of it is reimplemented. ACQUIRE.2 emits a SelectorEnvelope and an InventoryMember whose capability mapping CTX.SELECT's supplied-metadata entry points accept unchanged; tests drive the real build_candidate_filename_report and rank_candidates over it and validate the output as a subset. validate_selector_output rejects a candidate outside the envelope, in an excluded class, from the wrong tier, beyond the budget, from the wrong inventory or repeated. An envelope is not a read set and selector_bridge_authority is false.

NO PATCH OR WRITE SEMANTICS INHERITED. Actionability and editability are about whether a file may be changed, not about whether it may be believed. Neither reaches the receipt: there is no patch_candidate, no write_authority and no editability field anywhere in the schema, and a regression asserts none of those words appears in a rendered receipt.

EXTERNAL INFORMATION HAS NO CONCRETE CANDIDATES YET. An external request produces an abstract envelope naming the role, the source class, the freshness and a finite ceiling - and no host, address, query, engine or provider. Zero concrete external candidates is the expected result, because discovery needs a capability this phase does not have.

DIRECT CONTEXT IS REFERENCED, NOT RE-ACQUIRED. The order's own material becomes one candidate identified by the fingerprint of the record INPUT preserved. No content is copied, nothing is re-parsed, and a direct-context order needs no inventory at all - which is what keeps the DeepSeek differential intact one layer further down.

ZERO AUTHORITY. evidence_acquisition_authority, candidate_content_read_authority, repository_read_authority, repository_traversal_authority, repository_write_authority, external_search_authority, web_fetch_authority, context_selection_execution_authority, selector_bridge_authority, indexing_authority, graph_authority, retrieval_authority, validation_authority, command_execution_authority, execution_authority, patch_authority, planning_authority, routing_authority, provider_selection_authority, model_selection_authority and project_evolution_authority are all false in every status, including ready. human_approval_required is true.

DETERMINISM AND STATIC INERTNESS. The same request over the same snapshot always produces the same pool, the same order and the same ceilings. The modules import no os, subprocess, socket, requests, urllib, pathlib, random or time, open no file, and import no walker, ignore policy, index, manifest, graph or selector - so the whole INPUT-WAITER-ACQUIRE line stays importable where the CTX.SELECT dependency graph is not installed. An English order and its Vietnamese equivalent produce identical eligibility.

REPORT-ONLY AND UNWIRED. Nothing calls derive_candidate_eligibility in a live path. CTX.SELECT, the Canonical Graph, the Activation Graph, the indexer, the repository manifest, web search, the planner, Instant Run, Commander, Project Evolution, Dream, the Workbench and Mixed Mode are all untouched, and a test walks the repository sources to assert no caller exists outside the tests. INPUT.1-3, WAITER.1-2, ACQUIRE.1 and the CTX.SELECT modules are all forbidden to this phase.

RECOMMENDED NEXT PHASE. ACQUIRE.3 should validate an explicitly supplied candidate subset and a separate human-approved, fingerprint-bound authorization before acquiring bounded content. It should emit acquired-source payloads and per-source acquisition receipts that remain unverified and not_verified; checking expected roles and promoting acquired material to verified evidence belong to future EVIDENCE.1.
phases.summary: Second acquisition-track phase: a pure, deterministic layer that consumes one ready ACQUIRE.1 Acquisition Request Contract together with an already-authorized candidate inventory snapshot, and states which concrete members are eligible to be considered by the selector machinery that already exists. It answers 'which items on this catalogued shelf are of the kinds the list asks for?' and never 'read them' or 'these prove it'. The Candidate Eligibility Receipt names an identifier, the source classes it belongs to with the basis each was assigned from, the roles it may serve, the tier it inherited, whether it matches an identifier the user wrote, and the ceilings the pool stopped at - and every candidate carries content_read=false, evidence_status=not_acquired and authority_status=expected_not_verified. It walks no directory, opens no file, executes no selector and acquires nothing. It fails closed when the acquisition contract is not ready, when the supplied records do not fingerprint to the ones it was written over, when a repository request arrives with no inventory, when the inventory describes another repository or does not fingerprint to its builder's claim, and when the pool would reach further than the request licensed; a required role with no confidently eligible candidate reports insufficient_candidates rather than a widened classification. Report-only, unwired, and holding no acquisition authority of any kind.

notes: EXPLICIT SELECTION, NEVER SELF-SELECTION. ACQUIRE.3 accepts an AcquisitionSelection that fingerprints the ACQUIRE.2 receipt and names a canonical subset of candidate identifiers. It validates the subset, including CTX.SELECT-produced subsets through the existing selector-envelope validator, but it never executes CTX.SELECT, ranks candidates, chooses interesting files or substitutes another candidate after a failure.

EXPLICIT HUMAN-APPROVED AUTHORIZATION. A separately supplied AcquisitionAuthorization must state acquisition_allowed=true and human_approved=true and must bind the candidate receipt, acquisition request, evidence contract, inventory and repository identity. Missing approval, an absent grant, a mismatched fingerprint or a widened grant produces zero content reads. ACQUIRE.3 never mints its own authority and the user's original task request is not silently treated as read approval.

AUTHORIZATION ONLY NARROWS. Allowed identifiers and domains must remain subsets of ACQUIRE.2; source-count, total-byte and per-source-byte limits may be smaller and may never exceed the request, candidate-envelope or inventory-bound ceilings. Deferred and excluded material cannot be activated by unused budget, and both primary and secondary active candidates require explicit selection and authorization.

CANDIDATE-ADDRESSED READS, NO TRAVERSAL. The repository root and repository identity are supplied and fingerprint-bound. ACQUIRE.3 touches only selected identifiers, rejects absolute and escaping paths, opens no directory, performs no walk, glob, recursive enumeration or replacement search, and never accesses an unselected candidate's filesystem path.

READ-ONLY PATH AND IDENTITY SAFETY. Repository symlinks and reparse points are rejected conservatively; the target must remain a regular file inside the authorized root. Inventory size and stable metadata are compared before the read, descriptor identity is checked during acquisition, and changed, deleted, replaced or otherwise stale candidates fail without a substitute.

FINITE SOURCE AND BYTE SPENDING. Every source must fit completely within its per-source, per-request and total authorization ceilings before acquisition. Source count and exact acquired bytes are monotonic and never exceed upstream limits; an over-budget selection is refused rather than silently truncated into a new selection. Partial results may retain successful explicitly selected sources while recording bounded failures for the others, with no fallback candidate.

PAYLOAD AND RECEIPT ARE SEPARATE. Exact acquired bytes live only in an ephemeral in-memory AcquiredSourcePayload. SourceAcquisitionReceipt records the candidate binding, expected roles, eligible classes, tier, exact byte count and SHA-256 digest but serializes no payload. The same bytes produce the same digest, and receipt serialization cannot reproduce source content.

ACQUIRED IS NOT VERIFIED. A successful repository source has acquisition_status=acquired, verification_status=unverified and authority_status=not_verified. Eligible roles become expected roles only: no implementation, architecture, configuration, validation or current-authority role is verified here, no claim is grounded, and no source is promoted to evidence. Future EVIDENCE.1 owns inspection, contradiction/support decisions and promotion.

TARGET ARTIFACT REMAINS ROLELESS WHEN UNKNOWN. The ACQUIRE.2 target_artifact-equivalent conjunction of explicit anchor match and inventory membership may be selected and acquired even when eligible roles are empty. Reading that selected target does not turn README prose into implementation or architecture authority and grants no permission to modify it.

DIRECT CONTEXT AND EXTERNAL STAY DISTINCT. Already-present direct context becomes a bounded existing-context reference without repository-root or filesystem access and without copying raw prompt material into receipts. An external request with no concrete eligible source produces external_discovery_required; ACQUIRE.3 creates no query, contacts no network and invents no URL.

NARROW CONDITIONAL AUTHORITY AND HONEST PERFORMED FLAGS. Candidate-content and repository-read authority are true only for a validated grant covering the exact selected subset, and successful results record the reads actually performed. Repository traversal, external search/fetch, indexing, graph, validation execution, command execution, write, patch, planning, routing, provider/model selection, evidence verification and claim promotion remain false in every result.

REGISTRY CAPABILITY LIMITATION. ROAD.1 schema v1 has no field that distinguishes a conditionally supported repository-content-read capability from default or performed execution. ACQUIRE.3 supports candidate-addressed read-only acquisition only after a supplied selection and human-approved, fingerprint-bound grant validate; absent or invalid authorization means zero reads. writes_real_repo=false records that no repository content is modified, while network_allowed=false and model_calls_allowed=false remain exact. ROAD.1 registry validation and ROAD.2 phase picking execute nothing.

IMPORT-TIME INERT AND NOT LIVE-WIRED. Importing the contract and runtime modules opens nothing, and default or blocked calls read nothing. Static regressions permit only candidate-addressed stat and read-only descriptor operations, forbid traversal, filesystem mutation, network, subprocess, database, index, graph, selector, validation and model stacks, and prove that no live Instant Run, Commander, Project Evolution, Workbench, Mixed Mode, planner or web path imports or calls acquire_selected_content.

ANTI-6087 BOUNDED READ. A synthetic pool larger than 6,087 members is narrowed upstream, an explicit small subset is selected, and ACQUIRE.3 reads only that subset within its source and byte limits. No unselected, deferred or excluded member is touched, no failed source is replaced, and no traversal occurs.

RECOMMENDED NEXT PHASE. EVIDENCE.1 should inspect acquired payloads and their tamper-bound source receipts, determine whether each source really satisfies an expected evidence role, distinguish support, contradiction and insufficiency, and control promotion from acquired source to verified evidence. EVIDENCE.1 is not implemented or authorized here.

Repository access is candidate-addressed and read-only, rejects unsafe paths, symlinks, non-regular files and stale metadata, never traverses or substitutes, and emits ephemeral byte payloads beside tamper-bound source acquisition receipts. Acquired sources remain unverified with authority not_verified and expected roles never become verified roles. External sources remain discovery-required with no network activity. The phase is import-time inert, defaults to zero reads without a valid grant, and is not wired into any live product path.

notes: ONE IDENTITY, READ OFF EXISTING LIFECYCLE TRUTH. The revision receipt decides the generation: Candidate1 is the final candidate exactly when revised_candidate_present is true, and its fingerprint is the receipt's revised_candidate_fingerprint. Otherwise Candidate0 is, and its identity is what the candidate receipts recorded - verification first, then the no-op and safe_minimal receipts that survive a gate removing the candidate. The payload's own bytes are only cross-checked, never the source: a patch being present says nothing about whose it is. Every candidate-naming receipt present must agree.

OWNERSHIP, NOT KEY NAMES. The authoring envelope (PATCH_RESPONSE_SCHEMA) is classified once: patch_candidate/patch_plan are candidate bytes, summary/issues are the author's narrative, confidence/needs_escalation are the author's claims. A test proves the table equals the contract's fields. needs_escalation is recorded as the author's claim and never written back over the harness's decision; confidence stays the author's claim on the payload, which existing gates may demote but never replace with another author's.

ISSUES KEEP TWO OWNERS. The author's own entries follow its candidate; harness findings stay independent. Candidate0's entries are removed by multiset equality against the record of what Candidate0's author wrote, so a harness finding that merely resembles one is not taken with it. In Round 10 the result is [harness finding about Candidate1, Candidate1's own issue].

MISSING MEANS ABSENT. A Candidate1 response with no summary, confidence or issues leaves those fields absent - get_confidence_and_escalation reads 0.0, not Candidate0's 0.9 - and candidate_presentation_authored_fields names exactly what the author supplied. No text is generated and no second call is made to fill a gap.

HISTORY IS KEPT, LABELLED AND ONLY THERE. candidate_revision_previous_candidate keeps PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.1's five fields and adds generation initial, authored_fields, summary, issues, model_confidence, model_needs_escalation, verification_status and verification_rejection_reasons. Serializing the payload minus that record finds neither Candidate0's summary nor its issue. The record is harness-owned, so ANSWER.GROUND.LIVE.4's ownership inheritance keeps it verbatim - quoted rejected evidence, like the no-op debugging copy.

FAIL CLOSED, NEVER GUESS. If the identity is missing or malformed, a receipt or the payload bytes name another candidate, a revision left no author record, the record is from another generation, the summary is not the final author's, or a superseded author's issue is back, candidate_presentation_coherent is false, no identity is claimed, the reasons are listed from a closed vocabulary of seven, and the author-facing summary, confidence and authored issues are withheld. Candidate bytes, harness findings and every receipt stay.

EXACT ROUND-10 RED/GREEN. The fixture freezes the verbatim draft and revision responses, CONTROL's source snippet (660 chars, no trailing newline - the reason an inspect.getsource replay gets the wrong Candidate1 fingerprint), the behavior fact and probe fingerprint 15335911..., and what production displayed. The replay reproduces Candidate0 9e6924f6..., Candidate1 368fc158... and the 6347-char revision request byte for byte. Disabling only this phase's composition reproduces summary0 + patch1 + confidence 1.0; restoring it gives summary1 + patch1 + confidence 1.0, all bound to 368fc158..., with harness truth identical to what Round 10 recorded.

DISPLAY, PERSISTENCE AND RELOAD AGREE. The binding is fixed before ANSWER.GROUND runs, so the grounded display copy, the CLI's structured_output artifact and assistant message, and a web session saved with web.app.save_session and reloaded through find_session all carry the same coherent payload; grounding leaves every binding key and the history record byte-identical while still downgrading a fabricated path in Candidate1's own summary.

CONTAINMENT. core/pipeline.py: 2 helpers added (_recorded_candidate_presentation, _record_candidate_presentation), 3 definitions changed (finalize_answer, _maybe_revise_rejected_candidate, _verify_authored_candidate_without_mutation), 1 key group added and 1 extended, nothing removed. core/agent_state.py: one run field. tests/fixtures/answer_coherence_live1_reversal.json stores the hunks; its pipeline preimage is the 2026-09-10 remediation's post and its agent_state preimage is DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.5's pin, and tests/_harness_maintenance.py undoes it before the remediation, so every earlier pin is checked against history and none is re-pinned. 30 more files are pinned in answer_coherence_live1_frozen_boundaries.json, evaluated through before_later_receipts.

COST. Binding is pure composition over values already on the payload: a median of about 28 microseconds per run for capture, history, install and binding, about 44 including the one existing candidate fingerprint the binding cross-checks (7 x 2000 runs). No provider, network, sandbox, probe, validation, traversal or retrieval. Model-call delta 0; the revision prompt is byte-identical.

SCHEMA. Additive only. The new group carries its own candidate_presentation_schema_version (candidate_presentation_live_1_v1); the revision receipt stays candidate_revision_live_1_v1 because its fields did not change, and the history record only gained optional keys. No wire version was bumped for the sake of a new phase.

KNOWN LIMITATION: THE MUTATION-ENABLED BRANCH IS NOT STAMPED. Only the read-only verification branch can hold two candidates, so the binding is written there. With AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED=true the payload carries one authoring generation and nothing to bind; the self-correct loop's re-authored attempts are executed from a side holder and never enter the payload, which is a separate presentation question left untouched here.

KNOWN LIMITATION: needs_escalation SEEDING IS UNCHANGED. PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.1 seeds a fresh Candidate1's payload flag false and lets the gates raise it, so a verified Candidate1 whose author asked for escalation shows needs_escalation false while Candidate0's own claim would have survived. Folding the author's claim into the harness flag would change lifecycle policy; this phase records the claim separately instead.

CONCURRENT-REMEDIATION RECONCILIATION. The broad affected run (124 files) matched the 49-failure baseline exactly and added one failure outside it: tests/test_paired_defect_probe.py::test_frozen_probe_execution_and_authority_surfaces_are_unchanged, which hashed core/defect_probe.py's raw bytes against DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.3's pin (4f5c8cb1..., the remediation's preimage) while the shipped file is the remediation's post (813dda87...). An A/B with this phase reverted failed identically, so it predates this phase: the remediation routed the LIVE.4/LIVE.5/LOCALIZE.LIVE.2 raw-byte tests through its helper and missed this one. It now calls before_harness_remediation like its siblings; all 16 of its pins reconstruct with 0 mismatches and none was re-pinned. The three test_harness_blackbox_revision.py scenarios once recorded as baseline failures now pass, which is the remediation's doing, not this phase's.

REGISTRY NAMING. ANSWER.* is an existing phase-id namespace inside the CHECK track for user-visible answer truthfulness, alongside ANSWER.GROUND.LIVE.1-4; no track, schema dimension or phase_registry.py edit was needed. DIAG.INDENT.SEMANTICS.1 (structural indentation semantics) is not started here.
phases.summary: Round 10 produced two real candidates. Candidate0 (an inert guard, confidence 0.9) was rejected still_reproduced; PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.1's single revision produced Candidate1 (a branch reorder, confidence 1.0), which parsed, earned its own fingerprint 368fc158..., passed the candidate gates and was rejected behavior_preservation_regressed. Containment held, but the final payload paired Candidate0's summary and Candidate0's own issue with Candidate1's patch, Candidate1's confidence and the harness finding about Candidate1. Root cause: the revision path installed only the new patch bytes and the new confidence - parse_revised_candidate reads nothing else from the response - so every other field Candidate0's author had written stayed on the payload. This phase binds every candidate-authored field to exactly one candidate identity. core/candidate_presentation.py records what each authoring response said about its own candidate where that response is parsed (finalize_answer for the first draft, the revision path for Candidate1), before any gate narrows it; installs a replacement candidate and its author's account as one unit, so a field Candidate1 omits is absent rather than Candidate0's; keeps Candidate0's summary, issues, model confidence, escalation claim and verification verdict under the existing rejected-history record; and, once the lifecycle is terminal, reads the final identity off the revision receipt and the existing candidate receipts, checks every author-facing field against it, and stamps final_candidate_fingerprint, final_candidate_generation and candidate_presentation_coherent - withholding the author's account instead of guessing when it cannot be bound. The exact Round-10 pair, replayed through finalize_answer and the real read-only lifecycle, rebuilds Round 10's revision request byte for byte and now presents Candidate1's summary, patch, confidence 1.0 and fingerprint together, with verification rejected behavior_preservation_regressed, needs_escalation true, human_review_eligible false and approval_ready false exactly as production recorded them. No model call, network call, probe, validation, traversal, authority, revision, safe_minimal or confidence semantics change.

notes: ENTITY IDENTITY, NOT SEMANTIC TRUTH. Binding core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent establishes only that the source entity exists in current evidence; it does not establish that the function is defective or causal. CHECK.2 remains unwired and no second model reviewer is introduced.

LAST DISPLAY-SAFE BOUNDARY. CLI and web parse and postprocess the model payload, reach a terminal execution/authorization outcome, and only then call ground_state_answer. The same safe copy feeds terminal display, web answer and patch fields, logs, session messages, artifacts, and live-trace final text. Follow-up answers use the same display helper before printing or persistence.

ALLOWED FACT SOURCES. Operation-scoped RepositoryInventory membership, eligible loaded source symbols, CONTROL source/evidence objects, AnalysisEvidence acquisition receipts, typed or bounded execution-observed paths, and existing create_file operations are reused. No new walk, index query, graph rebuild, file reread, model call, embedding, or network request is performed.

SUBJECT BINDING. Existing canonical root-derived repository identities and aliases distinguish repository-qualified references. With multiple subjects, the same unqualified relative path is refused when its subject is ambiguous; a matching filename in one repository never establishes it in another.

SMALL STATUS VOCABULARY. grounded_existing, grounded_execution_observed, user_supplied_unverified, proposed_new, hypothetical, and unverified_model_assertion are the complete runtime statuses. Confidence is absent because membership, not probability, is authoritative here.

BOUNDED FREE TEXT. Extraction recognizes only common well-formed repository file references plus optional qualified symbols and line numbers. Fenced code is excluded and clear sentence-local example/hypothetical cues remain allowed. The implementation is not an NLP parser.

FAILED GROUNDING. Unsupported assistant factual specificity is removed from its sentence or field and replaced with a bounded evidence-gap statement. User wording can be repeated inside an explicitly unverified statement. A rejected fabricated entity is never silently replaced with a different ranked real entity.

PROVENANCE. Acquired analysis document paths remain precise without code-index membership. Execution-observed file locations do not establish source symbols. Proposed create-file paths remain proposals and answer grounding grants no patch scope, basis, safety, write, execution, or approval authority.

RECEIPT. answer_entity_grounding reports asserted, grounded, and unverified counts, one bounded action, at most twelve entity records, evidence gaps, extraction/membership/total timings, authority_effect=none and retrieval_effect=none. It stores no source contents, confidence, model review, or hidden reasoning.

T6 CLOSURE. A payload naming patcher/generator.py::PatchGenerator.generate and config/settings.py::ConfigurationOptions against a repository containing neither emits an explicit evidence gap, keeps patch_candidate=null and both authority fields false, invents no substitute, and exposes the same grounded copy through CLI and web.

FROZEN SYSTEMS. Retrieval, identifier recall, ranking, graph/index lifecycle, _classify_indent, validation, patch basis, patch safety, byte writes/rollback, execution authorization, CHECK.LIVE, human approval, model prompts, and network behavior are unchanged. Historical artifacts are not rewritten.

REGISTRY NAMING. ANSWER is an ID namespace in the existing CHECK track, following PATCH, EXEC, and RETRIEVE namespace precedent. It adds no track and no PLAN, READINESS, or CLOSE siblings. The sole prerequisite is RETRIEVE.LIVE.3.

VERIFICATION. The final answer/registry/picker matrix passed 271 tests; three frozen compatibility groups passed 1,225 tests; registry validation reports 152 valid phases; benchmark check passed 54/54; compileall and git diff --check passed. A representative boundary call measured extraction=0.000143 s, membership_check=0.000013 s, total=0.007817 s. The broad suite finished with 9,166 passed, 14 skipped, and 49 historical registry/checkpoint and selector-runtime failures (three fewer than the prior 52-failure baseline); no ANSWER.GROUND.LIVE.1 test failed.

The boundary runs only after execution authority is terminal, performs no repository traversal, index query, graph rebuild, model/network call, retrieval/ranking change, semantic cause verification, or authority widening, and exposes a bounded grounding receipt with timings but no confidence.

There is no answer_entity_grounding_v2 and no symbol hallucination checker.

ENTITY IDENTITY, NOT SEMANTIC TRUTH. Grounding core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent establishes that the symbol exists in current evidence, never that it is the defect. _classify_indent is not fixed here, CHECK.2 remains unwired, and no verifier model is introduced.

FILE AND SYMBOL GROUNDING STAY DISTINCT. A real file never validates an invented member, a real class never validates a method it does not own, and a real method never validates OtherClass.method. The relation itself has to exist.

BOUNDED SYMBOL EVIDENCE. RETRIEVE.LIVE.1 eligible graph symbols, class membership derived by a linear sweep over spans the graph already recorded, CONTROL entry nodes and grounded patch intent, WAITER.LIVE.1 analysis excerpts already held in memory, and traceback frames whose file is already established. No new walk, index query, graph rebuild, file read, model call, embedding or network request.

CONSERVATIVE CLAIM GRAMMAR. Structured symbol fields with sibling path context, inline code spans, qualified Owner.member / Owner::member / module.symbol forms, call formatting and a small set of sentence cues. A qualified claim needs a leftmost segment the repository already knows or a CamelCase owner outside the well-known external roots; an unknown bare token is a claim only when its own form marks it as a symbol and it is not a language builtin. False negatives are preferred: this is not an NLP entity recognizer.

BARE SYMBOL UNIQUENESS. A bare tail carried by exactly one source-backed symbol may stay precise without a path. Several distinct symbols with the same tail give ambiguous_symbol, and no winner is chosen; only a file or module named in the same sentence or a sibling structured field may make the identity exact. Grounding is not retrieval and never silently substitutes another symbol.

SMALL STATUS VOCABULARY. ambiguous_symbol is the single addition to grounded_existing, grounded_execution_observed, user_supplied_unverified, proposed_new, hypothetical and unverified_model_assertion. Stale or mismatched evidence keeps failing to unverified_model_assertion exactly as in LIVE.1. Confidence is absent because membership, not probability, is authoritative.

STILL SAYABLE. User-supplied missing symbols stay discussable under explicit unverified framing, plan-proposed classes and members are proposed_new (an anchored owner is required so an invented patched_snippet cannot launder an invented class), hypothetical illustrations introduced by a modal stay hypothetical, identifiers inside fenced examples are not claims, and external APIs such as pytest.main, pathlib.Path and requests.Session are never rejected for being absent from the repository.
REPOSITORY IDENTITY. Symbol universes are not collapsed across roots: repo A's Foo.run never grounds an answer about repo B, and an unattributable claim under several subjects fails closed.

RECEIPT. asserted_path_count, asserted_symbol_count, grounded_symbol_count, unverified_symbol_count and ambiguous_symbol_count join the LIVE.1 counters, with bounded unverified entities, evidence gaps and timings. No source text, no confidence, authority_effect=none and retrieval_effect=none.

NO EFFECT BEYOND DISPLAY. A rejected symbol never mutates the query, entry nodes, CONTROL ranking or the Scout candidate set, and never grants patch basis, patch safety, human_review_eligible, approval or execution authorization. patch_candidate and the authority flags are untouched, and an unverified symbol cannot alter a completed execution fact. Historical artifacts are not rewritten; only new runtime results carry the extended receipt.
REGISTERED AS A SINGLE LIVE FIX with no PLAN, READINESS, or CLOSE siblings, prerequisite ANSWER.GROUND.LIVE.1, and it is not report-only: the user-visible answer changes.
phases.summary: Live deterministic extension of the ANSWER.GROUND.LIVE.1 answer-truthfulness boundary to repository claims that carry no path: bare symbols, qualified members, module-qualified symbols and typed symbol fields. Round-5 proved path-shaped fabrications were caught while "CodeGenerator.format_patch" and "the bug is in the PatchGenerator.generate method" escaped; a concrete assistant-asserted symbol now may be shown as an established repository fact only when it binds to fresh inventory, source-backed graph metadata, acquired analysis declarations, CONTROL source evidence or an execution-observed frame. File and symbol grounding stay distinct, so a real file never validates an invented member, a real class never validates a method it does not own, a real method never validates the wrong owner, and an ambiguous bare tail is reported as ambiguous rather than guessed. Ordinary prose, language builtins, external APIs, fenced examples, hypothetical illustrations, user-supplied referents and plan-proposed symbols remain sayable. One extraction pass, one status vocabulary, one downgrade path and one receipt: the phase adds no model call, network call, repository traversal, graph or index rebuild, retrieval or ranking change, and no authority widening, and is not report-only because it changes the user-visible answer.

notes: THE PREREQUISITE RECORDS DISCOVERY ORDER, NOT OWNERSHIP. ANALYSIS.MULTIROOT.LIVE.1 produced the two-root T5 answer in which both defects became visible, and its own entry already notes that a second root grounds only what was actually read. The defects are ANSWER.GROUND defects and implementation stays in the CHECK track: core/answer_entity_grounding.py is the only production file changed. Analysis acquisition, root allocation, the 12-file/60,000-character budget, evidence ranking and retrieval are untouched, and core/analysis_multiroot.py, core/analysis_evidence.py and core/retriever.py are on this phase's forbidden_files list.

THE EXACT DESTRUCTIVE POINT, PINNED. core/answer_entity_grounding.py, ground_answer_text(): 'ranges = _merge_ranges(_sentence_bounds(value, start, end) for start, end, _ in unsupported)' followed by a reverse-order slice deletion of each merged range. One block. It is replaced by _annotate_unsupported_spans, which inserts and never deletes. _merge_ranges had no other caller and is gone.

AN UNSUPPORTED ENTITY SPAN IS NOT A CONTAINING SENTENCE. That is the hard invariant. Remediation operates from the exact extracted span and never asks where a sentence begins or ends, so abbreviations cannot influence it. _sentence_bounds still exists for two unrelated purposes it already served - hypothetical-cue context in _is_hypothetical_context and sentence-local path context in _sentence_local_paths for ambiguity resolution - and controls nothing about what survives. The Round-6 'parallel vs. exclusive' clause is a permanent regression fixture, alongside 'e.g.' and 'i.e.'.

UNVERIFIED IS NOT NONEXISTENT, AND THE WORDING NOW SAYS SO. The gate walks nothing, queries no index and builds no graph, so it is structurally incapable of earning a repository-wide absence claim. The evidence-gap statement closes with 'This check reads only the evidence this run acquired, so that is an evidence limit and not a finding about whether LABEL contains it.' Cordis and AgentLoop really do exist in deepseek-harness and remain unverified here because this run never acquired the files declaring them; rescuing them needs acquisition, not grounding, and no repository-wide scan was added to do it. test_unverified_never_reads_as_proven_nonexistent pins that no categorical wording is reachable.

INSERT-ONLY IS PROVEN, NOT ASSERTED. On the reconstructed Round-6 T5 answer, removing every inserted marker from the grounded body reproduces the source answer exactly apart from the single trailing newline the gap-statement seam consumes: character delta 252 = 6 markers x 42 characters. The same operation on the Round-6 body cannot recover the source, because 419 characters no longer exist. Deleted characters 419 -> 0; bullets 1/2 -> 2/2; headings 3/3 and repository-qualified citations 7/7 unchanged in both.

ORDERING AND OWNERSHIP ARE PINNED, NOT ACCIDENTAL. Insertions are applied right to left so offsets stay valid across any number of entities. Overlapping spans are taken in reading order, longest first, and annotated exactly once - both findings are still reported, only the text edit is deduplicated. _annotation_point places the marker after a closing delimiter when the span sits directly inside backticks, parentheses, brackets or double quotes, so '[the loop](docs/loop.md)' becomes '[the loop](docs/loop.md) (not established ...)' rather than a broken link destination.

THE PATH GRAMMAR, EXACTLY. Before: '(?P<path>(?:PART[\\/])*PART\\.(?:ext1|ext2|...))' with the alternation inheriting declaration order and no boundary. After: the same group with the alternation CONSTRUCTED as sorted(COMMON_REPOSITORY_EXTENSIONS, key=lambda item: (-len(item), item)) - longest first, ties alphabetical - immediately followed by _EXTENSION_BOUNDARY = '(?![A-Za-z0-9_])' inside the path group. The class is ASCII on purpose: it is the exact complement of the ASCII lookbehind already guarding the left edge and of _PATH_PART itself, and a Unicode '\\w' would additionally stop finding main.py inside non-Latin prose - a false negative, the wrong direction for a truthfulness gate, and a localization behaviour change T6 forbids.

REAL PATHS AND COMPOSITES STILL MATCH. Neither ':' nor '/' is a word character, so file.py::symbol, file.py::Class.method and main.py:12 stay single coherent entities and are never split into overlapping findings. Pinned: src/app.js, src/app.jsx, src/app.mjs, src/app.ts, src/app.tsx, config.json, module.c, module.cc, module.cpp, module.cxx, stub.py, stub.pyi, page.htm, page.html, build.yml, build.yaml, core/code_dna.py and core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent. Reproduction found three overlap defects the bug report did not list - config.json to config.js, module.cpp to module.c and src/app.tsx to src/app.ts - all fixed by the same construction.

THE NODE.JS GUARD IS FROZEN AND WAS NOT REGRESSED. Whole-spelling external-product matching is unchanged: Node.js and Vue.js produce no finding, while types.ts, path.ts and src/app.js remain possible repository paths and are still downgraded when absent. A dotted identifier is not a partial file path any more - Cordis.plugin, pytest.main, pathlib.Path, argparse.Namespace, _pytest.capture.CaptureFixture, logging.config and os.path produce zero path-shaped findings - and symbol/external classification handles them separately, exactly as before.

STRUCTURED FIELDS STAY FIELD-LOCAL. A typed symbol field is one claim whose span is the whole value, so the same span-local rule turns it into an explicit unverified value carrying the bounded gap statement LIVE.2 already put there. Structured-field remediation is still never converted into sentence or prose rewriting, and raw and grounded representations remain distinguishable because the grounded copy carries both the marker and the receipt.

RECEIPT SEMANTICS, BOUNDED. Two facts added: remediation_scope = 'entity_span' and surrounding_text_preserved = true. No confidence, no score, no authority effect, no retrieval effect. phase_ids becomes [ANSWER.GROUND.LIVE.1, ANSWER.GROUND.LIVE.2, ANSWER.GROUND.LIVE.3] and schema_version becomes answer_ground_live_3_v1. Historical stored answers are not rewritten; only new results use LIVE.3 remediation.

BOUNDARIES, STATICALLY PINNED. Model calls 0, network 0, filesystem traversal 0, graph/index/embedding 0, retrieval unchanged, analysis-evidence selection unchanged, write/patch/execution authority unchanged. test_no_repository_scan_model_call_or_network_is_introduced asserts that no os.walk, rglob, glob(, provider import, network import, core.retriever, core.indexer or authority setter appears in the module - and that no T5-specific symbol allowlist (Cordis, AgentLoop, ReactLoopAgent, AbortController) was smuggled in as a fix, which is why the module's own examples use neutral spellings.

KNOWN LIMITATIONS, measured. The annotation is verbose: every occurrence of an unsupported entity is marked, so an answer naming one entity ten times carries ten markers. Marking only the first occurrence would read better and was rejected because a later unmarked occurrence still reads as established fact, which weakens LIVE.2. Multi-root gap labels degrade to 'the relevant repository' when an unsupported entity binds to no repository - pre-existing LIVE.1/.2 behaviour in the two-root case, and honest, because the gate genuinely cannot say which universe the claim was aimed at. A pre-existing LIVE.2 grammar quirk was found and deliberately not fixed: parse_symbol_text rejects 'Cc.dd' because 'cc' is a supported extension, so a qualified symbol whose owner is spelled like an extension is never extracted as a claim; that lives in core/repository_symbol_membership.py, which is on this phase's forbidden_files list. t.json is still classified as a path claim, which is correct - only the truncation to t.js was a defect. Not report-only: this is the live display and persistence grounding path.
phases.summary: Live remediation fix for the answer-grounding boundary. Round-6 black-box evidence established two defects, both in what a downgrade DOES to the text and neither in what is classified. DEFECT A: an unsupported entity deleted its entire containing sentence, and because _sentence_bounds split on '[!?.]\\s+' the abbreviation 'vs.' was read as a sentence boundary, so the deletion started mid-clause and the live T5 answer shipped 'exclusive), and state transitions ...' to the user. Measured on the reconstructed Round-6 T5 answer that cost 419 deleted characters, one of two bullets, an emptied section and a mangled 'e.g.' clause - true, correctly cited prose destroyed in order to retract two entities. DEFECT B: _ENTITY_RE built its extension alternation as a plain join over declaration order with no boundary after the extension, so a supported extension matched as a PREFIX inside a longer dotted token: args.cmd produced a fabrication finding for args.c, t.json was truncated to t.js, Cordis.plugin to Cordis.pl and _pytest.capture.CaptureFixture to _pytest.capture.C. Reproduction found three more the report did not list - config.json to config.js, module.cpp to module.c and src/app.tsx to src/app.ts - so the gate was both inventing file claims nobody made and silently mis-citing real files. The primary epistemic distinction is preserved and made explicit: unverified_model_assertion means NOT ESTABLISHED BY THE CURRENT BOUNDED EVIDENCE, never PROVEN NONEXISTENT. This gate walks nothing, queries no index and builds no graph, so it is structurally incapable of earning a repository-wide absence claim, and the user-visible wording now says so. The fix: _annotate_unsupported_spans replaces the delete-the-sentence pass and INSERTS ONLY, marking the exact extracted span with '(not established in the current evidence)' so text before the entity, text after it, punctuation, citations, bullets and clause structure survive byte for byte. Remediation no longer consults sentence bounds at all - _sentence_bounds remains solely for hypothetical-cue context and sentence-local path context for ambiguity resolution, and controls nothing about what survives, which is why 'vs.', 'e.g.' and 'i.e.' can no longer influence a downgrade. Insertions are applied right to left so offsets stay valid across any number of entities; overlapping spans are taken in reading order longest first and annotated exactly once while both findings are still reported; and _annotation_point places the marker after a closing delimiter when the span sits directly inside backticks, parentheses, brackets or quotes, so '[the loop](docs/loop.md)' is never corrupted into a broken link. Structured-field remediation stays field-local: the typed value becomes an explicit unverified value and is still never converted into prose rewriting. The path grammar gains two pinned changes - the alternation is CONSTRUCTED longest-extension-first rather than inheriting declaration order, and _EXTENSION_BOUNDARY = '(?![A-Za-z0-9_])' sits inside the path group immediately after the extension. The class is ASCII deliberately: it is the exact complement of the ASCII lookbehind already guarding the left edge and of _PATH_PART itself, and a Unicode '\\w' would additionally stop finding main.py inside non-Latin prose, which is a false negative and a localization behaviour change T6 forbids. Neither ':' nor '/' is a word character, so file.py::Class.method and main.py:12 stay single coherent entities. Measured on the reconstructed Round-6 T5 answer with two-root bounded evidence and no provider call: characters deleted 419 -> 0, bullets surviving 1/2 -> 2/2, headings 3/3 unchanged, repository-qualified citations 7/7 unchanged, mid-clause cut at 'vs.' yes -> no, fabricated extension-prefix path findings {args.c, t.js, Cordis.pl, _pytest.capture.C} -> none, findings 15 -> 13, median grounding time 0.001010s -> 0.000949s. Insert-only is proven rather than asserted: removing every inserted marker from the grounded body reproduces the source answer exactly apart from the single trailing newline the gap-statement seam consumes, character delta 252 = 6 markers x 42 characters, while the same operation on the Round-6 body cannot recover the source because 419 characters no longer exist. Fabricated symbols are still downgraded, grounded symbols are still byte-identical, ambiguous/hypothetical/proposed/external behaviour is unchanged, multi-root symbol universes stay separate, and the Node.js whole-spelling external-product guard is untouched with types.ts and path.ts still treated as possible repository paths. The phase adds no model call, no network call, no repository traversal, no index or graph, no retrieval change, no analysis-evidence change and no authority change.

notes: PRIMARY INVARIANT. Grounding may inspect and remediate user-visible assistant prose, explicitly model-authored answer fields and explicitly model-authored repository claims. It may not mutate harness-authored machine fields: phase ids, schema versions, fingerprints and digests, statuses and enums, provenance, receipts, telemetry, authority fields, validation results, probe results, verification results, localization receipts, candidate bindings and freshness bindings.

OWNERSHIP, NOT SPELLING. The fix is deliberately not a longer blacklist of key names. _ANSWER_SURFACE_KEYS is an allowlist of fields the model itself is asked to write, and the safe default for any unknown structured field is DO NOT REWRITE. A test asserts the surface excludes phase_id, schema_version, provenance, status, fingerprints, receipt, evidence_freshness, verification_status, localized_target and the authority booleans.

OWNERSHIP IS INHERITED. The key is checked at every level of the payload, not only at the root, so everything beneath a harness-owned field is harness-owned. A receipt carrying its own 'summary' keeps it verbatim. Without this, a future receipt schema reusing an answer key name would silently reopen the defect.

MODEL-AUTHORED STRUCTURED CLAIMS STILL GROUND. LIVE.1/.2/.3 protection is not disabled for genuine model output. _SYMBOL_ASSERTION_KEYS is a subset of the answer surface, so a typed symbol field carrying ImaginaryClass.fake_method is still downgraded, and a fabricated target_node_name inside patch_candidate is still downgraded. The distinction is ownership, not str versus dict.

REUSED BOUNDARY. core/localization_handoff.py::_display_payload already recurses only into declared model-authored answer keys on this same payload, with the comment that execution receipts, patch bytes and entity-grounding facts remain exact. ANSWER.GROUND did the opposite on the same object; this phase makes the two seams agree and does not edit localization_handoff.

SKIP LIST NOW REDUNDANT. content, target_snippet, patched_snippet, source_snippet, output, diff and traceback are preserved because they are not on the answer surface, not because they are blacklisted. _SKIP_PAYLOAD_TEXT_KEYS is retained as a second gate and a test asserts the two sets stay disjoint, so a future edit that puts code bytes on the answer surface is caught rather than shipped.

REPRODUCTION CONDITION. The defect needs the subject repository to declare a symbol whose tail is 'candidate', which puts 'candidate' into SymbolMembership._known_names and makes CANDIDATE.* owner-shaped. That holds on a self-analysis of C.A.T.T.U.S via core/candidate_verification.py, which is why sparse-evidence fixtures never caught it. The annotated span stops at CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE because a segment starting with a digit is not a member name - exactly the Round-7 corruption.

LIVE.3 PRESERVED. Entity-span-only remediation, no sentence deletion, the honest 'not established in the current evidence' reading, the path-boundary fixes and multi-root semantics are unchanged. This phase changes which fields are offered to the grounding pass, never what the pass does with a field it is given. All 89 existing LIVE.1/.2/.3 tests pass untouched.

LANGUAGE SURFACE OUT OF SCOPE. The free-text classification of a phase-id-shaped token inside model prose is deliberately unchanged: if a model writes CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE into a summary it is a model-authored claim and LIVE.1/.2/.3 semantics apply. The elif/startswith free-text and entity classification question stays on its own backlog.

FROZEN BOUNDARIES RE-TAKEN HONESTLY. core/answer_entity_grounding.py was pinned whole-file in tests/fixtures/control_localize_live2_boundaries.json; this phase owns that file, so the pin was re-taken. Because a re-taken whole-file pin proves nothing, tests/fixtures/answer_ground_live4_frozen_boundaries.json replaces it with a finer invariant generated from a reconstructed pre-change file whose sha256 was verified equal to the old pin: of 44 top-level definitions exactly one, _ground_payload_value, changed, and the other 43 are pinned at their pre-LIVE.4 AST digests with none added or removed.

AUTHORITY DELTA ZERO. No model call, no network call, no repository traversal, no retrieval, no indexing, no authority change, no validation change and no candidate change. The receipt still reports authority_effect=none and retrieval_effect=none, and the payload walk now visits strictly fewer nodes than before.
REGISTRY NAMING. ANSWER.GROUND.LIVE.4 is a direct live phase in the existing CHECK track alongside LIVE.1/.2/.3; ANSWER.* remains a phase-id namespace only, adding no schema dimension.
phases.summary: Live ownership fix for the answer-grounding boundary. Round-7 proved ANSWER.GROUND rewrote machine-authored control-plane telemetry as if the model had asserted it: candidate_verification_phase_id and the nested candidate_verification_receipt.phase_id left the boundary as 'CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE (not established in the current evidence).1' followed by a user-facing evidence-gap paragraph. The payload stayed valid JSON and lost its machine meaning, so any reader matching the phase id or the receipt saw a mismatch. Root cause: core/answer_entity_grounding.py::_ground_payload_value walked the whole json_block and grounded every string at every depth, skipping only keys blacklisted in _SKIP_PAYLOAD_TEXT_KEYS - the default was rewrite-unless-blacklisted. json_block is not the model's answer; it is the answer plus every control-plane fact the harness attaches after the model finished, and core/pipeline.py alone names over a hundred such keys across _CANDIDATE_VERIFICATION_KEYS, _EXECUTION_ELIGIBILITY_KEYS, _TARGETED_VALIDATION_KEYS, _CANDIDATE_VALIDATION_KEYS and _CANDIDATE_DEFECT_PROBE_KEYS, with every future phase adding more. A name blacklist is always one phase out of date and fails open. The fix inverts the default to an explicit model-authored answer surface: _ANSWER_SURFACE_KEYS = _ANSWER_PROSE_KEYS | _SYMBOL_ASSERTION_KEYS | _PATH_CONTEXT_KEYS, where the prose keys come from the response schemas in core/prompter.py and the reviewer block patching/patch_gates.py::reject_schema_drift synthesises. A field is descended into and rewritten only when the model authored it; every other field is returned by identity. Ownership is inherited down the subtree - the key is checked at every level - so a harness receipt that happens to contain 'summary' keeps it verbatim and key-name collisions with future receipt schemas cannot reopen the hole. This reuses the boundary core/localization_handoff.py::_display_payload already applies to the same payload; that file is not edited. Model-authored claims stay groundable: a typed symbol field carrying ImaginaryClass.fake_method is still downgraded, because the distinction is ownership and not str versus dict. All 89 LIVE.1/.2/.3 tests pass unchanged, and the free-text classification of phase-id-shaped tokens in model prose is deliberately untouched and stays on its own backlog. No model call, no network call, no repository traversal, no retrieval, no indexing, no authority change, no validation change and no candidate change; the payload walk now visits strictly fewer nodes than before.
