notes: EXECUTION BRANCH, NOT THE EPISTEMIC BRANCH. CHECK.1 consumes an execution authorization, a worker self-report, observed change facts, validation expectations and receipts, and execution state fingerprints. It consumes no SYNTHESIS.1 StructuredSynthesis, no CLAIM.1 assessment and no evidence payload, so its prerequisite is the bounded patch-safety attachment phase CTX.APPLY.0 rather than the epistemic phase that happened to ship before it. The registry records architecture, not implementation order.

OBJECTIVE FACTS OUTRANK THE SELF-REPORT. The observed change set is authoritative. A declared change that was never observed is recorded as declared_but_unobserved and no diff is fabricated to match it; an observed change the worker never declared is recorded as undeclared and is never silently normalised away, even when the path was allowed. Declaring no change while changes exist, and declaring changes while none exist, are both explicit mismatches.

PATH AUTHORITY IS FAIL-CLOSED. Actual changed paths must be a subset of the authorized set; widening happens only through an explicit bounded path expansion receipt, which can never reach a path the authorization marks forbidden. A forbidden path change is blocked even when the worker declared it, even when every required test passed, and even when the patch was minimal. Supporting read-only files and validation execute-only files are non-writable: read authority is never write authority.

PATCH SAFETY IS REUSED, NOT REDISCOVERED. The narrow observation adapter runs every write-bearing path through the existing core.patch_safety gate and demotes anything it blocks to forbidden carrying the gate's own category, so a protected, env, test or benchmark-validation path cannot be laundered in as writable. Generated, temporary, sensitive, symlinked, stale and replaced remain bounded forbidden reasons rather than semantic rediscovery.

VALIDATION CANNOT BE FAKED BY PROSE. A required expectation is discharged only by a receipt bound to the same run, repository, expectation identity, validation kind and exact target scope. A worker declaration of a passing validation with no matching receipt is unverified_worker_validation_claim. An extra validation nobody asked for is recorded as additional_observed and can never discharge a missing required one. A skip is not an execution, and there is no approximate test-scope equivalence.

STALE VALIDATION CANNOT CERTIFY A LATER STATE. A passing receipt whose state fingerprint is not the final state fingerprint is stale, so a suite that passed before a further file changed leaves the run uncertified, and no automatic rerun is attempted. A supplied post-validation state that differs from the final state is recorded as a mutation after validation. The phase fails closed: validated_state_current is false unless a required receipt binds the exact final state.

NO SUCCESS LAUNDERING. Passing tests never override a scope violation, a failed required validation is blocked rather than incomplete, and a worker success claim is derived against the facts rather than accepted. Every result, including a fully reconciled one, still carries semantic_goal_review_required and human_review_required, and no field or serialized key asserts goal satisfaction or implementation correctness.

PRESERVATION OBLIGATIONS HAND OFF TO CHECK.2. A carried preservation obligation stays unresolved_semantic_check_required unless a deterministic upstream validation receipt explicitly certifies that exact obligation and binds the final state. Identical diff facts under a change-behaviour contract and a preserve-behaviour contract produce different preserved obligations without either being judged semantically.

DETERMINISM AND TAMPER BINDING. Canonical SHA-256 identities bind the task contract, execution authorization, worker report, observed fact set, every validation receipt, the request and the result. Unordered path, change and receipt input canonicalises, so the same fact set reconciles byte identically whatever order it arrives in. An edited report, fact set, authorization or receipt is inconsistent_input, and a moved final state turns previously current receipts stale. Time, randomness and machine state are absent.

AUTHORITY IS NARROW AND REPORT-ONLY. post_run_reconciliation_authority is true only for a coherent supplied fact set. Semantic-goal-review, implementation-correctness, final-success, merge, patch, write, repository-read, repository-traversal, validation-execution, command-execution, model-selection, provider-selection and final-response authority are always false, and human approval is always required.

NO DIFF, SOURCE, MODEL OR REPAIR LOOP. The reconciliation core imports only stdlib hashing, JSON, immutable dataclass helpers and the frozen lexical repository path policy. Changes are carried as path, change kind and before/after digests, never as diff or file content. There is no reviewer model, no regex or fuzzy path matching, no numeric risk score and no route to ask a worker to revise its note, so an original mismatch stays auditable.

ONE EXECUTION UNIT AT A TIME. One request yields one bounded result; there is no cross-worker aggregation, majority or voting. Per-worker path ownership is honoured when the authorization exposes it and is reported as worker_scope_ownership_unavailable when it does not, rather than invented. A future CHECK.MERGE.1 would own multi-worker arbitration.

DEEPSEEK-STYLE EXECUTION REGRESSION. A worker reporting two changed files and passing tests, while a third forbidden file changed and the suite passed before that change, is reconciled to blocked with undeclared, forbidden, stale-validation and inconsistent-success-claim findings, using no semantic reviewer, no model and no test execution.

NO LIVE WIRING. No Commander, Instant Run, Project Evolution, Workbench, Mixed Mode, executor, merge path or response generation imports or calls CHECK.1, and existing checker, note-vs-diff and patch-safety behaviour is unchanged by this slice. Tests and fixtures are its only consumers. CHECK.2 semantic goal-fidelity review is future work and is not implemented or authorized here.
phases.summary: Pure, deterministic, report-only reconciliation of one execution unit's supplied execution authorization, worker self-report, objective observed change facts, validation expectations/receipts and execution state bindings into a bounded reconciled / reconciled_with_warnings / incomplete / suspicious / blocked / inconsistent_input status. Observed facts outrank the self-report, a forbidden or out-of-scope path cannot be laundered by a declaration or a passing test, undeclared changes stay visible, worker prose cannot mint a validation receipt, and a receipt bound to an earlier state cannot certify the final state. It performs no semantic goal review, implementation-correctness judgement, repository traversal, source read, validation or command execution, patch generation or application, model or network call, merge, write, or worker repair loop, and is not wired into any live product path.
phases.title: Post-Run Contract Reconciliation

notes: TWO BRANCHES, ONE JOIN. CHECK.2 is the first phase that genuinely consumes both the execution branch and the epistemic branch: a frozen CHECK.1 PostRunReconciliation and the frozen CLAIM.1 ClaimAssessment records made over the propositions its obligations are bound to. Its prerequisites are therefore CHECK.1 and CLAIM.1. It consumes no SYNTHESIS.1 StructuredSynthesis and imports nothing from it: composing claims into a task answer and reconciling claims against post-run obligations are different questions over the same records.

NO REVIEWER MODEL, NO REVIEWER BYPASS. The forbidden architecture - task contract plus diff plus worker note into a model that says 'looks correct' - has no landing site. CHECK.2 makes no semantic judgement of its own, imports no analyzer, gate or adapter, and cannot re-run CHECK.1 or CLAIM.1. Every semantic direction it reports came from a ClaimAssessment that already passed the ACQUIRE, EVIDENCE.1, EVIDENCE.2 and CLAIM.1 spine.

EXECUTION SEVERITY IS MONOTONIC. The CHECK.1 entry gate maps reconciled and reconciled_with_warnings to assessable, incomplete and suspicious to diagnostic_only, and blocked and inconsistent_input to blocked. A blocked review yields no determined obligation state at all - the result cannot be constructed with one - so a forbidden file change plus every goal proposition supported is still blocked, and the CHECK.1 blocking reasons are carried forward verbatim.

NO OBLIGATION INVENTION. A preservation obligation must match a CHECK.1 preservation finding on identity, kind and text digest; a goal or constraint obligation must match an entry in an explicit requirement ledger bound to the same task contract fingerprint. The ledger cannot carry a preservation requirement and its provenance vocabulary has no inferred value, so a reviewer-invented 'performance should also be checked' requirement cannot be represented. An obligation naming no authoritative source is obligation_structure_widened.

NO OBLIGATION LOSS. Every CHECK.1 preservation finding and every required ledger requirement must appear in the specification, and three goals plus two preservation constraints produce exactly five obligation results even when some are missing_claim_assessment. Dropping one is preservation_obligation_dropped or goal_obligation_dropped and refuses the whole request.

POLARITY IS SUPPLIED, NEVER INFERRED. 'Do not change embedding behaviour' is satisfied by support for 'preserves the previous embedding behaviour' and by contradiction of 'changes the embedding behaviour'. The binding must state its orientation and the provenance of that orientation; a binding that omits either is binding_invalid rather than guessed, and the same ClaimAssessment bound under two explicit orientations yields two different obligation states.

CLAIM STATUS IS NEVER LAUNDERED. conflicting_evidence, insufficient_evidence, coverage_incomplete, current_state_unestablished and current_state_inconsistent pass through unchanged under either polarity, a claim that refused its own input is binding_invalid, and every obligation result carries CLAIM.1's own status beside the mapped one. Conflict is not adjudicated here and there is no implementation-beats-tests tiebreak.

A VALIDATION RECEIPT IS NOT A SEMANTIC CLAIM. CHECK.1 may report that a named test passed and binds the final state; that establishes the execution of a validation, not the meaning of a goal. An obligation with no bound ClaimAssessment is missing_claim_assessment however suggestive the test name is, and no semantic status is ever derived from CHECK.1 validation facts.

SEMANTIC BASIS SURVIVES AGGREGATION. Directional CLAIM.1 records arrive analyzer_assessed and leave analyzer_assessed; ten satisfied obligations are ten analyzer-assessed obligations. satisfied_by_assessed_evidence means the bounded assessment points toward satisfaction under the supplied orientation, not that the implementation was deterministically proven to satisfy the obligation, and the contract serializes that sentence so no consumer can read it otherwise.

POST-RUN STATE BINDING IS A KNOWN GAP, STATED AS ONE. A ClaimAssessment carries no repository or final-state identity, so nothing proves it describes the state CHECK.1 reconciled unless an explicit final-state receipt says so. Without one the obligation records final_state_binding_unavailable and the assessment is assessed_with_gaps; a binding naming a different final state is refused outright. Nothing infers the binding from a source digest.

NO MAJORITY, NO SCORE, NO REDUCTION. Three satisfied goals do not outvote one violated preservation constraint; both stay independently visible as identity lists rather than quantities. There is no count, tally, percentage, score, confidence or weight in the contract, and the static suite proves the arithmetic that would allow one is absent from the module.

DETERMINISM AND TAMPER BINDING. Canonical SHA-256 identities bind the task contract, the CHECK.1 reconciliation, the requirement ledger, the verification specification, every obligation, every proposition binding and every ClaimAssessment, and all of them are re-derived rather than trusted. A specification prepared for another task or another execution, an edited claim, a drifted proposition digest or a duplicated claim is inconsistent_input. Unordered input canonicalises, explicit obligation ordinals are preserved, and time, randomness and machine state are absent.

CHECK.2 IS NOT CHECK.3. Every assessment, including one where every required obligation is satisfied, leaves run_verdict_required and human_review_required outstanding and cannot be constructed without them. final_success, run verdict, merge, implementation-correctness and objective-truth authority are false in every outcome; only semantic_goal_review_authority can be true, and only for an assessable coherent request. Combining contractual and semantic state into an acceptance verdict is a future CHECK.3 / RUN.VERDICT.1.

UPSTREAM PRODUCERS ARE MISSING AND DOCUMENTED. Nothing in the project currently emits a typed goal requirement ledger, projects an explicit requirement into a Proposition, mints an obligation-to-proposition polarity, produces post-run ClaimAssessment records, or binds an evidence set to an exact post-run state. CHECK.2 requires all of them as supplied input rather than solving any of them opportunistically. Tests and fixtures are its only callers.

NO LIVE WIRING. No Commander, Instant Run, Project Evolution, Workbench, Mixed Mode, executor, validation runner, patch path, merge path or response generation imports or calls CHECK.2, and CHECK.1, CLAIM.1, EVIDENCE.1-2 and ACQUIRE.1-3 behaviour is unchanged by this slice. The boundary suites of both upstream phases were widened by exactly one permitted report-only contract consumer, each guarded by a narrower assertion that CHECK.2 re-runs nothing.
phases.summary: Pure, deterministic, report-only reconciliation of one execution's explicit goal and preservation obligations against the frozen CLAIM.1 assessments already made over their bound propositions, gated by the CHECK.1 objective reconciliation it consumes. It answers 'for every explicit obligation, what does the already-assessed semantic evidence say about whether the final execution satisfied it?' and never 'should this run be accepted?'. The eleven-value obligation vocabulary is satisfied_by_assessed_evidence, violated_by_assessed_evidence, conflicting_evidence, insufficient_evidence, coverage_incomplete, current_state_unestablished, current_state_inconsistent, missing_claim_assessment, binding_invalid, composite_obligation_unsupported and blocked_by_reconciliation, and the top-level status vocabulary is assessed, assessed_with_gaps, diagnostic_only, blocked and inconsistent_input - there is no success, failure, correct, incorrect, run_success, merge_ready, confidence, probability, score or count anywhere in the contract. A blocked CHECK.1 execution cannot be rescued by any amount of supporting semantic evidence; an incomplete or suspicious one caps the review at diagnostics; every obligation must trace to an authoritative explicit source and none may be dropped; each obligation reaches its semantics only through an explicit proposition binding whose satisfaction polarity and polarity provenance were supplied upstream; unresolved CLAIM.1 states survive identically under either polarity; and the analyzer-assessed semantic basis is preserved however many obligations agree. It reads no source byte, diff, test or repository, acquires no evidence, re-runs neither CHECK.1 nor CLAIM.1, executes no validation, calls no model, touches no network, applies no patch, writes nothing, resolves no conflict, repairs no worker, produces no run verdict, and is not wired into any live product path.
phases.title: Post-Run Goal-Fidelity Verification Contract

notes: SHADOW ONLY, AND THAT IS THE POINT. The existing authoritative run result is unchanged for success, validation failure, application failure, early error and no-op runs; with the flag off the result dict is byte identical to before this phase, and with it on the only difference is four additive non-authoritative metadata keys and one additive artifact. A CHECK.1 status of blocked beside an authoritative success is recorded and surfaced rather than reconciled away, because measuring that disagreement across real runs is the entire purpose of shipping the checker in shadow before promoting it.

ONE RECONCILIATION POLICY. The live wiring contains no reconciliation rule of its own. Producers produce; the frozen CHECK.1 decides. The boundary suite proves that reconcile_post_run is called from exactly one module, that a shadow reconciliation status can only be copied from the CHECK.1 result attribute or be null, and that no CHECK.1 status vocabulary is redefined locally.

AUTHORITY IS TRANSLATED, NEVER WIDENED. The execution authorization is derived from the same core.patch_safety verdict the apply path already computed against the real project root, then re-checked through the frozen CHECK.1 observation adapter, which demotes anything the gate blocks to forbidden carrying the gate's own category. A request to raise a path above the authority upstream recorded, to relabel read authority as execute authority, or to name a path upstream never authorized, fails closed with an error rather than being emitted. No path expansion receipt is ever minted.

NO PROSE IS PARSED. The typed worker report is built from the typed patch-plan operations, the typed apply outcome booleans and the typed validation result. There is no regular-expression import, no completion-note read, no diff parse and no model call anywhere in the producers, and the boundary suite asserts all of it. Facts that exist only as prose today are recorded as typed_worker_fact_unavailable and left unrepresented; existing completion output is untouched.

NO NEW REPOSITORY TRAVERSAL. The bounded observer imports neither os nor glob, so it structurally cannot enumerate a directory; it digests only paths the patch plan already named plus the paths the existing validation side-effect collector already reported. An instrumented live run performs exactly the two repository walks the apply path already performed for its own side-effect snapshots - the shadow adds zero - and the only additional enumeration is the artifact store listing its own replay bundle when the additive receipt is written.

STATE IDENTITY IS THE OBSERVED CHANGE SET. Freshness is bound to a canonical fingerprint over the repository id, the pre-execution content identity of the observed path set, and the observed change set - never a timestamp, run id, UUID or whole-repository hash. An empty observed change set therefore fingerprints identically to the pre-execution state, so a genuine no-op does not break CHECK.1's state chain, and any change to a path, kind or digest moves the identity.

STALE VALIDATION IS DETECTED THROUGH THE LIVE PATH. The receipt binds the state the validation actually validated, reconstructed as the final observed change set minus whatever the authoritative side-effect collector attributes to the validation window. A validation that mutates the worktree it just validated therefore produces a receipt whose state is not the final state, and CHECK.1 calls it stale - derived from a real run, not from hand-built fixtures.

A FAILED VALIDATION STILL PRODUCES A RECEIPT. Receipts are not reserved for passing checks: executed-and-failed becomes result failed, a crashed runner becomes errored, a refused unsafe command becomes skipped, and a validation that never ran produces no receipt at all so that CHECK.1 sees missing rather than a fabricated false result. The four states stay distinct.

KNOWN EMPTY IS NOT MISSING. A successful no-op run reports an empty observed change set with a complete observation, while a run that ended before the post-run boundary reports no reconciliation at all with observed_change_identity_missing. No empty successful reconciliation is ever fabricated for a run CHECK.1 was never given facts about.

FAILURE IS ISOLATED AND BOUNDED. A producer or checker failure is caught at the live boundary and recorded as one of six bounded categories with no traceback, command text, environment value or secret serialized into the run artifact. The original application, validation or worker failure remains the authoritative result; a shadow error can never hide or replace it, and never produces a fake reconciled status.

NO REPOSITORY SOURCE WRITE. writes_real_repo stays false because the phase writes no source file: its single write is one additive JSON artifact inside the .agent replay bundle the run already created, which is the same artifact-store convention every other observation phase uses. It cannot create, edit, delete or restore a repository file, and it never stages, resets, cleans or stashes.

THE EXISTING ARTIFACT STORE IS REUSED. No second run-history database is created. The receipt is one additive JSON artifact inside the replay bundle the run already produced, bound to that run's replay id and repository identity, with the frozen CHECK.1 result carried as its bounded, identity-only body. Bundles written before this phase remain loadable and report reconciliation unavailable rather than failing.

WHAT IS WIRED, AND WHAT IS NOT. CHECK.LIVE.1 covers the multi-file patch-plan apply path shared by the web app, the patch routes, the pipeline auto-patch, worker-run import, the sleeping consultant and the proposal queue. The single-file executor and self-correct loop are deliberately not wired: their apply engine exposes replaced snippets rather than before and after file identity, and core/executor.py stays frozen. Dry-run and preview paths never reach the boundary and are not observed.

CHECK.2 IS NOT INVOKED AND CHECK.3 IS NOT BUILT. Production still has no typed goal ledger, no goal-to-proposition projection, no supplied polarity, no post-run claim assessment and no semantic final-state binding, so none of them are manufactured here. The receipt reports which CHECK.2 inputs already exist - execution run identity and final-state identity - and which do not, and the boundary suite asserts CHECK.2 is unreachable from the live wiring. Promoting a proven checker into authoritative acceptance gating remains a future CHECK.GATE.1.

DEFAULT OFF, ENABLED FOR DOGFOOD. POST_RUN_RECONCILIATION_SHADOW defaults to disabled because a new checker with no measured false-positive rate must not change production behaviour, even additively. Enabled, it adds observation only: zero extra validation executions, zero extra patch applications, zero extra model calls and zero extra repository traversals, all asserted by instrumented baseline-versus-shadow regressions.
phases.summary: Default-off, shadow-only wiring of the frozen CHECK.1 post-run reconciliation into the real patch-plan apply path. Bounded producers turn facts the live execution already holds - the apply-time patch-safety verdict, the typed patch-plan operations, the typed apply outcome, the one validation result, and content digests of the paths the plan itself named - into a typed ExecutionAuthorization, WorkerReport, ValidationExpectation, ValidationReceipt and ObservedPostRunFacts, invoke the frozen CHECK.1 public API once at the true post-mutation boundary, and persist a bounded ShadowPostRunCheckReceipt into the run's existing replay bundle. The authoritative run outcome is byte-identical with the flag off and semantically identical with it on: the shadow status is recorded beside the run result, never in place of it, and a checker or producer failure is isolated into a bounded category rather than displacing an application, validation or worker failure. It adds no repository traversal, no validation execution, no patch application, no model call and no network call; it parses no prose to manufacture a typed fact; it cannot widen upstream write authority; it reimplements no reconciliation rule; and it neither invokes CHECK.2 nor promotes CHECK.1 to enforcement.
phases.title: Shadow Post-Run Reconciliation Wiring

notes: INDEPENDENT DECLARATION SEAM, NOT A FABRICATED PRODUCER. The repository has no structured production channel for what the patch-drafting worker believes it changed. CHECK.LIVE.1B therefore defines and wires a real typed seam but does not parse free text, change the model prompt-response contract or pretend the current plan is independent worker output. Existing production callers supply no declaration and are measured honestly as legacy_plan_derived until a future worker-protocol phase populates the seam.

STRUCTURAL INDEPENDENCE IS ENFORCED. core/live_worker_declaration.py imports no execution-authorization producer, live observation type, shadow orchestrator or patching module and references no executable plan, ExecutionAuthorization or ObservedPostRunFacts value. It accepts only already-structured declaration data and cannot derive a missing path, kind, status, validation action or identity digest from another live input.

STRICT, BOUNDED AND AUTHORITY-FREE. Declaration identifiers, paths, status, stage, change claims, validation actions, limitations and unresolved items reuse CHECK.1 bounds and repository path policy. Unknown keys and authority-claiming keys are rejected, duplicate paths fail, rename claims require a distinct original path, and the declaration grants no write, patch, validation or observed-fact authority. Its sole authority is worker self-report evidence.

UNKNOWN KIND STAYS UNKNOWN. change_kind_unavailable is an explicit sentinel, never a guess. Such a claim does not become a CHECK.1 DeclaredChange; its path enters the existing typed_worker_fact_unavailable channel, and no expected change-identity digest is manufactured from observation.

ONE SOURCE SELECTION, LEGACY PRESERVED. A valid WorkerChangeDeclaration supplies the CHECK.1 WorkerReport fields. None preserves CHECK.LIVE.1 behaviour exactly. An invalid mapping falls back to the same legacy path so the authoritative run completes normally, while worker_declaration_invalid=true makes the failed attempt visible rather than silently treating it as agreement.

DOGFOOD TELEMETRY RECORDS THE LIMITATION. ShadowPostRunCheckReceipt records worker_declaration_source as independent_worker_declaration, legacy_plan_derived or unavailable, plus worker_declaration_invalid and the computed independent_worker_declaration_missing flag. The offline summary tallies sources and invalid runs. These fields stay out of the authoritative result metadata and reuse the existing shadow receipt artifact.

LIVE REGRESSIONS PROVE REAL DISAGREEMENT. Real run_patch_plan_with_artifacts tests cover independent omission, overclaim and exact agreement. A forbidden changed path remains blocked even when honestly declared. Because the current apply op vocabulary cannot produce delete or rename operations, kind mismatch is exercised at the shadow boundary with the real unmodified digest-based observation producer reporting a deletion.

NO COST OR POWER EXPANSION. The optional lifecycle argument defaults to None. The phase adds zero model calls, validation executions, repository traversals and patch applications; changes no application order; leaves the shadow flag default off; changes no CHECK.1 or CHECK.2 contract; invokes no CHECK.2 or CHECK.3 path; and never affects the authoritative run outcome.

KNOWN LIMITATIONS REMAIN EXPLICIT. No production caller constructs a WorkerChangeDeclaration yet; declaration-provided expected change identity remains unavailable by design; mapping input is validated once with no repair loop; and kind mismatch is not reachable through the current full apply executor round-trip. A future worker-protocol phase may populate this seam without changing CHECK.LIVE.1B's reconciliation wiring.
phases.summary: Shadow-only extension of CHECK.LIVE.1 that introduces a strict, bounded WorkerChangeDeclaration contract and an optional live wiring seam so CHECK.1 can compare an independently supplied typed worker self-report against objectively observed post-run facts. A valid declaration supplies the worker status, changed paths and kinds, validation claims, limitations and unresolved items without consulting the executable patch plan, execution authorization, observed facts, prose, diffs or model output. Missing declarations preserve the existing plan-derived report exactly; malformed structured declarations fail closed to that legacy path and are explicitly measured as invalid. Receipts and offline summaries record independent_worker_declaration, legacy_plan_derived or unavailable without widening authoritative result metadata, changing the default-off feature flag, adding a production producer, running a model, executing another validation, traversing the repository or changing patch application.
phases.title: Independent Typed Worker Declaration Wiring

notes: ONE PROPOSITION, ONE ASSESSED SET, NO TRUTH. CLAIM.1 consumes one Proposition and one EvidenceSetAssessment and emits a ClaimAssessment carrying a categorical assessment_status, the semantic basis it rests on, conflict status, four coverage statuses, a corroboration status, directional and non-directional record fingerprint references, bounded gaps and bounded reason codes. It has no claim_true, claim_false, proposition_true, ground_truth, deterministic_truth, semantically_verified, verdict, conclusion, recommendation, final_answer, confidence, probability or score field, and a serialization regression walks every key and every value to prove none exists, that no value is a float, and that no value is a truth token. SYNTHESIS.1 owns combining several proposition assessments into a task answer and is not implemented or authorized here.

SUPPORTED IS NOT PROVEN. assessment_status=supported_by_assessed_evidence means the currently admitted, analyzer-assessed evidence set supports P. It does not mean P is objectively true, and the record says so structurally: semantic_basis is analyzer_assessed, assessment_basis is gated_analyzer_assessments, final_claim_authority and objective_truth_asserted are read-only properties returning false, and serialization carries semantic_relations_proved_deterministically=false alongside the positive status.

ANTI-TRUTH-LAUNDERING IS STRUCTURAL. SEMANTIC_BASES holds exactly two values and deterministically_verified is not one of them, so a ClaimAssessment asserting deterministic semantics does not construct; an assessed claim that does not state analyzer_assessed does not construct either. Twenty agreeing support records produce one analyzer-assessed supported status, and a regression asserts the rendered page contains no deterministically_proven_semantics, semantically_verified, proposition_true, deterministic_truth, claim_true or claim_false token anywhere.

CONFLICT IS TERMINAL AND HAS NO WINNER. conflict_status=conflicting produces conflicting_evidence and stops. Five supports and one contradiction is conflicting; the set ceiling minus one support and one contradiction is still conflicting; validation evidence against validation evidence is conflicting. There is no counting of supports against contradictions, no role rank, no source rank, no analyzer rank, no recency rule and no implementation-beats-tests tiebreak, and conflict_adjudication_unavailable is recorded as a gap for a human adjudication phase that does not exist.

NO MAJORITY, PROVED STATICALLY. No class field and no callable in the module carries majority, vote, winner, winning, outweigh, outrank, tally, average, strength or score in its name; there is no sum, max, min, Counter or most_common call; there is no arithmetic operator anywhere in the source; and no comparison has a length on both sides, so the shape that would let one count beat another is absent rather than merely unused. The corroboration test uses tuple slicing rather than counting for exactly this reason.

DUPLICATES DO NOT STRENGTHEN, AND A DIFFERENT DIGEST IS NOT INDEPENDENCE. One support plus five byte-identical copies yields the same assessment_status as the one real lineage, with corroboration_status=duplicate_only and the reason code CLAIM_DUPLICATE_LINEAGE_DOES_NOT_STRENGTHEN. Non-duplicate lineages are independence_unknown, which is recorded as independent_corroboration_unestablished and blocks nothing; independently_corroborated is reachable only where EVIDENCE.2 holds a supplied distinct-origin declaration, and nothing in the pipeline mints one. Independent corroboration is required only where a supplied ClaimRequirements explicitly demands it.

ABSENCE STILL NEEDS COVERAGE. A negative_existential proposition reaches supported_by_assessed_evidence only through negative_claim_coverage=complete; incomplete or inconsistent coverage is coverage_incomplete even with support records present, and no number of absence documents substitutes for the receipt. One concrete counterexample contradicts an absence with no coverage at all, because acknowledging a counterexample and proving an absence are different questions. Coverage-backed support plus a counterexample is conflicting_evidence, with neither side chosen.

CODE EXISTING IS NOT CODE RUNNING. A runtime_behaviour proposition reaches support only through current_state_coverage=complete; incomplete is current_state_unestablished and disagreeing receipts are current_state_inconsistent, a narrowly distinct bounded state rather than a silent fold into either inconsistent_input or unestablished. A contradiction already gated by EVIDENCE.1 - which requires a current-state receipt in both directions - is retained without demanding set-wide coverage, honoring the frozen upstream rule exactly rather than weakening or re-deriving it.

ROLE PRESENCE IS NOT DIRECTIONAL SUPPORT, AND ROLES ARE NEVER INVENTED. EVIDENCE.2 kept present and directional_present apart and CLAIM.1 does not merge them: a verified implementation_authority record whose relation is insufficient discharges required-role coverage and no support, and a role-covered set with no directional evidence is insufficient_evidence. Incomplete supplied role coverage makes a support-only set insufficient_evidence; role_coverage_status=not_applicable passes the gate and is recorded as role_requirements_not_supplied rather than read as complete.

RELATIONS ARE READ, NEVER REGRADED, AND THE PROPOSITION IS PRESERVED EXACTLY. No span is re-read, no test is promoted because several tests agree, no dependency declaration becomes runtime use, and ten historical documents stay insufficient. proposition_id, proposition_sha256, proposition_text, proposition_type and proposition_scope are copied through unchanged; a reworded, narrowed, broadened or requalified claim hashes differently and is refused as proposition_binding_mismatch rather than assessed against evidence gathered for another claim.

THE ENTRY GATE FAILS CLOSED AND REPAIRS NOTHING. inconsistent_input is produced for a set that refused itself, a proposition binding mismatch, a mismatched expected set fingerprint, an invalid or repeated member fingerprint, a relation summary that disagrees with the members it summarises, a member that does not match its own lineage group, an upgraded semantic status, an upstream already asserting claim-decision authority or admitting it interpreted anything, and a requirement binding naming another proposition or roles the set never assessed. A refused claim carries no coverage reading, no corroboration state, no record references and no claim_assessment_authority.

AUTHORITY IS NARROW AND FINAL CLAIM AUTHORITY IS A PROPERTY. claim_assessment_authority is the single narrow authority and is true only for a usable set. final_claim_authority, objective_truth_asserted and response_synthesis_performed are read-only properties returning false, absent from dataclasses.fields, so no construction path can set them - including for the outcome a reader would most like to treat as an answer: support-only, coverage complete, roles complete, no contradiction. Acquisition, verification, promotion, conflict adjudication, repository read, traversal, external search, web fetch, selection, indexing, graph, validation execution, command execution, worker launch, repository write, patch, planning, routing, model selection, provider selection, project evolution and response synthesis authorities are all false, and human_approval_required stays true.

NO SOURCE BYTES, NO PATHS, NO SPANS, NO MODEL. The ClaimAssessment references evidence only by record and lineage-group fingerprint; a regression asserts no source identifier and no source content digest from the set appears anywhere in the rendered page. AcquiredSourcePayload, BoundedPayloadView, EvidenceVerificationResult and StaticEvidenceAnalyzer do not appear in the source. Importing the promotion gate would transitively import an analyzer, so the gate, analyzer and model adapter are unreachable by import and verify_acquired_source, verify_with_bounded_repair, adjudicate, analyze and assess_evidence_set are unreachable by call. Static regressions forbid os, pathlib, glob, socket, subprocess, time, random, uuid, database, index, graph, selector, validation and model stacks, and prove import-time inertness.

DETERMINISM AND FINGERPRINT BINDING. The same EvidenceSetAssessment yields a byte-identical ClaimAssessment: member order in the upstream set does not reach the claim, there is no clock, no counter, no random token and no filesystem or machine state. assessment_fingerprint binds the preserved proposition, the EVIDENCE.2 assessment fingerprint, the EVIDENCE.2 request fingerprint, the claim request fingerprint, the status, the basis, every coverage reading and every ordered reference. An optional expected_evidence_set_fingerprint gives a caller its own tamper binding, and a mismatch is fatal.

UPSTREAM REGRESSIONS AMENDED, NOT WEAKENED. EVIDENCE.1 and EVIDENCE.2 each asserted that no production path imports them. CLAIM.1 imports both frozen contract modules by design, so each live-wiring regression now treats core/claim_assessment.py as a downstream contract consumer and adds a narrower assertion in its place: it binds to the contract module, never imports the gate, analyzer, adapter or acquisition payload contract, and never calls the gate or aggregator entry points. Every other production path is still asserted to import and call nothing. EVIDENCE.1 and EVIDENCE.2 are closed and frozen and appear in this phase's forbidden_files.

DEEPSEEK DOGFOOD CLAIM REGRESSION. The original failure class is reproduced at claim level across four sets for the claim that the harness has no session persistence: unrelated and insufficient sources are insufficient_evidence with absent coverage; four byte-identical absence documents are one lineage and still insufficient_evidence; one concrete SQLite implementation is contradicted_by_assessed_evidence with no absence coverage required; and hypothetical valid absence coverage plus the SQLite counterexample is conflicting_evidence with no winner. The duplicated documents never outvote the counterexample, and no final claim, confidence or truth value is emitted in any of the four.

REGISTRY CAPABILITY LIMITATION. ROAD.1 schema v1 has no field for a phase that is deterministic and report-only over one upstream assessment rather than over a repository. model_calls_allowed=false and network_allowed=false are exact for everything in this phase and its whole test suite, writes_real_repo=false records that no repository content is modified, and ROAD.1 registry validation and ROAD.2 phase picking execute nothing.

RECOMMENDED NEXT PHASE. SYNTHESIS.1 should consume several bounded ClaimAssessment records through their public contract, refuse any that is inconsistent_input, present conflicting and coverage-blocked propositions as unresolved rather than resolving them, preserve each claim's analyzer-assessed semantic basis and its recorded gaps into whatever it renders, keep the answer bounded by the propositions actually assessed rather than inferring new ones, and still emit no confidence and no objective truth. It is not implemented or authorized here.
phases.summary: First claim-track phase and the first one permitted to say anything about a proposition: a pure, deterministic layer that consumes one supplied Proposition together with the single EVIDENCE.2 EvidenceSetAssessment made over it, and states what categorical epistemic status that assessed evidence justifies. It answers 'given this already-assessed evidence set, what status is justified for this proposition?' and never 'what is ultimately true?'. The eight-value vocabulary is supported_by_assessed_evidence, contradicted_by_assessed_evidence, conflicting_evidence, insufficient_evidence, coverage_incomplete, current_state_unestablished, current_state_inconsistent and inconsistent_input - there is no true, false, likely_true, probably_false, confidence_high, ground_truth, probability, score or float anywhere in the contract. A conflicting set is terminal and produces conflicting_evidence with no winner at any scale; a support-only set passes absence coverage, currentness, required-role coverage, scope competence and any explicitly demanded independent corroboration before it reads as support; no directional evidence is insufficient_evidence and never contradiction. It re-derives the relation partition from the set's own members rather than trusting the summary, re-binds the supplied proposition by digest, checks the upstream's own authority and guardrail declaration, and refuses whole any set that refused itself, drifted in wording, disagrees with its own lineage grouping, upgraded a semantic status or arrived already asserting claim-decision authority. Semantic relations arrive analyzer-assessed and leave analyzer-assessed - aggregation cannot upgrade epistemic level, and SEMANTIC_BASES has no deterministically_verified value to write. It reads no source bytes, copies no excerpt, path or span into the result, imports neither the acquisition payload contract nor the EVIDENCE.1 analyzer, gate or adapter, never re-runs the EVIDENCE.2 aggregator, calls no model, touches no network, acquires nothing, executes nothing, synthesizes no response, emits no final claim, and is not wired into any live product path.

notes: Report-only Commander Run Contract, shipped 2026-06-22. Classifies a task into instant_run, commander_run, needs_clarification, or reject_or_defer and previews gates, stop conditions, evidence, budget, validation, and rollback expectations. Does not execute Commander Mode, run agents, call models, apply patches, run validation, run benchmarks, contact network services, launch workers, write to a database, push, merge, or open PRs.

notes: INTENT AND TARGETS. WorkbenchState snapshots the Main Intent text into a fresh Generate ticket (no eligible run) exactly as typed, and gives continuation tickets no task; the handlers append it as the query field only for fresh tickets, so same-repository continuation bodies stay byte-identical. The backend passes the raw text to safe_route_live_task: requested_targets are the Task Contract's explicit_evidence.file_paths in commitment order. No named file is bootstrap_discovery_required; a commitment set the Task Contract truncated is a budget escalation; a failed preservation gate is bootstrap_target_unresolved. A fresh request without the task field keeps CONTROL.FRESH.1's fresh_control_required answer unchanged.

GROUNDING AND READS. Each literal path is checked by the repository path policy, one lstat and one resolve (only the filesystem's own case folding may differ; links and aliases are refused) and the root ignore policy, then read through CTX.READ.1 over an exact-entry, zero-traversal RepositoryInventory with its established bounds (8 files, 1 MiB total, 256 KiB and 4,000 lines per file). Any unresolved, unsupported, over-budget or changed target fails closed with a typed status before a model call; nothing is truncated and files are never partially reviewed. Unrelated files need no import, call or graph relation.

AUTHOR AND VALIDATION. At most one provider call per fresh request, through the route's existing run_gemini_request with the provider's JSON transport; no retry. The raw reply passes the same web/control_context.py validator continuation uses (malformed JSON, wrong top-level type, missing required fields, invalid field types), then a closed admission contract: the author may write only hypotheses (each naming a requested file) and evidence_gaps (a closed semantic need vocabulary). Owner material (query, repo_path, live_route, exact related_snippets, target_scope) is composed by the owner and re-validated. Command text is never transported; provenance fresh_bootstrap and the source digests, freshness and CONTROL fingerprint live in the control_bootstrap receipt, not in CONTROL.

FROZEN. web/control_context.py is byte-identical; control=null stays the canonical fresh form and malformed CONTROL is rejected exactly as before. UX.STATE.1, UX.CONTEXT.1, Track A, SEC.UI.1, DATA.UNDO.1, EXEC.PLAN.1, AUTH.DREAM.1, DATA.ROLLBACK.1, AUTH.WEB.1, AUTH.WEB.READ.1 and execution or human Apply authority are unchanged. Repository discovery, graph bootstrap, indexing, embeddings, compiler/test/linter preflight (PREFLIGHT.REQUEST.1), UX-05, UX-06 and T6 Round 11 remain out of scope.

REGISTRY NAMING. It is the fourth phase to declare model_calls_allowed, for one production bootstrap authoring opportunity per fresh request, and pays the registry's price: strong_model_requires_approval and human_approval_required. Deterministic tests use stub authors and make zero live provider and external network calls.

notes: Production failure and old path. score_control_node combined callers, callees, impact, graph risk, query overlap, graph weight and depth; infer_hypotheses added caller-query and trace bonuses, normalized score/25 into confidence capped at 0.95, and recommend_action emitted auto_patch_candidate_allowed at 0.75 for a low-risk node. pipeline.maybe_run_auto_patch then averaged this localization value with the model writer's separate patch confidence, treated the top/Scout file as low risk and sent the derived value to build_patch_policy, which thresholded control_confidence into auto_apply_allowed.

Localization representation. score remains as the raw historical ordering field and localization_score is its explicit name. localization_strength_value plus weak/moderate/strong are display-only. Every result declares relative navigation heuristic; non-probabilistic and non-authoritative. Lexical overlap, graph centrality/risk, callers, callees, impact, depth and execution/state trace proximity are navigation evidence even when they are non-lexical.

Compatibility. confidence remains only as a deprecated localization-rank alias carrying confidence_kind=localization_rank_legacy and legacy_control_confidence_deprecated=true. Unsafe historical recommended_action is retained as legacy_recommended_action while the live projection becomes inspect_candidate/needs_grounding. Stored artifacts are not rewritten. No patch or policy consumer reads this value as defect probability.

Grounding. refresh_control_safety reuses OPS.VALIDATE.1 is_executed_failure_evidence. Validation must have run, failed and carry a genuine executed-failure category, then bind through a typed preflight location or the executed output's exact already-ranked candidate path. Inconclusive categories, command presence and passing validation never ground. Exact source must remain a literal substring of the named file before handoff is ready.

Rank and grounding are independent. top_hypothesis remains the highest localization candidate; grounded_hypothesis can be lower-ranked and patch_intent then names that grounded source. The C.A.T.T.U.S self-bug regression deliberately leaves tests/test_index_completion.py::write_text first, while preventing it from becoming executable. The inverse regression lets lower-ranked calc.py::add proceed when genuine failure evidence binds it.

Authority. CONTROL's patch_candidate_state always records patch_eligibility_granted=false, auto_patch_candidate_allowed=false, write_authority=false and patch_application_authority=false. grounded_defect_candidate means only that exact candidate facts may be handed to existing quote grounding, patch safety, patch policy, Executor/patch-plan lifecycle, CTX.PATCH/CTX.APPLY and any human approval. CONTROL mints none of those authorities.

Production boundaries. build_control_prompt forces localization-only model output to patch_candidate=null/patch_plan=null with escalation. postprocess_gates, direct web generation and sleeping-consultant generation enforce the same payload boundary if a model ignores the prompt. maybe_run_auto_patch requires grounded handoff, never reads recommended_action, never combines localization with writer confidence, and build_patch_policy ignores its retained control_confidence compatibility argument.

Model confidence distinction. The model patch response's top-level confidence remains the writer's self-assessment. It participates in existing writer thresholds only after independent grounding. It is not CONTROL localization confidence and cannot compensate for missing defect evidence. Validation command existence likewise cannot compensate.

Test files. There is no blanket test-file prohibition and no requirement that the user name one. A genuine failure can ground a test target, after which ordinary editability, patch safety and authority gates still decide what may happen.

Regression proof. Synthetic high-centrality and high-lexical candidates retain rank but lack defect/patch authority; the two field failures, false-positive no-patch, validation pass/inconclusive cases, high-rank AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED=false, recommended-action, escalation, historical artifact and AST anti-laundering boundaries are pinned. A deterministic calc.py integration runs a real failing assertion, actual CONTROL builder/serialization, exact-source and postprocess gates, Executor apply and real passing validation with no model fixture call.

Deltas and frozen systems. Zero added model calls, network calls or repository traversals. Entry-node selection, ranking weights, traversal depth, project map, retrieval, indexing, OPS.VALIDATE.1 detection/classification, OPS.PATCH.1 write/rollback mechanics, CTX.PATCH, CTX.APPLY, patch safety, CHECK.LIVE and WORKER.DECL lifecycle contracts were not weakened or redesigned. WAITER.LIVE.1 and WORKER.DECL.2B were not implemented.

Known limitation and next phase. Until WAITER.LIVE.1 provides a separately typed change-request route, a feature/refactor request that reaches CONTROL with no genuine executed failure remains inspectable but cannot auto-apply through this path. This phase deliberately does not recreate semantic task classification in CONTROL. The production path is ready for WAITER.LIVE.1 because accidental routing is now harmless rather than authoritative.

The model writer's patch confidence remains separate, AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED and CTX.PATCH/CTX.APPLY remain monotonic, and the legitimate calc.py failing-assertion path still reaches patch safety, apply and passing validation. No retrieval/indexing redesign, model call, network call or traversal was added, and this is not report-only.

notes: ONE CALL, AND THE COUNTER IS STRUCTURAL. MAX_REVISION_CALLS_PER_RUN is 1 and there is no configuration knob for it. The counter lives on AgentState.candidate_revision, which is the receipt itself, so re-entering the read-only branch re-reads a spent budget and refuses with revision_budget_already_consumed. CandidateRevisionReceipt.__post_init__ raises on attempt_count > 1, on attempted with attempt_count != 1 and on unattempted with a non-zero count, so a receipt claiming two calls cannot be constructed at all.

THE TRIGGER IS EVIDENCE, NOT FAILURE. Only a rejection that carries deterministic behavioral counterevidence is eligible. A verifier that was inconclusive, unavailable, stale or invalid establishes nothing to answer and is refused as candidate_verification_did_not_reject; a rejection whose only reasons are about form, freshness or evidence availability is refused as no_deterministic_behavioral_counterevidence. Model confidence is not an input in either direction: two payloads differing only in confidence produce byte-identical evidence, which a test pins.

CHEAP REJECTIONS STAY CHEAP. An exact no-op costs zero probes, zero sandboxes and zero provider calls, exactly as PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.1 made it. The same is true of a safe_minimal rejection, a sandbox apply failure, a stale fingerprint and a malformed candidate. All five are recorded as not_eligible with a named reason rather than left silent, so a reader can see the trigger was evaluated and declined.

NO IMPLEMENTATION HINTS, PROVED STRUCTURALLY. There is no code path that can compose advice because there is no advice written down: every fixed sentence the request can contain is a module constant listed in PROMPT_TEMPLATE_CONSTANTS, and the test reads that tuple and asserts none of them contains gcd, lstrip, strip, width, unit, divisor, modulo, leading space, count the, local variable, branch order, reorder, measure, loop over or helper function. A second test subtracts the template constants, the user's own task, the target, the original source, the rejected bytes and every measured case field from the rendered prompt and asserts the residue is only punctuation and field labels.

PROVENANCE CANNOT BE LAUNDERED. RevisionCounterexample refuses to construct a non-primary case carrying explicit_user_fact provenance, the same rule BehavioralMatrixCase enforces upstream. A matrix case that arrives mislabelled is discarded rather than relabelled, which can only make the evidence smaller.

CANDIDATE1 IS BASED ON THE ORIGINAL, NEVER ON CANDIDATE0. rebase_onto_original_source performs exactly one substitution into the authoritative original bytes, so a full-function revision is accepted as-is and a body fragment is grafted into the original. A revision whose target_snippet exists only in Candidate0's bytes is not found in the original and is refused as revision_candidate_is_not_based_on_the_original_source - the mechanism that stops compounding edits.

ZERO RECEIPT REUSE. Before Candidate1 is measured, _drop_candidate_bound_receipts removes all seven candidate-bound key groups - validation, targeted validation, defect probe, execution eligibility, verification, mutation effect and novelty - plus patch_safety, approval_ready, human_review_eligible, candidate_review_ready, needs_escalation and Candidate0's verification issues. A test asserts every candidate-bound fingerprint on the finished payload names Candidate1.

CANDIDATE1 EARNS EVERYTHING AGAIN. It gets normalization, a fresh fingerprint, PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.1, PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.2, a fresh sandbox, the whole four-case LIVE.4 matrix, OPS.VALIDATE.3 and a fresh CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 reduction. A no-op revision is stopped by the minimality gate and a revision carrying a new import is stopped by safe_minimal, both with no third attempt, which two smokes pin against the live target.

THE PIPELINE CHANGE IS CONTAINED, AND THE CONTAINMENT IS REVERSIBLE. core/pipeline.py went from 35 to 42 top-level definitions: seven added (_run_read_only_candidate_lifecycle, _maybe_revise_rejected_candidate, _call_revision_provider, _record_candidate_revision, _revision_attempts_already_made, _revision_author_configuration, _drop_candidate_bound_receipts), none removed, and exactly one existing definition changed (_verify_authored_candidate_without_mutation, which now delegates its body to the extracted lifecycle). tests/fixtures/patch_author_live1_frozen_boundaries.json stores the six reversal hunks, so a test reconstructs the pre-phase file from the shipped one, asserts its sha256, and derives that def-level comparison rather than asserting it.

THE VALUE OF A FAILED REVISION IS STILL A MEASUREMENT. The deterministic failure control returns a second bad branch trick: Candidate1 reaches fixed_but_regressive, verification rejects it, revision_attempt_count stays 1, no third call is made, needs_escalation is true, execution_authorized is false and core/code_dna.py is byte-identical. That is the phase working, not the phase failing.

AUTHORITY IS UNCHANGED. CandidateRevisionReceipt has no authorization field that can be true: execution_authorized and final_repository_changed are read-only properties returning False and authority_effect is the literal 'none'. The deterministic success smoke ends with candidate_verification_status=verified alongside execution_authorized=false, auto_apply_allowed=false, write_authority=false and the target file unchanged on disk.

REGISTRY NAMING. PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.1 is an implementation slice inside the existing CONTROL track alongside PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.1/.2 and PATCH.BASIS.LIVE.1. PATCH.* remains a phase-id namespace only, adding no track and no schema dimension, so core/phase_registry.py needed no edit. It is the third phase in the seed to declare model_calls_allowed, and it pays the registry's price for that: strong_model_requires_approval and human_approval_required.

KNOWN LIMITATION: THE REBASE RULE IS STRICT. A revision whose target_snippet appears more than once in the original source, or not at all, is refused rather than guessed at. On a live provider that costs the opportunity when the model returns an ambiguous fragment. The alternative - having the harness choose which occurrence was meant - would be the harness authoring part of the patch, which is the boundary this phase exists to hold.

KNOWN LIMITATION: ONE SUBJECT HAS A MATRIX. Counterexamples are only as rich as DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.4's adapters, and indentation_style is still the only production subject with one. A defect whose subject has no matrix reaches no_deterministic_behavioral_counterevidence and is never revised - correctly, since there would be nothing measured to send back.

KNOWN LIMITATION: THE HOOK IS IN THE MUTATION-DISABLED BRANCH ONLY. _maybe_revise_rejected_candidate is reached from _verify_authored_candidate_without_mutation, which maybe_run_auto_patch enters only when AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED is false. config.py defaults that switch to true, so a default-configured run gets no revision at all; the black-box eval harness and every deterministic control here set it false, which is the configuration sections 26, 30, 51 and 52 specify throughout. Putting the hook on the mutation-enabled path as well would let a revised candidate reach an auto-apply path, which is the authority widening this phase forbids, so it is deliberately absent there.
phases.summary: Round 8 authored four wrong candidates for one defect and the harness caught all four: an inverted branch, two exact no-ops, and finally 'elif line.startswith("  ") and not line.startswith("    "):' - byte-changing, structurally minimal, admitted by PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.2 and behaviorally identical to the baseline, because the 4-space elif above it already excluded the condition it added. DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.4 measured that precisely - primary 2space still_reproduced, depth-variant 2space still_reproduced, both 4space cases preserved - and CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 rejected it for primary_defect_not_closed. None of that returned to the author. This phase is that return path and nothing else. A new pure module core/candidate_revision.py reduces receipts the run already holds into one immutable CandidateRevisionEvidence, decides whether the rejection is the kind a second attempt could use, and renders a deterministic request. Eligibility is a conjunction, not a score: defect-repair route, grounded_defect basis, a candidate that exists, candidate_effect mutating, safe_minimal and patch safety accepted, the candidate sandbox applied, the baseline reproduced, an exact and current target binding, matching candidate fingerprints on both the matrix and the verification, a rejected verification carrying a behavioral reason (primary_defect_not_closed, behavior_preservation_regressed or subject_invariant_not_closed), a matrix status in {still_reproduced, partially_fixed, fixed_but_regressive, unresolved_matrix_failure}, and at least one failing case. Exact no-ops, safe_minimal rejections, sandbox apply failures, stale fingerprints, malformed candidates, explicit_change and analysis routes are all named ineligible and spend zero provider calls. The request carries the preserved task verbatim, the exact target, the authoritative original source, Candidate0's bytes labelled REJECTED CANDIDATE - EVIDENCE ONLY, and each measured case as case_id/role/provenance/expected/observed/status. It carries no technique: every fixed sentence lives in PROMPT_TEMPLATE_CONSTANTS and a test asserts none of them names gcd, lstrip, width counting, a local variable or branch order, and that the rendered prompt is nothing but those constants plus the user's own text plus measured facts. Candidate1 is authored against the ORIGINAL bytes - a revision whose target_snippet exists only in Candidate0 is refused as revision_candidate_is_not_based_on_the_original_source - gets a fresh fingerprint, and re-enters PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.1, PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.2, a fresh sandbox, the full four-case LIVE.4 matrix, OPS.VALIDATE.3 and CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 with every one of Candidate0's receipts dropped first. The budget is exactly one call per run, held on the run rather than the payload; a failed, malformed or unavailable revision terminates with needs_escalation=true and no second attempt. No reviewer, critic or debate call is added, no retrieval, traversal, index rebuild or embedding is performed, no validation budget moves, and a verified revision authorizes nothing: under AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED=false the deterministic smoke ends execution_authorized=false, final_repository_changed=false and core/code_dna.py byte-identical. _classify_indent is not fixed.
phases.title: Verification-Guided Single Revision

notes: ONE CONTRACT, PROVED BY CONSTRUCTION RATHER THAN BY ASSERTION. build_control_prompt and the revision path both call control_engine.authoring_contract_for_control_result, which resolves the style from the same patch policy and the source snippet from the same patch_intent and returns one PatchAuthoringContract. The parity test does not compare two hand-maintained copies - there is only one object, and the drift test monkeypatches the shared renderer and asserts the sentinel appears in BOTH prompts, so a path that stopped consuming it fails immediately.

MOVED VERBATIM, NOT RETYPED. The two renderers and the response schema were lifted line-for-line out of core/control_engine.py and core/prompter.py; only the leading underscore of the two function names changed. An A/B over 82 configurations - five styles by feature/defect route by present/absent source by present/absent related context by handoff eligible/not, plus both human-prompt branches - produced byte-identical initial-draft prompts. control_engine keeps _safe_minimal_forbidden_block and _patch_output_format_block as delegating shims, and a test asserts each holds no string literal but its own docstring, so a re-inlined copy cannot reappear unnoticed.

THE PRODUCER GOT A BETTER CONTRACT; THE CONSUMER GOT NOTHING. parse_revised_candidate is untouched. The captured Round-9 response is still revision_output_carried_no_patch_candidate; replacement_snippet, replacement, new_snippet, diff_text and new_code are all still revision_candidate_has_no_patched_snippet; a bare candidate object with no wrapper is still refused; and a test greps core/candidate_revision.py to prove no alias string exists anywhere in it. There is no typo recovery, no auto-wrapping and no post-hoc repair.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE A REJECTION. Wrapped in the correct envelope, the Round-9 implementation substance now parses, earns a fresh candidate fingerprint, and is then rejected by PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.2 as novel_external_reference for its lstrip member, dropping patch_candidate to None with needs_escalation true. lstrip is not specially allowed, safe_minimal is unchanged and the local novelty caps are unchanged. Prompt text is advice to a model; the deterministic gate is the authority, and a test drives exactly this path end to end.

THE FIX BROKE SIX TESTS THAT DEPENDED ON IT BEING BROKEN, AND THAT IS THE PHASE WORKING. An A/B - revert the four changed files, move the new module and suite aside, drop this entry, re-run - attributed six adjacent failures to this phase: 6 passed reverted, 6 failed present. Three suites (test_candidate_verification, test_defect_probe_matrix_live5, test_patch_minimal_live) drive the real maybe_run_auto_patch on a behaviorally rejected T6 candidate without stubbing _call_revision_provider, so PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.1's branch has been making a live Gemini call in them since it shipped. Before LIVE.2 the answer was unusable, revision_output_invalid returned early, and Candidate0's receipts happened to survive for their assertions to read; after LIVE.2 the answer parses, _drop_candidate_bound_receipts runs exactly as LIVE.1 specifies, and the assertions raise KeyError on behavioral_matrix_status. Nothing was weakened: two of the three helpers already claimed 'no provider call' in their own docstrings and that claim was false, so an autouse fixture per file now makes it true by holding the single revision opportunity deterministically unavailable. The measurement stays on Candidate0, three suites stop making live network calls, and the revision path keeps its own coverage in test_candidate_revision_live.py (98) and test_patch_authoring_contract_live2.py (44), which stub the adapter explicitly.

THE CORRECT PATH IS STILL EXPRESSIBLE. The already-established local-only candidate - three bounded local bindings, no novel member, no import, inside the changed-line cap - still parses, is admitted by the novelty rule, passes all five DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.5 cases as fixed_and_preserved, verifies, and ends with execution_authorized false, auto_apply_allowed false, write_authority false and core/code_dna.py byte-identical on disk. The shared contract does not accidentally forbid it.

NO T6 ADVICE, CHECKED AGAINST THE CONTRACT ITSELF. The rendered contract is asserted to contain none of gcd, lstrip, strip, greatest common divisor, indentation unit, leading space, count the, branch order, reorder, divisor, modulo, loop over, minimum indentation or width counting, and neither _classify_indent nor 2space. The only T6-specific material the revision sees is still the user's task, the authoritative source, the rejected candidate and the measured counterexamples. The safe_minimal identifier list is derived from the bounded source the author was already handed, by the existing derivation, with no repository rescan.

TELEMETRY IS THREE FACTS, AND THEY ARE NOT DUPLICATED. authoring_contract_version, authoring_contract_fingerprint and revision_contract_present live inside candidate_revision_receipt only, deliberately not flattened beside it: the receipt is already duplicated into the payload and three more flattened keys would make that worse. No new payload key is added, so ANSWER.GROUND.LIVE.4's ownership boundary is untouched. The contract text itself is never stored in a receipt.

THE FINGERPRINT IS NOT A CANDIDATE FINGERPRINT. It is sha256 over the rendered contract text and answers 'were both authors held to the same contract', which is a question about the request. It is computed by the contract module, has no candidate input, and is never compared against a candidate fingerprint.

RE-PIN AS PROOF. Five earlier fixtures froze core/control_engine.py and DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.5 also froze core/candidate_revision.py and core/pipeline.py. All of them move, each with a pre_live2 digest and a repin note, and tests/fixtures/patch_author_live2_contract_reversal.json stores the hunks that reverse this phase's edits to all four changed files - so a test reconstructs the pre-phase bytes from the shipped ones and asserts the digests the notes replaced. PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.1's pipeline reversal now chains: undo LIVE.2, assert LIVE.1's post_sha256, undo LIVE.1, assert its pre_sha256, which keeps that number a live assertion instead of a stale one. Containment: candidate_revision 0 added / 3 changed, control_engine 1 added / 3 changed, pipeline 0 added / 1 changed, prompter 0 added / 0 changed, nothing removed anywhere.

THE CONCURRENT EDITS WERE A DOCUMENTED REMEDIATION, AND THIS PHASE RE-ANCHORED ON IT. While this phase was being verified, a separate, explicitly requested harness remediation edited core/pipeline.py, core/defect_probe.py, patching/patch_gates.py and core/targeted_repository_validation.py, recording exact reversible hunks in tests/fixtures/2026-09-10-harness-remediation-reversal.json behind a test-only helper, tests/_harness_maintenance.py::before_harness_remediation. Its core/pipeline.py preimage is exactly this phase's post (d135ecda), so the canonical chain is shipped -> remediation undone -> LIVE.2 post -> LIVE.2 undone -> LIVE.1 post (67c83a2e), byte for byte. Mid-phase this fixture had been rebuilt against the remediation's in-flight bytes; once the remediation finalized that was corrected - the pipeline reversal is LIVE.2 post -> LIVE.1 post again, the two in-flight pins are back to the history every other phase pins, and every entry is evaluated after the helper. PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.1's chain asserts every link again, and perturbing one digest turns all three chain tests red. The three frozen-pin tests the remediation left reading raw bytes - DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.4, DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.5 and CONTROL.LOCALIZE.LIVE.2 - now use the same helper: 71 pins, 0 mismatches, and not one historical fixture re-pinned.

AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED=true IS STILL OUT OF SCOPE. PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.1's hook remains in the mutation-disabled branch only, so a default-configured run still gets no revision. Wiring revision into the auto-apply path needs an explicit authority and lifecycle review and is deliberately not started here.

KNOWN LIMITATION: THE PROMPT IS STILL ONLY ADVICE. A stateless model that is shown the exact schema can still return something else, and when it does the run ends with revision_output_invalid and no second attempt - which is what the raw Round-9 response does in a test that also asserts the contract did travel. This phase raises the probability of a usable envelope; it does not guarantee one, and buying a guarantee would mean a repair call the budget forbids.

KNOWN LIMITATION: THE CANDIDATE-LANGUAGE BLOCK IS STYLE-SHAPED. balanced and vibe still get their one-sentence constraints and safe_minimal still gets the identifier list, exactly as the initial author always did. Making the revision stricter than the draft, or looser, would be a new safety rule, and section 9 forbids adding one here.

REGISTRY NAMING. PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.2 is an implementation slice inside the existing CONTROL track alongside PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.1, PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.1/.2 and PATCH.BASIS.LIVE.1. PATCH.* remains a phase-id namespace only, adding no track and no schema dimension, so core/phase_registry.py needed no edit. Unlike PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.1 this phase declares no model call: it changes what an existing call is told, not how many calls there are.
phases.summary: Round 9 spent the one verification-guided revision call, the model materially improved the implementation strategy, and the result was discarded before candidate normalization because its envelope was {target_snippet, replacement_snippet} instead of the production candidate contract. The parser refused it as revision_output_carried_no_patch_candidate, correctly. Comparing the two prompts established the cause: the initial-draft prompt carried patch_candidate, patched_snippet, the operation shapes, the output-only rule and the safe_minimal identifier/FORBIDDEN constraints; the revision prompt carried none of them and said only 'return the normal patch-candidate JSON schema and nothing else'. The provider call is stateless, so that sentence named a protocol the revision author had never been shown. This phase gives both authoring calls one authoritative contract instead of one and a half. The wire shapes, the exact field names, the per-style output rules and the candidate-language constraints move verbatim into core/patch_authoring_contract.py, PATCH_RESPONSE_SCHEMA moves there from core/prompter.py which now re-exports it, and control_engine.authoring_contract_for_control_result renders the one PatchAuthoringContract that build_control_prompt and build_revision_prompt both consume - so a field name cannot be changed in one path without moving in the other. The initial-draft prompt is byte-identical across 82 configurations of style, route, source availability and handoff eligibility; the revision prompt grows by the contract text and its heading and by nothing else. Nothing on the consumer side moved: the captured Round-9 response is still invalid, replacement_snippet/replacement/new_snippet/diff_text/new_code are still refused as revision_candidate_has_no_patched_snippet, a bare candidate object is still not auto-wrapped, and the same substance wrapped correctly now parses and is then rejected by PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.2 as novel_external_reference for its lstrip member. That rejection is the phase working: it fixes schema blindness, not the algorithm. The already-established local-only candidate still parses, is admitted, passes all five DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.5 cases, verifies, and authorizes nothing. One revision call remains the whole budget; there is no repair prompt, no JSON fixer and no second author, and this phase adds no model call, no network call, no retrieval and no repository traversal of its own.
phases.title: Self-Contained Authoring Contract Parity

notes: PROJECTION ONLY: parameters, baseline locals and proven repository-local direct imports are owned by the existing policy evidence. Locals retain initialization/shadowing constraints. Declared immutable result fields are data capabilities, never a field-name allowlist or implementation advice. No module dump, repository scan or candidate-created bindings.

EXACT EXECUTED EVIDENCE: one text argument plus declared language is materialized only when the probe result names that immutable contract. No generator is called by the reducer. Missing/oversize inputs are not invented or truncated. Failed and preserved cases share an eight-case and 16 KiB budget.

CONTRACT VERSION: v1 explicitly identifies contract material; materially changing lexical guidance requires patch_authoring_contract_v2. A separate scope fingerprint identifies the legal lexical environment, never candidate identity. Both calls share that scope for the same current source.

FROZEN HISTORY: reversible hunks reconstruct entry bytes, preserving earlier phase hashes. Earlier prompt-hash tests explicitly project back to the historic contract and evidence format; current tests require concrete inputs.

NO AUTHORITY: the deterministic author stub exists only in tests. The exact six-line candidate is sandbox-only and still requires the real gate, eight-case oracle and candidate verifier. Verified is not authorized. No live Gemini smoke, Round 11, second revision, research or Track B changes.
STOP TRACK A: authoring gaps are closed; UI/security Track B is the next separately scoped work. Round 11 remains deferred until after Track B.
phases.summary: Closes both local authoring-information gaps. CandidateAuthoringContext projects the same pre-candidate AuthoritativeBindingContext and immutable-result proof used by PATCH.MINIMAL into compact shared draft/revision scope. The shared lexical contract advances deliberately to patch_authoring_contract_v2. Matrix results carry exact text only from a contract named by the executed observation; revision evidence binds task, original source, rejected candidate, matrix cases and probe, with eight selected cases and a 16 KiB aggregate concrete-text cap. A test-only stateless adapter replays exact Round-10 Candidate0, requires every information class, emits the already legal six-line Candidate1, and reaches fixed_and_preserved over eight unchanged cases, verified and execution_authorized=false. The target, deterministic policy, oracle, targeted validation, authority, UI/security and provider call count are unchanged.
