notes: Three questions stay separate. patch_basis answers why a change may be considered; target_source_grounded answers where a concrete proposal may operate; existing patch safety, CTX.PATCH/CTX.APPLY, AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED, runtime authorization and human approval answer whether it may write. Neither grounded_defect nor explicit_change_request sets write_authority or patch_application_authority.

Failure relevance is bounded executed evidence, not graph causality. direct_location preserves the existing exact failure-file path. direct_executed_reference reads the exact Python statement at a validation-named caller/test location and resolves its call only against already-localized candidates and ordinary imports. It means failure-relevant, not sole-cause certainty. Ambiguity refuses rather than using rank as a tie-breaker.

Navigation remains navigation. Graph callers/callees, dependency relation, lexical rank, score magnitude and execution-trace proximity are not inputs to core.patch_basis and cannot establish grounded_defect. A high-ranked C.A.T.T.U.S wrong target therefore stays patch_basis=none/unresolved and cannot reach patch safety.

WAITER reuse, no reclassification. explicit_change plus change_need_source=explicit_user_request from the existing receipt produces patch_basis=explicit_change_request. The binder does not inspect prose to rediscover feature intent. The preserved obligations are used only for narrow exact scope retention such as across model/store/CLI.

Target grounding is concrete. Related/source snippets count as acquired only when the quote remains a literal substring of the named file. Every replacement target must be acquired, arbitrary new files require a literally requested path, and an unrelated acquired file still fails a preserved explicit multi-surface scope.

Policy audit. defect_established and defect_grounded remain actual-defect facts. patch_basis_accepted is the any-legitimate-basis policy fact. target_source_grounded remains a source fact. auto_apply_allowed remains a separate automatic-write decision and explicit_change_request never makes it true. Model confidence participates only in the existing writer thresholds after basis/target grounding and cannot create either.

Human authority is unchanged. A safe explicit feature is authored, exact-source grounded and evaluated by the existing patch-safety function, then retained for the existing human approval path with auto_apply_allowed=false. The task request is not an approval token for later scope expansion. Grounded defect auto-application behaves as before where its existing policy conditions allow it.

Regression proof. Real local calc.py/main.py and flat solution.py/test_solution.py failures bind to their implementation candidates, author patches, pass patch safety, apply through the established executor and pass validation. A model/store/CLI feature with a healthy or inconclusive baseline receives explicit_change_request without a defect and stops at a passing non-writing human handoff. A production-plus-test expectation rewrite remains blocked before any write.

Compatibility. Historical defect_grounded artifacts remain readable. Projection to grounded_defect requires retained executed_validation_failure evidence and exact_source_grounded=true; localization confidence or a naked legacy boolean is insufficient. No historical run is rewritten.

Deltas. Zero added model calls, network calls, repository traversals, graph walks, index operations or retrieval changes. OPS.PATCH.1 byte writes/rollback, OPS.VALIDATE.1 detection/outcomes, CONTROL.SAFETY.LIVE.1 rank separation, WAITER.LIVE.1 routing, patch safety, CTX, CHECK.LIVE and WORKER.DECL remain frozen and are regressed. Validation timeout semantics remain OPS.VALIDATE.2 and were not changed.

Known limitation. The new syntactic resolver is intentionally one-hop Python only, covering the field-test caller and pytest failures. Other languages retain direct-location grounding until an existing deterministic resolver can be reused without recursive traversal, graph-causality inference or another parser framework. Retrieval quality remains the next major hard problem.
Registry bookkeeping. PATCH is accepted as an implementation-slice phase-id prefix while the phase track remains CONTROL; no PATCH track was introduced.

The additive structural_definitions reports only parser availability and 1-based line ranges beside the walker's existing kinds, names and byte spans. Because graph/builder.py builds CONTROL's hypotheses from the same extractor, a legitimate target is a tree-sitter symbol by provenance, so not_found is a genuine contradiction rather than a blind spot. FAIL CLOSED. zero definitions is not_found, more than one plausible definition with nothing to disambiguate is ambiguous, and a spelling whose measured diagnostic line is owned by another definition is location_mismatch. All three yield no target. Overloads are disambiguated only when the grounded location structurally owns exactly one definition; overlapping or nested owners stay ambiguous. A location naming a different file is not evidence about this file and is ignored.

NO AUTHORITY, NO FORCED BASIS. Identifier length is now used nowhere as an eligibility criterion. A target symbol is admitted when the repository's existing language-aware extractor (core/treesitter_parse, the same one graph/builder.py builds CONTROL's hypotheses from) structurally resolves exactly one definition of that spelling inside the exact file already grounded, and - when a measured defect location exists for that file - that definition structurally owns the line. Refusal is closed and explicit: zero definitions, more than one plausible definition with nothing to disambiguate, or a diagnostic line owned by another definition all yield no target, and first-match-in-file-order is never used. A short spelling occurring only in a comment, a string, a docstring, a local variable or a field grounds nothing, because the extractor emits no definition for it. Where no structural proof is obtainable - a language with no parser, or a legacy qualified spelling - the pre-existing path is preserved untouched, and file-only and no-symbol targets are out of scope and unchanged. Accepted short symbols receive exactly the long-symbol source representation through the unchanged extract_symbol_snippet, so exact_source_grounded becomes true through existing logic rather than being forced, and the unchanged PATCH.BASIS rules decide the basis. Every previously valid >=3-character symbol is pinned behaviourally unchanged. Structural grounding grants no write_authority, execution_authorized, Apply authority or auto_patch; patch safety, human approval and execution authorization remain the only later gates. Zero repository traversal (exactly one already-named file is read), zero model calls, zero network calls, no retrieval, graph, index or embedding change, no authoring or minimality policy change, and not report-only.

notes: PRIMARY INVARIANT. For every authoritative patch operation where the original target bytes and the proposed replacement bytes are both available, original_bytes == replacement_bytes means exact_no_effect_operation. A candidate whose operations are ALL exact-no-effect has candidate_effect=no_op and is rejected before candidate sandbox, paired probe, targeted validation and oracle assessment. Nothing else in the lifecycle moved.

EXACT BYTES ONLY. Whitespace, indentation, line endings, CRLF/LF, trailing newline, encoding, comments, AST, syntax and formatting are deliberately NOT normalized. Those deltas are real repository changes owned by byte-preserving semantics, and a gate that claimed them would be a formatting policy. Seven parametrized negative controls pin this.

NOT A SEMANTIC VERDICT. A no-op candidate says nothing about whether the model's diagnosis was correct; Round 7 had a correct diagnosis and an empty implementation delta. The reason vocabulary is closed to no_op_candidate and deliberately excludes validation_failed, probe_failed and semantic_error, because nothing was executed. The payload's confidence and summary are left exactly as the model wrote them.

SAFE_MINIMAL SEMANTICS UNCHANGED. The guard sits immediately before the candidate-shape preflight in core/pipeline.py::finalize_answer, and the two reasons stay separate: no_effect here, unsafe/non-minimal there. patching/patch_gates.py is not edited and _looks_like_noop_patch and _classify_indent are untouched - the Round-7 candidate was structurally minimal, it simply was not a patch.

REUSED MATERIAL, NO NEW PRIMITIVES. The bytes come from the bounded representation the candidate pipeline already consumes (candidate_plan_from_payload) with no repository re-read and no traversal, and candidate identity comes from the existing patch_plan_fingerprint rather than a second fingerprint subsystem. The evaluator imports only __future__, dataclasses, hashlib, json, time and typing; two AST tests pin that it opens no file, spawns no process and reaches no network.

MULTI-OP POLICY IS DELIBERATELY NARROW. All operations exact-no-op rejects the candidate. At least one authoritative operation differing continues unchanged: no operation is deleted, rewritten or reordered, and exact_no_op_operation_count is exposed as telemetry instead. An operation whose byte sides are not both available is 'undetermined', never 'no_op' - fail-open is the safe direction because rejection is the aggressive action.

AUTHORITY DELTA ZERO. Rejection can only narrow. needs_escalation is raised and human_review_eligible, candidate_review_ready and approval_ready are written false; execution_authorized and final_repository_changed stay owned by EXEC.AUTH.LIVE.1 and come back false through the existing no-execution path. EXEC.POLICY, EXEC.APPROVAL and EXEC.AUTH semantics are unchanged.

NO FABRICATED EVIDENCE. Because the producers did not run, no sandbox_result, candidate_validation_status, post_probe, paired_status, targeted_validation_status, check_oracle_assessment_status or candidate_verification_status is written. A test asserts every one of those keys is absent from a rejected payload. CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 semantics for real candidates remain frozen.

ANSWER.GROUND.LIVE.4 COMPATIBILITY. The new keys are harness-authored control-plane state and sit outside _ANSWER_SURFACE_KEYS, so the ownership boundary returns them by identity. A regression grounds a rejected payload and asserts every harness field, the nested receipt phase id included, is value-identical, so the new status/reason cannot become another fabricated repository entity.

POSITIVE CONTROLS ARE THE POINT. The known semantically wrong branch-reorder candidate changes bytes, so it passes this gate and is still rejected by CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 with primary fixed and preservation regressed - proved by a live end-to-end run, not by a stub. The deterministic width-distinguishing candidate likewise passes the gate. PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.1 must not, and does not, replace semantic candidate verification.

REGISTRY NAMING. PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.1 is an implementation slice inside the existing CONTROL track alongside PATCH.BASIS.LIVE.1. PATCH.* remains a phase-id namespace only, adding no track and no schema dimension, so core/phase_registry.py needed no edit.

ONE PRE-EXISTING TEST WAS RE-HOMED, NOT WEAKENED. tests/test_execution_outcome_telemetry.py::test_no_op_execution_is_not_reported_as_a_repository_change reached EXEC.AUTH's APPLICATION_NO_OP accounting by driving an exact no-op candidate all the way to the executor. That candidate is now rejected upstream, so the vehicle no longer works while the claim still does: the test now pins APPLICATION_NO_OP directly at the reducer that owns it (authorized_execution over a succeeded apply and a complete observation in which nothing changed), and a new sibling test_an_exact_no_op_candidate_never_reaches_execution records the lifecycle truth with the same plan bytes - no execution authorized, no execution attempted, repository byte-identical. Coverage went from 41 to 42 top-level tests in that file and core/execution_outcome_telemetry.py was not edited.

SHARED OWNERSHIP GUARD KEPT COMPLETE. tests/test_answer_ground_payload_ownership.py::test_the_answer_surface_is_disjoint_from_the_pipeline_control_plane_keys enumerates core/pipeline.py's control-plane key groups so a future phase's key cannot silently collide with a model-authored answer field. _CANDIDATE_EFFECT_KEYS was added to that enumeration; this phase is exactly the future phase that test was written for. core/answer_entity_grounding.py is untouched.
phases.summary: Round-7 black-box evidence established one narrow candidate-sanity defect: the model authored a candidate whose patched_snippet was byte-identical to its target_snippet. safe_minimal accepted it and was right to - the candidate introduced no identifiers, was structurally small, and patching/patch_gates.py::_looks_like_noop_patch detects emptied or degenerate function bodies, not exact replacement equality. The expensive read-only chain rejected it correctly but late, spending roughly 3.65 s of candidate sandbox and 4.29 s of paired probe proving that identical bytes do nothing. The harness was safe, wasteful and semantically late. This phase adds one cheap deterministic invariant in a new pure module core/candidate_mutation_effect.py: a patch candidate that changes zero authoritative bytes is not a meaningful patch candidate. For every authoritative operation where both byte sides are available, original_bytes == replacement_bytes means exact_no_effect; a candidate whose operations are ALL exact-no-effect is rejected as no_op_candidate before any sandbox, paired probe, targeted validation or oracle work. Comparison is exact bytes only - whitespace, indentation, CRLF/LF, encoding, comments, AST and formatting are deliberately not normalized, because those are real repository changes owned by byte-preserving semantics. Mixed candidates with at least one mutating operation continue unchanged into existing minimality and verification semantics; no operation is dropped, rewritten or reordered, and no mixed-op rejection policy is introduced. The gate reuses the bounded target/replacement representation the candidate pipeline already consumes via candidate_plan_from_payload and re-reads nothing, and it reuses the existing candidate identity primitive patch_plan_fingerprint rather than inventing a second one. Rejection narrows only: needs_escalation true, human_review_eligible false, candidate_review_ready false, approval_ready false; execution_authorized and final_repository_changed stay with EXEC.AUTH and remain false. No sandbox_result, post_probe, targeted_validation or oracle_assessment is fabricated for evidence that did not run. The known semantically wrong branch-reorder candidate changes bytes, so it passes this gate untouched and is still rejected by CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 on behavioral evidence - this phase does not replace semantic candidate verification. No model call, no network call, no repository traversal, no retrieval, no probe execution, no validation change and no authority setter.

notes: MEASURED FIRST, DESIGNED SECOND. The widening was not designed from token spelling. The shipped _enforce_safe_minimal was replayed against twelve representative candidates for the live T6 target and every novel identifier was recorded with its AST role, binding scope, load/store context, containing function and whether it existed before. All ten candidates carrying any novel identifier were rejected with the same reason - width (1 local), ch + width (2 locals), the Round-8 ceiling's ch + indent (2 locals), the correct unit + width + ch (3 locals), lstrip and append (members), statistics (import), leading (nested def), _INDENT_UNIT (global), default_unit (parameter) and counts.unit (attribute store). Only the exact no-op and the inverted reorder, which introduce no identifier, were accepted. That table is what the caps and the vocabulary were derived from.

THE DISTINCTION IS SYNTACTIC, NOT LEXICAL. Eligibility is a chain and not a score: novel identifier -> is it a local binding? -> contained in one existing function? -> within caps? -> is there no structural, dependency, callable/member or cross-scope novelty anywhere in the same candidate? -> eligible for verification. There is no novelty_score and no confidence anywhere in the module.

NO IDENTIFIER ALLOWLIST, AND lstrip IS NOT SPECIAL. The string 'lstrip' does not appear in core/local_binding_novelty.py, and a test asserts it. The Round-6 candidate is still rejected, as novel_external_reference. The phase was never required to admit it - it was required to make a genuinely correct fix expressible, which it does with three bounded locals and no novel member at all.

ADMISSION GRANTS NOTHING. A candidate admitted by local novelty is eligible for candidate verification and nothing else. The gate writes no human_review_eligible, no approval_ready, no execution_authorized and no write_authority, and the Round-8 ceiling candidate - admitted by the widened rule - is still rejected by the DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.4 matrix and by CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1. There is no path from admission to a behavioral verdict.

THE WIDENING CAN ONLY BE MORE PERMISSIVE. The new gate rejects a strict subset of what the old one rejected: classification runs only when the lexical delta is non-empty, and its sole effect is to skip a rejection. Every candidate the old rule accepted is still accepted, which a test pins directly.

RE-PIN AS PROOF, NOT AS A BUMP. DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.4 and CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 both froze patching/patch_gates.py at 816101991102f593cd037ec2009ddbfb3936b6ceb004dd839a1584e01434425e. This phase is the one authorised to move safe_minimal, so both pins move to cec73583c9d416e3b4f883090b02f2b48e0b012c44d2962f5e40819a5c070cf7 - and tests/fixtures/patch_minimal_live2_safe_minimal_reversal.json stores the four hunks that reverse the change, so the test reconstructs the pre-LIVE.2 file from the shipped one and asserts the old digest. Of the file's 35 top-level definitions, exactly one - _enforce_safe_minimal - has a different AST. Every other file in both fixtures is still byte-identical.

PYTHON ONLY, DELIBERATELY. Lexical scope is a language-specific fact. Modelling Python's rules and applying them to every grammar for symmetry is precisely the unsafe move this phase declines; JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust and an unset language all report language_supported=false and keep the previous conservative rule byte for byte.

TWO CANDIDATE SHAPES. A whole definition is the strongest shape: definition sets, public shapes and per-function bodies are all comparable directly. A dedented body fragment is supported too, because that is what the live reviewer path often produces, but only when target_node_kind is 'function', neither side contains a def, class or lambda, and every non-blank line of both sides is indented - a contiguous, definition-free, wholly indented region cannot contain module-level code and cannot span two functions. Anything else is unsupported_candidate_shape and falls back to the old rule.

THE CAPS ARE MEASURED. 3 novel local bindings is the smallest cap that admits the correct candidate; the measured local-only family binds 1, 2, 2, 3 and 5. 24 changed lines is the largest measured local-only diff, and the correct candidate measures 18. 1 touched function is section 25's own bound. A four-local candidate carrying no other novelty is rejected as local_novelty_budget_exceeded, which a test pins.

FRESHNESS IS REUSED, NOT REINVENTED. The receipt is bound to the existing candidate fingerprint primitive via candidate_fingerprint_from_payload, and core/pipeline.py drops the whole _CANDIDATE_NOVELTY_KEYS group when the candidate changes after classification - with the same exemption PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.1 has for a recorded rejection, which is the record of why the payload carries no candidate at all.

REGISTRY NAMING. PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.2 is an implementation slice inside the existing CONTROL track alongside PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.1 and PATCH.BASIS.LIVE.1. PATCH.* remains a phase-id namespace only, adding no track and no schema dimension, so core/phase_registry.py needed no edit.

KNOWN LIMITATION. A candidate that introduces an f-string cannot be admitted: the gate's lexical scanner strips the quoted text and leaves the 'f' prefix behind as an identifier that no AST node carries, so it falls through to unresolved_novel_identifier. That is the pre-existing behaviour, unchanged and fail-closed, and widening it would mean changing the lexical scanner rather than the novelty classifier.
phases.summary: safe_minimal's identifier rule was one line of lexical set arithmetic: any identifier in patched_snippet that is absent from target_snippet, from the language keyword list and from the language builtin allowlist rejected the candidate. Round 6 measured what that costs. A candidate whose whole novelty was lstrip / mode / stripped was rejected as 'identifiers not present in the source', and re-running the shipped rule for this phase showed the same sentence rejecting a loop counter (width), a loop variable (ch), a running accumulator (unit) and a new import (statistics) identically. A lexically new identifier is not evidence that a candidate expanded what the program can reach, and the rule could not tell the two apart. This phase widens exactly one thing: LOCAL BINDING NOVELTY. A new pure module core/local_binding_novelty.py parses the two bounded snippets the gate already holds, models Python lexical scope, and admits a novel identifier only when the same candidate binds it as a local of the one existing function it edits - assignment, loop target, walrus, with-target, except-target or comprehension target - and every load of it resolves through the lexical scope chain to that binding. EXTERNAL and STRUCTURAL reference novelty keeps the previous conservative treatment with its own typed reason: novel_import, novel_definition, signature_change, novel_scope_declaration, novel_attribute_store, novel_external_reference, unresolved_novel_identifier, local_novelty_budget_exceeded, multiple_functions_changed. Structural eligibility only - no score, no coefficient, no confidence - with three measured caps: at most 3 novel local bindings, 1 touched function, 24 changed lines, chosen as the smallest that admit the measured correct candidate. Mixed novelty stays blocked because admission requires the whole lexical delta to be explained by proven local bindings and no blocking finding anywhere in the same candidate. Python only; every other language reports language_supported=false and behaves byte-for-byte as before. There is no identifier allowlist: lstrip is not special-cased, and the phase's own positive control avoids it by counting leading spaces with a loop and accumulating the greatest common divisor in place. That test-only candidate needs three locals (unit, width, ch), passes the widened gate, reaches fixed_and_preserved on the DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.4 four-case matrix and verified on CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 with execution_authorized=false and the real repository unchanged. The Round-8 ceiling candidate, expressed the same local-only way, is also admitted and is still rejected by the matrix, which is the point: admission is eligibility for verification, never a correctness verdict. Zero model calls, zero network calls, zero repository traversal; no new fingerprint algorithm; DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.4 semantics, targeted validation, candidate verification, EXEC.AUTH/POLICY/APPROVAL and _classify_indent are untouched.

notes: THE PROPOSITION ARRIVES, IT IS NEVER INVENTED. EvidenceVerificationRequest cannot be constructed without a Proposition supplied by a deterministic caller, and Proposition computes its SHA-256 over identifier, text, type and scope together. An analyzer that rewords the claim, swaps an entity, adds or removes a qualifier, widens the scope or flips the type produces a digest the gate no longer recognises. EVIDENCE.1 never inspects content and asks what claims could be made from it.

PROPOSITION TYPE AND SCOPE ARE SUPPLIED, NEVER CHOSEN BY THE MODEL. The taxonomy is deliberately small: positive and negative_existential, with seven bounded scopes naming what kind of fact the claim asserts. Unknown types and scopes are rejected at construction, and a request whose proposition needs coverage or currentness must declare that constraint or it will not build.

TWO SEPARATE GATES, ROLE AND RELATION. Source role verification asks whether the content really satisfies an expected role. Proposition relation asks how it bears on the claim. A source may verify as implementation_authority and still be insufficient; a source may verify as validation_evidence and contradict. Both regressions are asserted, and no rule couples authority role to support direction.

EXPECTED ROLE IS A HYPOTHESIS, NOT A VERDICT. Verified roles are a strict subset of the expected roles ACQUIRE.3 recorded, and a role no upstream phase requested cannot be assessed at all. A file under tests/ does not become verified validation evidence because ACQUIRE.2 classified it, and a docs file does not become verified architecture description; classification granted permission to inspect, and only content verifies.

SCOPE COMPETENCE IS A FROZEN TABLE, NOT A HEURISTIC. SCOPE_COMPETENT_ROLES names the verified role that could establish each scope, and a verified role outside a scope entry cannot move that proposition in either direction. An interface is insufficient for a concrete implementation claim, a dependency manifest is insufficient for a runtime-use claim, a test expectation is insufficient for a runtime-behaviour claim, and a rejected design note is insufficient for a current implementation claim while supporting a historical one.

ABSENCE NEEDS COVERAGE, A COUNTEREXAMPLE DOES NOT. Supporting a negative_existential proposition requires a supplied NegativeClaimCoverage bound to the same proposition, the same acquisition request and the same candidate pool, marked sufficient, leaving nothing uncovered, and naming this source receipt. Without it the gate downgrades supports to insufficient with promotion_blocked_negative_coverage and status coverage_required, even when the analyzer asserted supports. One concrete incompatible implementation may contradict the same claim with no coverage at all.

CODE EXISTING IS NOT CODE RUNNING. A runtime_behaviour scope requires a supplied CurrentStateReceipt in either direction; implementation content alone yields insufficient with promotion_blocked_current_state_receipt. EVIDENCE.1 does not collapse code exists, code reachable, code configured, code executed and behaviour observed into one fact, and it never infers deployment truth ACQUIRE.3 did not establish.

OMISSION IS NOT CONTRADICTION. A positive claim is not contradicted because a source fails to mention its mechanism; contradiction requires positive incompatible content and a contradicting span. The deterministic analyzer has no absence-as-contradiction rule, and the system instruction for a model analyzer states the same limit explicitly.

THE PAYLOAD IS AUTHORITATIVE AND THE PATH IS NEVER REOPENED. Bindings are revalidated before any analysis: the bytes are re-hashed, the receipt is re-fingerprinted, the ACQUIRE.3 identity chain is compared field by field, and the source must still be acquired, unverified and not_verified. Any mismatch is binding_invalid with no analyzer call at all. EVIDENCE.1 verifies what ACQUIRE.3 acquired, not whatever is on disk now.

SPANS ARE BYTES SOMEBODY READ. Every supports or contradicts must cite bounded byte spans whose digests are recomputed from the acquired payload, within count and total-byte ceilings, and an optional quoted excerpt must be byte-exact. An invented symbol, an invented file or a span past the end of the payload cannot produce a matching digest, which is the structural answer to the DeepSeek invented-symbol failure. Analyzer reasons are enum codes, so a hallucinated identifier has nowhere to be written.

THE MODEL IS AN ANALYZER, NOT THE GATE. The analyzer protocol may propose role status, relation, spans and bounded reason codes. It may not alter the proposition, name another source, invent a role, request another file, search the repository or the web, select a candidate, choose a provider or model, set an authority flag, or promote itself. Forbidden response keys, including confidence and probability, fail the response closed rather than being trimmed into validity.

NO NUMERIC CONFIDENCE ANYWHERE. The relation vocabulary is four categorical values and no record in the contract carries a confidence, probability or score field. A static regression asserts that no dataclass field name contains one.

SEMANTIC RELATION IS ANALYZER-ASSESSED, NOT DETERMINISTICALLY PROVEN. Every result and every promoted record carries VerificationLevels naming four dimensions separately: source_binding, citation_integrity and role_admissibility are deterministically_verified by re-hashing bytes and re-deriving bindings, while semantic_relation is analyzer_assessed - a judgement accepted through the deterministic gate, never produced by it. DIMENSION_MAX_LEVEL gives each dimension exactly one level besides not_established and the record refuses construction otherwise, so a deterministically verified semantic relation and an analyzer-vouched digest are both unrepresentable rather than merely forbidden. VerifiedEvidence means tamper-bound, proposition-bound, citation-bound and role-admissible; it does not mean the proposition was proven true and it is not ground truth. No serialized record contains claim_proven, semantic_truth_verified, proposition_verified_true, deterministic_semantic_verification or ground_truth in any spelling, and a static regression asserts that no source file does either. The relation is attributed to its analyzer proposal fingerprint; provider and model identity are required nowhere and grant nothing. Role verification and relation direction stay uncoupled: implementation_authority with insufficient, and validation_evidence with contradicts, are both ordinary valid records. The amendment is additive - nothing renamed, no gate rule changed, the whole prior suite passing unmodified - and only the two records whose serialized shape grew moved to schema v2.

CONTRADICTION IS VERIFIED EVIDENCE. Verified describes the quality and binding of the assessment; supports and contradicts describe direction relative to the claim. A contradicting record is promoted with the same standing as a supporting one, and insufficient and unrelated are recorded as findings without producing a VerifiedEvidence object.

NO CLAIM SYNTHESIS. One proposition against one source at a time. Several results may be serialized side by side with aggregated, majority_computed and confidence_computed explicitly false. No majority, weighted support, aggregate confidence or final truth state is computed; EVIDENCE.2 / CLAIM.1 owns evidence-set synthesis and is not implemented or authorized here.

SOURCE CONTENT NEVER REACHES A RECEIPT. Spans are byte ranges and digests, quoted excerpts are verified and discarded, and a canary regression proves that a serialized result and a promoted VerifiedEvidence record contain neither a secret in the payload nor any identifier from the source text.

CLOUD DISCLOSURE IS A CONFIGURATION ACT. An analyzer client must declare its locality; an undeclared client is treated as cloud and refused. Sending acquired repository content to a cloud model requires an explicit cloud_disclosure_approved policy, and a request carrying local_analysis_only refuses a cloud analyzer regardless. That INPUT.2 uses a hosted model for intake semantics grants nothing here.

ONE ANALYZER, ONE CALL, NO ESCALATION. Provider and model are configured before verification starts. There is no model list, no cheap-then-strong escalation, no failover and no retry on a disappointing relation. An optional bounded repair may be attempted exactly once against the gate own structural defect list, is never attempted for a binding failure, and promotes nothing if the second answer is still invalid.

REGISTRY CAPABILITY LIMITATION. ROAD.1 schema v1 has no field that distinguishes an optional caller-supplied model analyzer from a phase that calls a model itself. EVIDENCE.1 ships no live transport: only a protocol and a scripted offline client, so model_calls_allowed=false and network_allowed=false are exact for everything in this phase and for its whole test suite. A caller that supplied its own client would be making that call under its own authority and under the disclosure policy above. writes_real_repo=false records that no repository content is modified, and ROAD.1 registry validation and ROAD.2 phase picking execute nothing.

IMPORT-TIME INERT AND NOT LIVE-WIRED. Importing the contract, analyzer, gate and adapter modules opens nothing and contacts nothing. Static regressions forbid os, pathlib, glob, socket, subprocess, database, index, graph, selector, validation and model stacks across all four modules, prove the deterministic gate cannot reach the model boundary, and prove that no live Instant Run, Commander, Project Evolution, Workbench, Mixed Mode, planner, CTX.SELECT, patching or web path imports or calls verify_acquired_source.

ANTI-DEEPSEEK NEGATIVE CLAIM REGRESSION. The original failure class is reproduced: one acquired source that does not establish repository-wide absence cannot support the negative claim that the harness has no session persistence, even when the analyzer asserts supports with a real span. The result is coverage_required and nothing is promoted. Supplying one concrete SQLite implementation contradicts the same claim without coverage.

UPSTREAM REGRESSION AMENDED, NOT WEAKENED. ACQUIRE.3 asserted that no production path imports it. EVIDENCE.1 imports its frozen contract module by design, so the ACQUIRE.3 live-wiring regression now treats the four EVIDENCE.1 modules as downstream contract consumers and adds a narrower assertion in their place: they bind to core/content_acquisition.py, never import core/evidence_content_acquisition.py, and never call acquire_selected_content. Every other production path is still asserted to import and call nothing.

RECOMMENDED NEXT PHASE. EVIDENCE.2 / CLAIM.1 should combine several independently verified evidence records for one proposition, handle conflict between supporting and contradicting sources, reason about coverage across a set rather than a source, and produce a bounded claim assessment. It is not implemented or authorized here.

EVIDENCE.1 CLOSED AND FROZEN. The phase is closed at the semantic-assessment provenance amendment: deterministic integrity verification and analyzer-assessed semantic relation are structurally distinguished in every record the phase emits, and no further EVIDENCE.1 change is planned. EVIDENCE.2 consumes these records through their public contracts and may not weaken the distinction.
phases.summary: First evidence-track phase and the first one permitted to interpret acquired source content: a deterministic promotion gate that consumes one supplied proposition, one ACQUIRE.3 acquired payload and its tamper-bound source receipt, and answers two separate questions - whether the content actually satisfies an expected evidence role, and how it relates to that exact proposition as supports, contradicts, insufficient or unrelated. The proposition, its type and its scope always arrive from a deterministic caller; a content analyzer proposes an interpretation and never owns the claim, the source identity, the role vocabulary, the promotion decision or any authority flag. Bindings are revalidated before any analysis, byte spans are re-hashed against the acquired payload, verified roles stay a subset of expected roles, a frozen scope-competence table decides which verified role could establish that kind of fact at all, supporting a negative existential claim requires a supplied coverage receipt while one concrete counterexample may contradict it without one, and a runtime behaviour claim requires a supplied current-state receipt in either direction. Promotion to VerifiedEvidence happens only through the gate and only for supports or contradicts; insufficient and unrelated are recorded without promotion. There is no numeric confidence field anywhere, no claim synthesis across sources, no repository read, no traversal, no acquisition and no network. The phase is import-time inert, ships no live model transport, and is not wired into any live product path. Every result and every promoted record additionally names how each of four dimensions was established: source binding, citation integrity and role admissibility are deterministically verified, while the semantic relation is analyzer-assessed and can never be recorded as deterministically verified. The phase is closed and frozen at that amendment.

notes: ONE PROPOSITION, MANY RECORDS, NO CLAIM. EVIDENCE.2 consumes one supplied Proposition and the EvidenceVerificationResult records bound to it, and emits an EvidenceSetAssessment describing relation composition, conflict, role coverage, scope coverage, negative-claim coverage, current-state coverage, duplication and independence uncertainty. It has no claim_true, claim_false, claim_verified, final_relation, winning_relation, truth_status, confidence, probability, recommendation or conclusion field, and a serialization regression walks every key and every value to prove none exists and that no value is a float. CLAIM.1 owns proposition assessment and is not implemented or authorized here.

COUNTING IS NOT WEIGHING. Five admissible support records and one admissible contradiction record yield conflict_status=conflicting, never supported. There is no majority, weighted majority, support score, contradiction score, Bayesian confidence, Elo or averaged analyzer confidence, and a static regression asserts that no class field and no callable in the module carries majority, vote, winner, winning, outweigh, tally, average or score in its name. Record, source and lineage-group counts are reported as structural facts with record_count_is_evidence_weight=false.

RELATIONS ARE GROUPED, NEVER REGRADED. Members are partitioned into supports, contradicts, insufficient and unrelated exactly as EVIDENCE.1 decided them. No span is re-read, no test is promoted because several tests agree, no manifest becomes runtime behaviour, and ten historical documents never outrank one current implementation. Regressions pin all four cases and each member serializes relation_reinterpreted=false.

ROLE PRESENCE AND DIRECTIONAL SUPPORT ARE DIFFERENT DIMENSIONS. A source verified as implementation_authority whose relation is insufficient discharges role presence and discharges no directional support, so RoleCoverage carries present and directional_present separately. An unrelated record discharges nothing and is reported as unrelated_only: a file being acquired and verifying its role is not the same as that file bearing on the claim.

ROLE REQUIREMENTS ARE SUPPLIED, NEVER INVENTED. With no EvidenceSetRequirements supplied, role_coverage_status is not_applicable and role_requirements_not_supplied is recorded as a gap rather than silently reading as complete. Supplied requirements are bound to the proposition and carry the upstream evidence-requirement fingerprint. scope_coverage is separate and comes from EVIDENCE.1's frozen SCOPE_COMPETENT_ROLES table.

IDENTICAL CONTENT PROVES DUPLICATION; A DIFFERENT DIGEST PROVES NOTHING. Sources whose content SHA-256 matches collapse into one lineage group, as do sources a supplied restates declaration relates. Nothing else collapses anything - not a shared directory, not a similar filename, not a similar role. A non-duplicate group is independence_unknown, never independent, because different bytes say nothing about whether two sources were produced independently. README.md and README-copy.md are two records and one independent evidence lineage.

INDEPENDENCE IS CONSUMED, NEVER DERIVED. INDEPENDENCE_INDEPENDENT is reachable only through a supplied SourceLineageDeclaration asserting distinct_origin, the same consume-never-produce shape EVIDENCE.1 uses for NegativeClaimCoverage and CurrentStateReceipt. Nothing in the pipeline currently mints one, so in practice every non-duplicate lineage is independence_unknown and independent_corroboration_unestablished is recorded for every supporting set. Identical content wins over a distinct-origin note about the same pair. LineageGroup refuses at construction to report independent without a declared distinct-origin basis.

ANTI-MIRROR-TUNNEL. One upstream hypothesis copied into several derivative artefacts is one lineage wherever the copies are byte-identical or a declaration exposes the relationship. Three support records, two of them sharing a digest, report three records, two lineage groups, one duplicate group and zero independent groups. Semantic duplicate detection is deliberately out of scope: it would need a model, and EVIDENCE.2 calls none.

ABSENCE STILL NEEDS COVERAGE ACROSS A SET. For a negative_existential proposition, negative_claim_coverage is complete only when a supplied NegativeClaimCoverage bound to that proposition is coverage_sufficient. Twenty sources each saying nothing about persistence stay twenty insufficient records; there is no count at which they become support. Two coverage receipts describing different acquisition universes or different required roles are coverage_inconsistent and are never merged into a wider one. A single concrete counterexample is grouped and visible with no coverage receipt at all, and the set still emits no proposition=false.

NO PRODUCER FOR COVERAGE OR CURRENT-STATE RECEIPTS. EVIDENCE.2 consumes NegativeClaimCoverage and CurrentStateReceipt and has no code path that could build either. A runtime_behaviour scope is complete only when every member cites a supplied, established receipt; a member with no receipt leaves it incomplete; two receipts disagreeing about one source leave it inconsistent. Nothing inspects a runtime, and a missing receipt is a recorded gap rather than an automatic resolution.

AGGREGATION CANNOT UPGRADE EPISTEMIC STATUS. Every member relation arrives analyzer_assessed and stays analyzer_assessed. Ten agreeing analyzer-assessed support records are ten analyzer-assessed support records. The set-level VerificationLevels is EVIDENCE.1's own record type, whose DIMENSION_MAX_LEVEL ceiling makes a deterministically verified semantic relation unconstructible, so the invariant is structural rather than a rule someone could forget. Structural dimensions aggregate as a floor: the set is only as source-binding, citation-integrity and role-admissibility verified as its weakest member.

TAMPER BINDING IS RE-DERIVED, NEVER TRUSTED. Each record's identity is recomputed from its own canonical serialization, which covers the proposition binding, the source content digest, every evidence span, the relation, the role assessments and the semantic assessment marker. No caller-supplied fingerprint field is read. Two of the tamper cases turn out to be unconstructible rather than merely detected, because the EVIDENCE.1 record itself refuses the mutation, and the regression accepts that stronger outcome.

ADMISSION BEFORE DESCRIPTION, AND THE SET FAILS CLOSED. A set that mixes propositions, repeats a record identity, admits a binding_invalid, analysis_invalid or unsupported_source record, names one identifier with two content digests, carries a hand-built promoted support for an absence with no sufficient coverage, cites coverage that was not supplied, or supplies a receipt, lineage declaration or requirement bound elsewhere is inconsistent_input with no groupings at all. Coverage gaps are a different thing and live in the four coverage fields and in missing_requirements.

CANONICAL ORDERING AND DETERMINISTIC IDENTITY. Members are ordered by re-derived record fingerprint and the request identity is computed over sorted collections, so [A,B,C] and [C,A,B] produce byte-identical assessments. assessment_fingerprint binds the proposition, the ordered member fingerprints, the coverage and current-state receipt fingerprints, the lineage declarations and the supplied requirement identity. No timestamp, no counter, no random token.

NO SOURCE BYTES, NO ANALYZER, NO MODEL. EVIDENCE.2 does not import core/content_acquisition.py, and AcquiredSourcePayload and BoundedPayloadView do not appear in its source. Importing the EVIDENCE.1 promotion gate would transitively import an analyzer, so the gate, the analyzer and the model adapter are unreachable by import and verify_acquired_source, verify_with_bounded_repair, adjudicate and analyze are unreachable by call. Static regressions forbid os, pathlib, glob, socket, subprocess, database, index, graph, selector, validation and model stacks, prove import-time inertness, and prove that no live Instant Run, Commander, Project Evolution, Workbench, Mixed Mode, planner, CTX.SELECT, ACQUIRE runtime, patching or web path imports or calls assess_evidence_set.

CLAIM DECISION AUTHORITY IS A PROPERTY, NOT A FIELD. claim_decision_authority and final_claim_authority are read-only properties returning false, absent from dataclasses.fields, so no construction path can set them - including the outcomes a reader would most like to treat as a verdict: support_only, coverage complete, no contradiction, multiple lineage groups. evidence_set_assessment_authority is the single narrow authority and human_approval_required stays true.

UPSTREAM REGRESSION AMENDED, NOT WEAKENED. EVIDENCE.1 asserted that no production path imports it. EVIDENCE.2 imports its frozen contract module by design, so the EVIDENCE.1 live-wiring regression now treats core/evidence_set_assessment.py as a downstream contract consumer and adds a narrower assertion in its place: it binds to core/evidence_verification.py, never imports the gate, analyzer or adapter, and never calls the gate entry points. Every other production path is still asserted to import and call nothing. EVIDENCE.1 is closed and frozen and appears in this phase's forbidden_files.

DEEPSEEK DOGFOOD EVIDENCE-SET REGRESSION. The original failure class is reproduced at set level across three sets for the claim that the harness has no session persistence: unrelated and insufficient sources produce no support and incomplete coverage; adding one concrete SQLite implementation surfaces a contradiction record without requiring absence coverage; adding four byte-identical no-persistence documents collapses them to one lineage group that produces no support at all and never outvotes the implementation counterexample. No final claim is emitted in any of the three.

REGISTRY CAPABILITY LIMITATION. ROAD.1 schema v1 has no field for a phase that is deterministic and report-only over records rather than over a repository. model_calls_allowed=false and network_allowed=false are exact for everything in this phase and its whole test suite, writes_real_repo=false records that no repository content is modified, and ROAD.1 registry validation and ROAD.2 phase picking execute nothing.

RECOMMENDED NEXT PHASE. CLAIM.1 should consume one assessed EvidenceSetAssessment through its public contract, refuse an inconsistent_input set outright, refuse to assess when negative-claim, current-state or required role coverage is incomplete or inconsistent, treat conflicting as a terminal unresolved state needing human adjudication rather than a winner, keep the claim's epistemic status bounded by its members' analyzer-assessed relations, and emit a categorical claim status with no confidence. It is not implemented or authorized here.
phases.summary: Second evidence-track phase and the first one permitted to look at several evidence records at once: a pure, deterministic layer that consumes one supplied proposition together with the EVIDENCE.1 verification results said to be about it, and states what that evidence set contains. It answers 'what does this set hold?' and never 'is the proposition true?'. The assessment partitions members into supports, contradicts, insufficient and unrelated without moving a single relation, reports conflict as composition rather than as a winner, computes role coverage against supplied role requirements and scope coverage against the frozen EVIDENCE.1 competence table, summarises negative-claim and current-state coverage from supplied receipts it can never mint, and collapses sources into lineage groups so that identical content counts once. It re-derives every record fingerprint from the record's own serialization rather than trusting a caller-supplied field, orders members canonically so input order cannot change the result, and refuses whole any set that mixes propositions, repeats a record identity, admits a record that established nothing, names one identifier with two digests, or carries a hand-built uncovered support for an absence. There is no majority, no weighted majority, no support score, no confidence, no probability and no float anywhere in the contract; five supports and one contradiction is conflicting, not supported. Semantic relations arrive analyzer-assessed and leave analyzer-assessed - aggregation cannot upgrade epistemic status. It reads no source bytes, imports neither the acquisition payload contract nor the EVIDENCE.1 analyzer or promotion gate, calls no model, touches no network, acquires nothing, executes nothing, decides no claim, and is not wired into any live product path.
