notes: RETRIEVE.LIVE.1 shipped 2026-09-01 as a live production retrieval correctness fix. Like OPS.PATCH.1/.2, OPS.VALIDATE.1/.2 and EXEC.AUTH.LIVE.1 it changes code real runs go through; it is not an audit, plan, preview, shadow experiment or report-only layer.

Malformed nodes were reproduced before any production change, and the exact reported examples were reproduced by mechanism, not by resemblance. Running the pre-fix parser over agents/deepseek_client.py yields calls 'e(\n  ', 'n(warning emoji) O' and 'equest_2(\n        "Y', plus the function name 'cont'. The file holds three warning emoji; each is two characters and six bytes, so byte offsets run 4, 8 then 12 ahead of character offsets, and the byte span of the real symbol 'main' lands on the characters 'cont' inside 'content_to_review' twelve bytes later.

One cause, not several. Repository-wide the pre-fix parser produced 8,367 malformed symbol names (control characters 4,380, delimiters 3,285, embedded whitespace 702) and 59,957 malformed call names, across 413 of 1,272 parsed files - and 523 of those files contain non-ASCII characters. Every one traced to the same line: tree-sitter reports byte offsets into the buffer it was given, and extraction sliced the Python str with them. Slicing bytes instead takes both counts to exactly zero, which is the evidence that no second mechanism was hiding behind the first.

Producer over denylist. Section 3 of the brief and the shape of the defect agree: a truncation such as 'cont' is a perfectly valid identifier, so no grammar filter could ever have rejected it - and no filter could have recovered the symbols that were silently lost. core/code_dna.py has an em dash at byte 31 and produced twelve corrupt names and zero correct ones, so _classify_indent, the live retrieval target this branch is measured on, was not in the graph at all. It was never a ranking failure; it was an absence.

Byte offsets were already the contract everywhere else. patching/patch_engine.py slices code_bytes[node['start']:node['end']] with the same numbers, so the fix aligned extraction with what the rest of production already assumed rather than inventing a new convention. Context windows (start-60, end+60) snap off UTF-8 continuation bytes before decoding, so an approximate window can no longer emit a replacement character into evidence text.

Candidate eligibility is defence in depth, not the fix. core/localization_candidate.py is deterministic, stdlib-only, reads no file, calls no model, opens no socket and walks no directory; every verdict is a function of metadata indexing already produced. Check order is fixed - kind, source binding, role, symbol grammar, span consistency - so one node always yields one reason.

Node kinds inventoried on this repository: file 1,274, function 18,949, class 457, call 6,622, expression 299, type 5, struct 5, enum 1, trait 1. Primary localization kinds are the implementation kinds (function, method, constructor, property, class, struct, union, enum, trait, interface, object, record, type, and the generic 'symbol' default). Structural-only kinds are file, directory, module, package, call, expression, statement, external, dependency and root.

Call nodes are structural only. A call node carries no file, no span and no language - it is a name plus edges - so it cannot satisfy the source-binding requirement and never competes with an implementation symbol as a primary defect target. The decision rests on that absence, not on the 'call::' prefix, and the dependency relation is untouched: caller -> call -> resolved_call -> callee all survive, and resolved_call edges rose from 406,718 to 577,996 total edges because correct call names now resolve to real symbols.

A graph node may exist while being localization-ineligible. Nothing is deleted, no edge is removed, and graph/weights.py already excluded call and expression nodes from centrality, so centrality cannot create authority now any more than before. Old graph artifacts remain readable and their malformed nodes are exposed as candidate_eligible=false rather than pretended out of history.

Symbol grammar is language-aware by construction. The rule is UAX-31 identifier validity per qualified segment - Python's str.isidentifier - after normalising the extra characters a given language allows ($ in JS/TS/Java/Kotlin, ~ in C/C++, @ in C#, ' in Rust). isascii() and [A-Za-z0-9_]+ were both rejected as rules because they would refuse legitimate Unicode identifiers this project's parsers accept. Length is never evidence: 'cont' passes the grammar, which is precisely why the producer had to be fixed.

Test files are not garbage and were not excluded. tests/test_index_completion.py::write_text - the symbol CONTROL used to localize to - remains an eligible primary candidate, because CONTROL.SAFETY.LIVE.1, not this filter, decides authority. Benchmark cases, node_modules and vendor paths are likewise not excluded by this boundary; the existing editability and generated-source policy remains the authority on those and was not touched.

Documents keep their evidence role. In production a .md file produces no code symbols at all - markdown has no entry in TREESITTER_LANG_MAP - so there was no role leak to fix and none was invented. Document-kind nodes (section, heading, document, prose) stay eligible navigation candidates and are never primary defect targets; source_role_mismatch is reserved for the actual leak shape, an implementation symbol claimed from a document or a prose object claimed from source.

Index freshness (section 38): the ProgramGraph CONTROL localizes on is rebuilt in-process from source, so the parser fix takes effect immediately there. The persisted code-unit index is incremental, so a parser fix would otherwise leave unchanged files serving symbols built by the broken parser indefinitely. SYMBOL_EXTRACTION_VERSION now enters compute_policy_fingerprint, which the existing delta path already turns into force_full_reindex exactly once. No new migration system, no manual index deletion asked of users, and no run is forced to rebuild - the fingerprint is stable between runs.

Ranking was frozen and is pinned by test. score_control_node's coefficients, compute_node_weights' alpha/beta/gamma defaults and the identity profile's path multipliers are all asserted literally, so the population effect stays measurable separately from any future ranking effect. RETRIEVE.LIVE.2 inherits a clean population and unchanged weights.

Registry naming constraint (section 45): the schema has no 'RETRIEVE' track and adding one would have grown a dimension in the schema, the counts and the report. RETRIEVE.* is therefore an ID namespace inside the existing INDEX track - the nearest existing retrieval/index track - following the precedent PATCH.* set inside CONTROL and EXEC.* set inside OPS. The phase_id the brief asked for is preserved exactly.

Deltas: zero model calls, zero network calls, zero embedding or vector-retrieval calls, zero added repository traversal (span metadata is recorded from the file the builder already had open), zero ranking-coefficient changes, zero patch-basis change, zero validation change, zero execution-authorization change, zero CONTROL.SAFETY authority change, zero WAITER routing change. core/code_dna.py was not modified and is on this phase's forbidden list.

_classify_indent remains deliberately broken and is pinned by two tests: a realistic nested two-space fixture still classifies as '4space', and the function's source is asserted unchanged. The defect stays available as the live retrieval target for RETRIEVE.LIVE.2.

Performance: graph build over 1,274 files measured 50.59 s before and 51.26 s after, within noise despite many more resolved_call edges; parse-only time fell from 18.9 s to 13.3 s because 13,610 fewer bogus call names are produced. The eligibility filter costs 0.22 s over 27,613 nodes. No claim is made about T6's ~26-minute wall time: indexing and retrieval have other known costs this phase did not address.

Known limitations carried forward: C++ operator overloads (operator(), operator[]) are still dropped by extract_name before they reach the graph, so the grammar's rejection of delimiters costs nothing today but would need a kind-aware exception if that extractor is ever fixed. The '<top-level>' synthetic aggregate is classified structural_only rather than removed. Vendor and generated-source population optimisation was deliberately not attempted and remains a separate, evidence-first question.
phases.summary: Live production retrieval-quality fix opening the large-repository retrieval recovery branch. Reproduced on this repository: 8,367 of 19,837 extracted symbols (42%) and 59,957 of 197,682 call names (30%) were misaligned fragments of source rather than identifiers, across 413 of 1,272 parsed files. One cause, deterministic: core.treesitter_parse parsed a UTF-8 byte buffer (parser.parse(bytes(code, 'utf8'))) and then sliced every extracted span out of the Python str, so byte offsets indexed characters. From the first non-ASCII character in a file onward every name was shifted - the reported call::e(\n, call::n(emoji) O and agents/deepseek_client.py::cont are all this single mechanism, and cont is the corrupted form of main. The damage was loss, not just noise: core/code_dna.py has an em dash at byte 31, so all 12 of its symbols were corrupt and the phase's own dogfood target core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent did not exist in the graph at all, which is why CONTROL localized elsewhere. Fixed at the producer (SYMBOL_EXTRACTION_VERSION v2, byte-space slicing with boundary-snapped decoding) rather than by a denylist: malformed symbols and malformed call names both fall to zero repository-wide. Defence in depth on top of it: core/localization_candidate.py is a deterministic, stdlib-only boundary answering 'which objects are legitimate localization candidates at all' before any ranking question, over a bounded reason vocabulary (eligible, structural_only, invalid_source_binding, malformed_symbol, unsupported_candidate_kind, source_role_mismatch). Symbol grammar is language-aware UAX-31 identifier validity per qualified segment, never isascii() or [A-Za-z0-9_]+, so elevacion and a CJK identifier pass while e(\n does not. A node may exist in the graph and carry candidate_eligible=false: nothing is deleted, no edge is removed, and resolved_call connectivity in fact improved (406,718 -> 577,996 edges) because correct call names now resolve. Population on this repository: 56,522 -> 27,613 nodes, eligible candidates 10,016 -> 18,645, malformed rejections 8,632 -> 0, and _classify_indent is present, eligible and primary. Zero ranking-coefficient changes, zero model calls, zero network, zero embeddings, zero authority change, zero added repository traversal.
phases.title: Candidate Population Hygiene & Symbol Eligibility
validation: python -m compileall -q core graph scripts tests benchmarks web patching

notes: ENTRY RECALL, NOT FINAL RANKING. The phase answers which eligible symbols are lexically connected enough to enter CONTROL's bounded pool. score_control_node, relevance_bonus, graph weight coefficients, path multipliers, DFS depth, neighbour limits and hypothesis scoring are unchanged. Any later ranking weakness belongs to RETRIEVE.LIVE.3 only after membership is proven.

The old path was raw query -> reasoning.deep_project_understand.extract_symbol_candidates -> expand_candidates -> exact graph query helpers -> findings -> core.control_engine.resolve_symbol_to_graph_nodes -> exact tail equality -> select_entry_nodes -> PROJECT_MAP hotspot supplement/fallback -> control_dfs_v2 -> infer_hypotheses. core.retriever._extract_symbol_candidates is a separate file-context consumer and is not part of CONTROL entry selection.

The reproduced failure is exact: query candidates indent and classification both resolved to an empty list for core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent; the explicit tail _classify_indent resolved. The target existed and was eligible, but no whole tail equalled either bare term.

Canonical identities never change. core.identifier_recall.decompose_identifier supplies a use-time auxiliary token tuple. Qualification separators, snake underscores, leading/trailing underscores, camel/Pascal transitions, acronym-to-word transitions and Unicode case properties are handled deterministically; __init__ remains exact-queryable while also exposing init.

No substring bridge exists. cat does not retrieve concatenate and run does not retrieve runner merely by character containment. exact_symbol, exact_tail, identifier_token, multi_token_identifier, bounded_morphology and unresolved are the complete match vocabulary.

Morphology is deliberately not a stemmer. The first live bounded-cap measurement showed indentation -> indent alone was starved behind six single-token space/classified test symbols, so the complete explicit observed family is indentation -> indent plus classification/classified -> classify. That gives the dogfood target two meaningful matched concepts ahead of single-token ambiguity; operation is not truncated to oper or opera.

Low-information handling is a fixed eight-token repository-facing set: get, set, run, main, data, value, item and test. A lone token cannot expand via token membership, exact symbol/tail lookup still works, and the token may support a multi-token match containing meaningful evidence. Ambiguity is otherwise legitimate and capped deterministically.

Eligibility precedes decomposition. resolve_query_to_graph_nodes iterates only eligible_localization_nodes, so call nodes remain structural-only and malformed persisted nodes cannot be resurrected by garbage token overlap. Tests remain eligible when their identifiers match.

PROJECT_MAP remains a legitimate bounded supplement and fallback. Query-derived matches are inserted first; a successful match records query_derived_entry_nodes and cannot yield hotspot_only=true. An unresolved query still admits existing deep/project-map sources and the legacy graph fallback remains intact.
No persistence is added. Tokens derive from canonical node IDs already in memory; no DB/vector index, repository scan, second traversal, index schema/version change or forced rebuild is introduced.

Navigation evidence grants nothing. IdentifierEntryMatch contains no score, confidence, weight, defect grounding, patch basis, authorization or write field. CONTROL.SAFETY.LIVE.1, PATCH.BASIS.LIVE.1, OPS.PATCH.1/.2, OPS.VALIDATE.1/.2 and EXEC.AUTH.LIVE.1 remain frozen.

Deltas: zero ranking-coefficient changes, zero model calls, zero embedding/vector calls, zero network calls, zero added repository traversal, zero indexing/rebuild change, zero validation change, zero execution change and zero authority change. core/code_dna.py is forbidden and _classify_indent remains deliberately broken.

Final deterministic live measurement: 27,723 graph nodes, 18,736 eligible candidates, query concepts space/indentation/classified, six bounded query-derived entries, no PROJECT_MAP or graph fallback, and hotspot_only=false. core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent is an entry member through two-token bounded morphology, obtains unchanged CONTROL final rank 1 with score 14.0113, and keeps relevance_bonus=0. Candidate token matching took 0.378191 s, total entry selection 0.518284 s, and retrieval after the existing graph build 4.768050 s. Calc and flat-pytest product smokes pass. RETRIEVE.LIVE.3 is not needed for this target because unchanged ranking already places it first.
Registry naming follows RETRIEVE.LIVE.1: RETRIEVE is an ID namespace under the existing INDEX track, not a new registry dimension. No PLAN, READINESS or CLOSE sibling phases were created.
phases.summary: Live production retrieval-quality fix for the query-derived entry boundary. RETRIEVE.LIVE.1 made core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent source-backed and eligible, but reasoning.deep_project_understand.extract_symbol_candidates emitted bare concepts such as indent while core.control_engine.resolve_symbol_to_graph_nodes required an exact canonical node ID or exact tail, so the target never entered CONTROL competition and query-independent PROJECT_MAP hotspots occupied the entry set. RETRIEVE.LIVE.2 adds a deterministic auxiliary identifier representation over already-loaded RETRIEVE.LIVE.1-eligible nodes: snake_case, leading/trailing underscore, dunder, camelCase, PascalCase/acronym, qualified and Unicode identifiers decompose into exact tokens while canonical graph identity stays unchanged. Exact node and tail lookups remain strongest; meaningful token membership and multi-token overlap provide bounded entry evidence; morphology is limited to the explicit observed indentation -> indent and classification/classified -> classify family; lone repository-observed low-information tokens are suppressed from token-only expansion but retain exact lookup and multi-token participation. Results are capped before CONTROL ranking using lexical entry facts only, structural call nodes and malformed persisted nodes are filtered before tokenization, and successful query resolution cannot collapse into a hotspot-only set. The CONTROL score formula, graph weights, path multipliers, traversal depth/limits, relevance_bonus implementation, patch basis, validation, execution authorization and the intentionally broken _classify_indent implementation are unchanged. Zero model calls, embeddings, network calls, persistent indexing, forced rebuilds, added repository traversal or authority widening; not report-only.
phases.title: Query-to-Symbol Entry Recall & Identifier Decomposition
validation: python -m compileall -q core graph reasoning scripts tests benchmarks web patching

notes: FIRST DIVERGENCE, NOT FINAL RANK. The RETRIEVE.LIVE.2 closure used the short query '2-space indentation is classified as 4-space'; the retained final product prompt is a longer sentence. That raw-input difference occurs before extract_symbol_candidates. For an identical query and eligible population, the pre-phase working tree already reached the same match_identifier_entry primitive, so this phase does not invent a semantic mismatch or widen matching to equate different prompts.

ONE CANONICAL RAW-QUERY RESOLVER. core.identifier_recall.resolve_identifier_recall owns extraction, query preparation, identifier decomposition, the frozen bounded morphology map, entry matching, lexical ordering and the cap. select_entry_nodes calls it directly once with eligible_localization_nodes(graph). resolve_query_to_graph_nodes and resolve_symbol_to_graph_nodes delegate to the same core candidate resolver; the latter has no independent exact-tail scan.

VISIBLE FACTS. Production entry_resolution reports raw_query_terms, normalized_query_terms, resolved_entry_nodes, entry_match_kind, morphology_relations, fallback_used, candidate_population_count and query_resolution_seconds. The normalized list exposes indent and classify as targets of the existing indentation->indent and classified->classify relations; it does not feed another matcher.

PINNED LIVE PREFIX. The no-model run_control_structured regression for '2-space indentation is classified as 4-space' reports core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent as eligible and query-derived with multi_token_identifier evidence, fallback_used=false and hotspot_only=false. Focused and production resolved identity lists are equal.

FALLBACK IS MONOTONIC. PROJECT_MAP can supplement unused slots and remains available for a genuinely unresolved query. It cannot replace or reset a successful canonical query result; project_map_fallback_used and fallback_used remain false whenever resolved_entry_nodes is non-empty.

NO NEW MATCHING POWER. The morphology table, low-information set, exact/token/multi-token rules, entry-kind ordering and caps are unchanged from RETRIEVE.LIVE.2. calc and longest-substring compatibility, exact-tail strength, cat -/-> concatenate, structural-only call exclusion and malformed-node exclusion remain pinned by the combined suite.

ONE ELIGIBLE-POPULATION PASS. resolve_identifier_recall scans only caller-supplied eligible node IDs and a one-shot iterable regression fails on a second iteration. It reads no repository content, traverses no directory, rebuilds no graph and adds no persistent index.

NAVIGATION ONLY. Query recall carries no confidence, defect grounding, patch basis, write or patch-application authority. CONTROL.SAFETY.LIVE.1, WAITER.LIVE.1, PATCH.BASIS.LIVE.1, OPS.PATCH.1/.2, OPS.VALIDATE.1/.2 and EXEC.AUTH.LIVE.1 remain frozen.

Deltas: zero new morphology rules, prefix or substring matching, ranking coefficient changes, graph construction changes, candidate eligibility changes, model calls, embeddings, network calls, repository traversal, validation changes, execution changes or authority changes. core/code_dna.py and _classify_indent are untouched.

FINAL LIVE RETRIEVAL HALF. The single no-model production-prefix run built 27,759 nodes and 581,678 edges with 18,761 eligible candidates. raw_query_terms=space/indentation/classified; normalized_query_terms also exposes indent/classify; all six entries are query-derived; core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent is a multi_token_identifier member, hotspot_only=false, fallback_used=false, final CONTROL rank 1 and score 14.01. Graph build took 55.018119 s, canonical query resolution 0.454069 s, production CONTROL prefix 5.450624 s and the full retrieval half 60.468766 s.

VERIFICATION. Phase plus frozen resolver suite 37 passed; registry/picker 249 passed; frozen eligibility/CONTROL/WAITER/PATCH.BASIS/OPS.PATCH/OPS.VALIDATE/EXEC.AUTH group 540 passed; registry valid with 151 phases and INDEX count 11; benchmark check 54/54; compileall and git diff --check passed. Broad suite: 9,141 passed, 14 skipped and the same 52 known historical failures recorded by RETRIEVE.LIVE.2; no retrieval, CONTROL, safety, registry, picker, benchmark or phase regression failed.
phases.summary: Live integration hardening of the frozen RETRIEVE.LIVE.2 query-recall contract. The retained full-product artifact and deterministic closure used different raw prompts, so the first observed trace divergence was before extraction; the current same-input focused and CONTROL paths already converged on match_identifier_entry, but production composition and receipts did not make that invariant explicit. RETRIEVE.LIVE.3 adds one raw-query resolver in core.identifier_recall, routes production CONTROL and compatibility lookup through it, removes the independent exact-tail scan, and exposes bounded raw terms, normalized terms, resolved entries, match kinds, morphology relations, fallback decision and timing. No morphology, prefix, substring, ranking, graph, eligibility, validation, patch-basis, authority, model, embedding, network, indexing, traversal or _classify_indent change; not report-only.
phases.title: Production Query-Recall Path Unification
validation: python -m compileall -q core graph reasoning scripts tests benchmarks web patching

notes: ORDERING, NOT RECALL. The phase owns only the order of already-resolved eligible entry candidates. Candidate existence stays RETRIEVE.LIVE.1, query-to-symbol recall stays RETRIEVE.LIVE.2/.3, and final ranking stays downstream CONTROL. For an identical query and eligible population the SET of matched candidates before the bounded cap is unchanged; only their order moves.

REPRODUCED BEFORE IMPLEMENTED. The Round-5 'max IDF x precision' calculation was recovered verbatim from the recorded experiment rather than guessed, and replayed against the real eligible population before any production edit. The replay returned the recorded top six in the recorded order: _indentation_signature, _classify_indent, harness_controls::_indent_of, pipeline::_indent_of, patch_engine::_indent_of, _point_lines. Production reproduces the same six.

MEASURED COMPARATIVE TABLE over one candidate population (19,264 eligible / 747 matched, the exact Round-5 long prompt): legacy key 736, morphology promoted one tier 736, sum IDF 17, max IDF 6, max IDF x precision 2, chosen production key 2. Round-5 recorded 723/269/19/6/2 over 19,177 eligible / 734 matched; the eligible population grew by 87 nodes between the two runs, accounted for by the ANSWER.GROUND.LIVE.2 modules that landed afterwards, so the legacy and sum-IDF numbers come from different repository states and are reported as such. The corrected rank is 2 in both states.

NO T6 STOPWORD PATCH. _QUERY_STOP_WORDS is unchanged and still excludes 'at', 'back', 'repository' and 'writes'. Measured negative experiment: dropping the nine filler terms this prompt contributes still leaves the target at rank 7 of 18 under both the legacy key and a promoted-morphology tier, and it gets there by deleting recall - the matched population collapses from 747 to 18, the exact invariant this phase must preserve. The chosen key reaches rank 2 with all 747 matches intact, and reaches the same rank 2 with or without the filler removal.

MORPHOLOGY IS A TIE-BREAK, NOT A TIER. bounded_morphology no longer sits in a bottom tier; a rare morphology bridge on 'indent' now outranks exact token coincidences on 'at' and 'back'. At equal specificity an exact token equality still wins, which is why _indentation_signature ranks above _classify_indent.

COST. The frequency map is built from already-loaded canonical symbols during the single existing population scan: no second traversal, no second decomposition, no persistence and no index migration. Measured 12.1 ms over 19,264 candidates, 0.82 ms to order 747 matches, and +45 ms (+8.8%) on a full resolve against a 76,000 ms graph build. A three-node repository resolves in 0.103 ms.

CONTROL SAFETY. token_idf, max_match_specificity, identifier_precision and lexical_specificity_score are navigation evidence. No field is named confidence or probability, none is stored on IdentifierEntryMatch, and none reaches defect grounding, patch basis, validation authority or write authority.

PRODUCT SMOKES, no provider call and no write: the real repository with the exact Round-5 long prompt puts the target at rank 2 inside the six-node query-derived entry set with fallback_used false and hotspot_only false; a small calc repository still localizes calc.py::add at rank 1 by exact tail; and a filler-heavy prompt over 61 synthetic candidates keeps the rare _indent_width at rank 1 against 60 'repository' coincidences.
_classify_indent remains intentionally unfixed. This phase is retrieval ordering only; it does not touch core/code_dna.py, which stays forbidden.
phases.summary: Live production retrieval-quality fix for entry ORDERING, the last stage before the bounded CONTROL entry cap. RETRIEVE.LIVE.1/.2/.3 made core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent source-backed, eligible, recalled and reachable through the bounded indentation->indent morphology bridge, yet Round-5 production evidence measured it 723rd of 734 matched entry candidates against a cap of 6, so the real long-form user prompt lost the target before CONTROL could rank it. The measured cause was the ordering key itself: a hard five-tier match-kind precedence put bounded_morphology dead last, and the tie-break was a raw matched-token count that scores every token alike. Common prose words in a long request ('at', 'back', 'repository', 'writes') coincide with identifier tokens, and measured document frequencies over the eligible population show why the count is a poor signal: indentation df 4 and indent df 13 against repository df 230 and writes df 210. RETRIEVE.LIVE.4 replaces the raw count with repository-local lexical specificity derived at use time from the already-loaded eligible candidates: candidate-level document frequency, token_idf = log(N / (1 + df)) with a non-negativity floor, max_match_specificity over the matched query tokens, and identifier_precision as matched query tokens over candidate identifier tokens. The ordering key becomes exact identity, then specificity x precision, then exact token equality ahead of a morphology bridge, then canonical node id. Explicit source references stay strongest: a full path::symbol and an exact tail keep their own precedence tiers. Matching semantics, identifier decomposition, bounded morphology, the low-information token policy, the query stop word list, the entry cap of 6, relevance_bonus and every downstream CONTROL ranking coefficient are unchanged; the matched candidate population before the cap is byte-identical, verified against the pre-phase module over six queries. Specificity is navigation evidence only and can never become confidence, defect grounding, patch basis or write authority. The phase adds no model call, no embedding, no network call, no repository traversal, no persisted index and no rebuild, leaves _classify_indent intentionally unfixed, and is not report-only because it changes which candidates production CONTROL actually receives.
phases.title: Repository-Specificity Weighted Entry Ordering
validation: python -m compileall -q core graph reasoning scripts tests benchmarks web patching

notes: The raw user prompt is stored verbatim in task_contract.raw_request.text and is the one field never truncated. A model-generated summary can never replace it.

Explicit evidence is extracted by literal, deterministic rules only: named entities, dotted acronyms, URLs, file paths, quoted terms, ordered list items, evaluation frameworks/rubrics, comparisons, requested output formats, and must / do not / only / according to constraints.

Provenance has exactly two states. 'explicit' means the user literally supplied the value and carries no probabilistic confidence; 'inferred' means an interpreter derived it. An inferred value can never be presented as explicitly supplied.

The Semantic Waiter is an interface plus two deterministic implementations. No model or provider adapter is wired. The waiter may not solve the task, inspect or index the repository, select an execution mode, select a provider or model, patch files, run validation or benchmarks, launch workers, start Dream or Project Evolution, or authorize writes.

The Requirement Preservation Gate is deterministic and ignores model confidence. Dropped subjects, dropped comparison relationships, dropped or reordered rubric values, rewritten constraints, lost output formats, and values falsely labelled explicit all fail the gate.
Failure is fail-closed: preservation status 'failed' forces routing_allowed=false, and the contract type refuses to be constructed with routing allowed over a failed gate.
Goal Brief remains assistive and optional. A short conversational request produces a small valid contract with goal_brief_required=false; no Goal Brief field is ever forced.

The phase performs zero execution, mode dispatch, repository scan or index, patch generation or application, validation run, benchmark run, worker launch, Dream run, Project Evolution run, model or provider selection, network call, database write, or repo mutation. Existing routing behavior is unchanged.
Recommended next phase is INPUT.2 - Semantic Waiter Model Adapter and Semantic Evaluation.
phases.summary: Pure, deterministic input-understanding layer that preserves the raw user request verbatim, extracts literal explicit evidence, defines the Semantic Waiter interpretation boundary, and fails closed through a Requirement Preservation Gate before any downstream routing may be considered.
phases.title: Lossless Task Contract & Semantic Waiter Boundary
validation: python -m pytest tests/test_explicit_evidence.py tests/test_task_contract.py tests/test_semantic_waiter.py tests/test_requirement_preservation.py tests/test_input_understanding.py -q
python -m pytest tests/test_goal_brief.py tests/test_goal_brief_4w1h.py tests/test_mixed_mode_intent_router.py tests/test_unified_workbench_input_plan.py tests/test_commander_run_contract.py -q

notes: REGISTRY SCHEMA MISMATCH, STATED PLAINLY: network_allowed and model_calls_allowed are false because the implementation, default behavior, test suite, and every validation command listed above perform zero model and zero network calls. The phase does however ship two opt-in adapters an operator can enable: a local one (ollama, the default) and a cloud one (gemini). The ROAD.1 schema has no field for a phase that ships an opt-in capability it never exercises itself, and network_allowed=true is a hard registry error. No registry rule was weakened to fit; the gap is recorded here instead. An operator who sets SEMANTIC_WAITER_PROVIDER=gemini is choosing to make network calls and to spend on a provider; nothing in this phase makes that choice for them.

The live adapter is opt-in and off by default. It runs only when a caller explicitly builds it via core.semantic_waiter_client.build_live_semantic_adapter or injects their own client. The live smoke test is skipped unless RUN_LIVE_SEMANTIC_WAITER_TESTS=1 and is not part of any validation command.

SHARED CLIENT CHANGE: agents/ollama_client.py gained one optional, additive generate(options=...) parameter that merges over its existing defaults. Every prior caller is byte-for-byte unaffected and is covered by regression tests in tests/test_ollama_client_options.py. The reason is measured, not speculative: a reasoning model bills its hidden thinking block against the same context window as the prompt and the answer, so at the stock 4096-token window the dogfood request stopped at done_reason=length before writing an answer and returned an empty response, which the adapter correctly but unhelpfully classified as semantic_model_unavailable. The semantic client now requests SEMANTIC_WAITER_NUM_CTX (default 16384). This is a transport option, not model routing: still one configured model, still one call, still no fallback.

CONFIGURED PROVIDER, NOT ESCALATION: the provider is resolved once, before the request starts, from SEMANTIC_WAITER_PROVIDER or an explicit argument. One request uses one provider and one model start to finish. There is no local-to-cloud failover, no cheap-then-strong escalation, and no retry against a different model; if the configured model fails, the request fails and reports which failure it was. An unrecognised provider raises rather than quietly defaulting. The cloud client is deliberately not built on agents.gemini_client.run_gemini_request, which walks a model list and would smuggle model routing into this phase. The credential is read at call time and never stored on the client or in telemetry.

MEASURED ON THE EVAL MATRIX (12 cases, one run each, recorded for honesty rather than as a benchmark): gemma-4-31b-it via the gemini provider passed 12/12, needing the single bounded repair on 2 cases, with 0 invalid-JSON and 0 hallucination failures. qwen3.5:4b via the local provider passed 9/12, losing B_paraphrase and K_owasp_reference to preservation failures the one repair could not fix and C_vietnamese to an empty response. Both failure modes were caught by the deterministic gate rather than by model confidence.

The model never builds the authoritative Task Contract. It returns an intermediate SemanticInterpretation which the frozen INPUT.1 deterministic path converts and then gates. routing_allowed continues to come from the Requirement Preservation Gate alone.

Structured output only. The response must be one JSON object over a fixed key set. Prose, unknown keys, unsupported vocabulary, out-of-range confidence, and over-bound collections all fail closed. Keys that would claim authority (routing_allowed, preservation, mode, provider, model, read/write/apply/patch authority, human approval, guardrails) are rejected on sight.

Provenance stays deterministic. A model claim of provenance=explicit without literal backing in INPUT.1 evidence fails the gate. Task classification and execution requirements are forced to inferred, and a confidence attached to an explicit value is stripped rather than honoured.

Repair is hard-bounded at one retry, so a request costs at most two semantic model calls. The repair prompt is generated from deterministic preservation evidence and names the exact missing items; it is never a vague retry. There is no recursive retry, no stronger-model escalation, and no provider switch.
Model confidence is not authority. An interpreter reporting 0.99 while dropping a rubric value still fails preservation and still blocks routing.

Deterministic fallback is opt-in, reports itself as semantic_deterministic_fallback rather than as understanding, records the model failure it replaced, still runs the preservation gate, and is forced to routing_allowed=false.

INPUT.2 adds a Semantic Waiter implementation but adds no Driver or model-routing authority. Model selection is configuration (SEMANTIC_WAITER_MODEL) or explicit construction, never a semantic decision.

The phase performs no execution, mode dispatch or routing change, repository scan or index, context selection, reconnaissance, patch generation or application, validation run, benchmark run, worker launch, Dream run, Project Evolution run, provider auto-selection, or repo mutation. Instant Run, Commander, Mixed Mode, Chat, Dream, and Project Evolution behavior are untouched, and the Mixed Mode router does not consume Semantic Waiter output.
INPUT.1 modules were not modified. Recommended next phase is INPUT.3 - Progressive Clarification / Goal Brief Escalation.
phases.summary: First model-backed Semantic Waiter behind the frozen INPUT.1 SemanticInterpreter protocol: strict structured-output parsing, one bounded repair attempt driven by deterministic preservation evidence, bounded telemetry, honest failure and fallback statuses, and a semantic evaluation matrix. The model interprets meaning only and holds zero execution, routing, or provider authority.

notes: REGISTRY SCHEMA MISMATCH, STATED PLAINLY, AND SMALLER THAN INPUT.2's: network_allowed and model_calls_allowed are false because the implementation, the default behavior, the test suite and every validation command listed above perform zero model and zero network calls. The phase does ship one opt-in local adapter (core.local_intake_assistant.build_live_intake_assistant over the existing Ollama transport) that an operator can enable. The ROAD.1 schema still has no field for a phase that ships an opt-in capability it never exercises itself, so the gap is recorded here rather than papered over. Unlike INPUT.2 there is no cloud path at all: INPUT.3 ships no cloud provider, reads no credential, and cannot reach a network service even when the operator opts in.

ZERO-MODEL-CORRECT BY CONSTRUCTION. The completion state, the ownership, the ambiguity set, the missing requirements, the required-before-handoff fields, the contradiction verdict and every canonical Goal Brief value are produced by core.intake_completion before any assistant is consulted, and the same objects are returned. Turning the optional local model off, or having it fail, changes wording only. tests/test_input_completion.py pins this with a fingerprint comparison across every decision state, and separately proves that a model attempting state=ready, ready_for_future_handoff=true, or resolved=[...] changes nothing.

INPUT.3_COMPLETE_WITH_CLOSURE. Handoff eligibility is now a derived conjunction, not a synonym for READY: the decision must be READY, have an actual TaskContract, retain preservation_status=passed, and carry valid existing INPUT.2 receipt evidence. Valid evidence is only semantic_interpretation_ok or semantic_interpretation_repaired with a matching receipt final status, structured output valid, no fallback, and the bounded positive-attempt success shape INPUT.2 emits. A standalone preview may still be READY, but missing, invalid, forged, failed, fallback, unknown, or mismatched semantic evidence always leaves ready_for_future_handoff=false. No INPUT.1 or INPUT.2 module changed.

THE ASSISTANT HAS NOWHERE TO PUT A DECISION. IntakeAssistance carries no state, owner, readiness, severity or resolution field, so promoting ASK_CLARIFICATION to READY is impossible through the API rather than merely forbidden. On top of that, the response parser rejects authority-claiming keys on sight, question severity and suggestion provenance are taken from the deterministic decision rather than from the response, and enforce_assistance_boundary refuses an invented question anchor, a severity disagreement, a duplicate need, or a suggestion over a field the contract already fills. Every failure path returns deterministic assistance and records which failure it was.

DECISION PRECEDENCE: (1) semantic/system failure, (2) explicit conflict in the user's own literal commitments, (3) preservation failure, (4) unresolved meaning ambiguity, (5) operational incompleteness, (6) ready. Step 2 sits above step 3 deliberately and only reaches over it when the preservation failure is entirely explained by the user naming more than one output format, which INPUT.1's single-output contract cannot represent by construction. Reporting a self-contradictory order as an interpreter failure would blame the system for the user's words and leave the user nothing to fix. A preservation failure with any wider footprint is a system failure and is reported as one. Neither exception may override the derived handoff predicate: a failed preservation gate is always non-handoff-ready.

KNOWN INPUT.1 REPRESENTATION LIMIT, HANDLED HONESTLY: 'as a table in markdown' names two composable shapes, and INPUT.1 carries one requested output, so its gate reports the second as lost. Nothing the user said actually disappeared. The policy may continue with READY as an intake classification, carrying the reason code output_format_representation_limit and preservation_status=failed, so the situation is visible rather than swallowed. The hardening closure makes that READY result explicitly non-handoff-ready through the derived preservation blocker. No INPUT.1 module was changed to accommodate it.

SYSTEM FAILURE IS NEVER THE USER'S FAULT. semantic_interpretation_failed, semantic_output_invalid, semantic_model_unavailable, semantic_deterministic_fallback, an unrecognised status, a run that produced no contract, and a preservation failure all resolve to SEMANTIC_SYSTEM_FAILURE owned by semantic_system_failure. The deterministic wording says the semantic interpreter failed and that it is not a problem with how the user wrote the request; it never says the request is unclear and never asks the user to restate it. A deterministic fallback counts as a system failure because INPUT.2 records it as a substitution for a model failure, not as understanding.

COMPLEXITY IS NOT INCOMPLETENESS. Goal Brief assistance requires both an operational task type (implementation, debugging, planning) and a breadth signal from the contract's execution requirements. An explanation, a question, a bounded comparison of two pasted snippets, and a comparative analysis flagged multi-stage are all READY. A single-file typo fix is operational but carries its own scope and is READY with no questions at all. When a decision is READY nothing is asked and nothing is volunteered: optional improvements are emitted only while already assisting, and 'why' and 'desired output' are deliberately never among them because they are the two fields that turn assistance into an interview.

AMBIGUITY SOURCE, STATED AS A LIMIT: INPUT.3 does not re-read the raw prompt. Clarification needs come from what the interpreter itself reported as ambiguous, from a structural dangling relationship subject, and from an explicit output-format collision with no exclusivity marker. Deciding whether 'it' has a referent is a meaning question owned by the Semantic Waiter (INPUT.2 eval case F already requires it), and honouring that report rather than second-guessing it is also what keeps the policy language-independent. Consequence: with no semantic model configured, 'Replace it with the other one.' can be READY as an intake preview because INPUT.1's literal extractor cannot distinguish it from 'Compare these two pasted functions.', but semantic_receipt_missing makes it non-handoff-ready. A pronoun regex would fix the English case and break the Vietnamese one, so none was added.

CONTRADICTION DETECTION IS CONSERVATIVE AND MODEL-FREE. It reads only INPUT.1 explicit evidence and performs no logical inference beyond an exact residual-token match between an explicit requirement and an explicit prohibition after their polarity markers are removed, plus an incompatible explicit output-format pair pinned by an explicit restriction whose own text contains the user's own output cue. Two incompatible formats with no exclusivity marker are preserved as ambiguity rather than invented as conflict. Because frozen INPUT.1 only extracts marker-bearing constraints, 'Modify the tests but do not modify any tests.' is a single clause and is not detected; 'You must modify the tests. You must not modify the tests.' is.

THE OPTIONAL LOCAL ASSISTANT IS LOCAL, SMALL AND SINGLE. One configured model (INTAKE_ASSISTANT_MODEL, default qwen3.5:4b) over the existing Ollama transport. No provider choice, no provider ranking, no difficulty-based escalation, no local-to-cloud failover, no automatic Gemma usage, no retry against a different model. The prompt carries the completion state, the open needs, a compact task summary capped at 600 characters, and the explicit constraints, and nothing else: no repository map, source file, project index, graph, benchmark, lesson, Dream artifact or run history. It measures 728 characters on the ambiguity case and 1187 on the migration case, so the context window is 4096 by default rather than INPUT.2's 16384; a 4096-vs-8192 comparison on the migration prompt returned 881 and 878 characters respectively, so nothing was being truncated and the wider window bought nothing. The module is inert on import; the transport is imported lazily inside complete.

MEASURED ON THE OPT-IN LOCAL SMOKE, RECORDED FOR HONESTY RATHER THAN AS A BENCHMARK: qwen3.5:4b, local, 45-85s per call on this laptop. The first live run found a real defect - the anchor ids were originally 'ambiguity:reported_ambiguity_1' and 'missing:scope_1', and the model returned an otherwise perfect response that had silently dropped the 'ambiguity:' prefix, so the boundary rejected the whole thing. The boundary was right and the id format was wrong: anchors are now 'ambiguity_1' and 'missing_1', numbered by position in the decision so they stay unique, and a CompletionDecision refuses to be built with two needs sharing an anchor. After the change the same model produced usable questions on both cases, for example "Which item are you referring to when you say 'it'?" for the unresolved reference and four natural questions for the migration. A 4B reasoning model does not answer identically every time and some calls still produced output the strict parser refused; in every case the canonical decision was identical to the zero-model run, which is the design working rather than failing.

SUGGESTION PROVENANCE IS SEPARATE FROM CANONICAL TRUTH. A model-written field suggestion carries provenance generated_assistance, serializes with canonical=false, lives on the assistance record rather than the projection, and cannot be constructed with provenance explicit at all. A suggested compatibility requirement stays a suggestion; it never becomes a user constraint and never enters the Task Contract.

NO EXECUTION AUTHORITY IN ANY STATE. Every decision, projection, assistance record and outcome serializes an authority block with routing, execution, repository read, repository write, patch, validation, benchmark, worker launch, provider selection, model escalation, dream, project evolution and mode selection authority all false, and human approval required true. READY means intake information appears complete. ready_for_future_handoff is separately derived from READY, contract presence, preservation pass, and valid existing INPUT.2 receipt evidence; it is deliberately not named routing_allowed and grants nothing. The contract's own routing_allowed is read but never written.

NOT WIRED. Nothing calls complete_intake in a live path. Chat, Instant Run, Mixed Mode, Commander, Goal Brief submission and execution, Project Evolution, Dream, CTX.SELECT, the indexer, the graph, patching, validation, benchmarks, lessons, the model Driver and provider routing are all untouched. INPUT.1 and INPUT.2 modules were not modified; INPUT.3 is built entirely around their public contracts. WAITER.1 remains unimplemented. Its future workflow selector should consume a CompletionDecision whose ready_for_future_handoff is true, then decide which workflow handles it.

Turning the local model off changes no completion state, ownership, ambiguity, required field, contradiction verdict or canonical contract value. The phase selects no workflow, mode, provider or model and holds zero execution authority.

notes: THE PREREQUISITE IS DISCOVERY ORDER, NOT OWNERSHIP. ANALYSIS.EVIDENCE.LIVE.1 found the defect - its own registry entry records 'INPUT.1 truncates a long obligation at about 250 characters' as a known limitation - but the defect is an INPUT transport defect and the implementation stays in the INPUT track. ANALYSIS.EVIDENCE.LIVE.1's role-allocation algorithm, its 12-token subject budget and its 12-file / 60,000-character / 6,000-per-file caps are all untouched. It receives what the user wrote; nothing about how it spends that was retuned to pass T5.

THE EXACT TRUNCATION POINT, PINNED. core/live_task_shape.py, split_obligations(), 'parts.append(clause[:MAX_OBLIGATION_CHARS])' with MAX_OBLIGATION_CHARS = 240. One line. The fix is at that authoritative producer, not around it at the consumer: no compensating logic was added to core/analysis_evidence.py or core/analysis_evidence_roles.py, and both are on this phase's forbidden_files list.

THE CUT INVENTED A WORD. The 240th character of the T5 first clause falls inside 'handles', so the old obligation ended at 'how each handle' and subject_tokens carried the fragment 'handle' into path matching as though the user had typed it. Post-phase the token stream carries 'handles' and 'tool' instead. test_analysis_evidence_is_no_longer_handed_a_fabricated_token pins it. This was not in the original bug report and was found by reproduction.

ONE SET, STRUCTURALLY. classify_live_shape derives the ObligationSet once; the preservation verdict, LiveTaskShape.obligations and LiveRouteReceipt.obligations all read it. LiveTaskShape.__post_init__ raises if the carried tuple differs from the inspected set, and raises if preservation_passed is true while the set reports authoritative_truncated. 'Gate says preserved, downstream receives fewer' is unrepresentable, not merely covered by a test.

BOUNDED, NOT UNBOUNDED. Lossless moved the bound from characters-of-a-commitment to whole-spans-the-user-wrote. Intake reuses INPUT.1's own MAX_SCAN_CHARS = 100,000 rather than declaring a second size policy, so intake and extraction cannot disagree. 32 clauses, 32 units, 480 characters per unit, 6,000 characters total; a clause past a unit is sub-divided at enumerations, sentence ends or comma-plus-conjunction the user actually wrote, and the word-boundary wrap of last resort never splits inside a word. Every remaining bound reports an explicit overflow_status. Nothing silently accepts 5,000 characters and keeps 250.

STORAGE IS NOT DISPLAY. ObligationSet.values is authoritative and never abbreviated. ObligationSet.preview is 240 characters plus an ellipsis for a UI field, a log line or a receipt - the old cap kept in the one place a cap is honest. On T5: preview_truncated true, authoritative_truncated false, in the same record. The receipt carries counts and flags, never a second copy of the user's text; test_receipt_does_not_dump_the_whole_private_request pins that.

ROUTE DELTA ZERO, MEASURED NOT ASSUMED. Mixed-obligation detection reads the set's clauses - the user's own sequencing - never its sub-divided units, so sub-division cannot manufacture a needs_clarification route. The pre-phase splitter was re-implemented verbatim and compared: 0 route deltas across the 12-case fixture matrix, and 0 mixed-obligation verdict flips across 180 adversarial head x tail x padding combinations of which 120 were truncated by the old cap. defect_repair, explicit_change, analysis_only and needs_clarification all keep their pre-phase routes.

LATE COMMITMENTS, INCLUDING SAFETY-RELEVANT ONES. Four long single-clause fixtures carrying no separator the old splitter honoured: 'do not modify files', 'return exactly three recommendations', 'analysis only, and do not write', and a late subject/relationship/rubric group. All four were lost before and all four survive now. Across the matrix: 12 explicit commitments lost by the old transport, 0 by the new. WAITER authority behaviour itself is unchanged - a surviving prohibition is preserved text, not a new gate.

CONTEXT BUDGET, MEASURED. Serialized Task Contract size delta is 0 percent - the contract never carried obligations. The only model-prompt growth is the obligations block itself: on T5, 405 -> 517 characters, which is the five recovered commitments. The route receipt grows 26,529 -> 30,849 characters across the 12-case matrix (+16.3 percent), all of it the bounded counts-and-flags preservation receipt; that receipt is a routing/telemetry record and reaches no prompt - render_live_route_json has no production caller. The raw request is not duplicated into any additional field, the route-level receipt omits 'preview' because 'obligations' sits beside it, and the bounds a receipt was produced under are identified by schema_version rather than copied into every record.

MODEL DELTA ZERO, NETWORK DELTA ZERO, TRAVERSAL DELTA ZERO. core/obligation_preservation.py imports re, dataclasses and typing from the standard library and one bound constant from core.explicit_evidence. It opens no file, contacts no service, calls no model, walks no repository, builds no index or graph, ranks nothing and grants no authority. No summariser was added: a model summary standing in for user commitments is precisely the lossy semantics this phase removes.

HISTORICAL ARTIFACTS STAY READABLE AND ARE NEVER RE-CLAIMED. ObligationSet.from_historical restores a stored obligation list and reports overflow_status = historical_representation_unknown with authoritative_truncated = True, because the completeness of a list written by the old transport cannot be established after the fact. Missing obligations in an old run are not reinterpreted as having been preserved.

KNOWN LIMITATIONS, measured. Sub-division is structural, not semantic: a 480-character clause with no enumeration, sentence end or conjunction is wrapped at a word boundary, which loses nothing but splits at arbitrary prose rather than at a commitment boundary - ObligationUnit.continued marks it. All five recovered T5 terms now reach ANALYSIS.EVIDENCE, but only 'tool' wins a token slot because MAX_SUBJECT_TOKENS is 12 and subjects are spent first; widening that is ANALYSIS.EVIDENCE's decision and was deliberately not taken here. Deduplication is exact casefold match only. Multi-root is not begun: the C.A.T.T.U.S side of the T5 comparison remains unavailable and the answer still says so.
phases.summary: Live preservation fix for the TRANSPORT of explicit user obligations, upstream of every consumer. A live T5 black-box run violated the already-frozen INPUT.1 preservation contract: the request named six explicit comparison dimensions, WAITER.LIVE.1 split it correctly at the sequencing the user wrote, and then capped each clause at MAX_OBLIGATION_CHARS = 240. The first clause is 352 characters, so the transport kept '... (1) how each one structures its agent loop and extension model, (2) how each handle' and dropped tool, plugin, lifecycle, context and retrieval before ANALYSIS.EVIDENCE.LIVE.1 ever saw them. The cut landed mid-word, which had a second unmeasured consequence: the fragment 'handle' - a word the user never typed - entered subject_tokens and travelled into path matching as a user-supplied term, so the old transport did not only lose commitments, it invented one. The Preservation Gate compared ExplicitEvidence against SemanticInterpretation, neither of which carries obligations, so it reported passed while downstream received five fewer dimensions - exactly the 'gate says preserved, downstream receives fewer' regression. INPUT.PRESERVE.LIVE.1 makes core/obligation_preservation.py the single authoritative producer. The bound moves from characters-of-a-commitment to whole-spans-the-user-wrote: intake is bounded at INPUT.1's own MAX_SCAN_CHARS = 100,000 reused rather than re-declared, a clause longer than one 480-character unit is SUB-DIVIDED at boundaries appearing literally in the request - enumerations, sentence ends, comma-plus-conjunction, then a word-boundary wrap that never splits inside a word - and every remaining bound reports an explicit overflow_status instead of shortening a span quietly. Storage is separated from display: ObligationSet.values is authoritative and never abbreviated, ObligationSet.preview keeps the old 240 characters for a UI field or a log line. The structural core is that there is ONE set: classify_live_shape derives it once, the preservation verdict and every downstream consumer read the same object, and LiveTaskShape.__post_init__ refuses to construct a shape whose obligation tuple differs from the set the gate inspected or that claims preservation while the set reports authoritative_truncated - so the regression is unrepresentable rather than merely tested for. Mixed-obligation detection reads the set's clauses, never its units, so sub-division cannot manufacture a clarification route. Measured: 12 explicit commitments lost by the old transport, 0 by the new; 0 route deltas across the fixture matrix and 0 mixed-obligation verdict flips across 180 adversarial combinations of which 120 were truncated by the old cap; Task Contract serialized size delta 0 percent and the T5 model-prompt obligations block grows 405 -> 517 characters, which is the recovered commitments themselves. The phase adds no model call, no network call, no repository traversal, no routing retune, no analysis-ranking change and no multi-root access.

notes: PRIMARY INVARIANT. AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED controls mutation and nothing else. It may not decide whether an already-authored candidate is verified before it is represented as suitable for human review. Verification is not authorization: even a verified candidate ends the run with execution_authorized=false while the switch is off.

OLD BOUNDARY. The early return was the AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED check at the top of maybe_run_auto_patch, immediately after the WAITER read-only route guard. It printed one line, recorded the auto_patch_disabled denial and returned. Everything downstream - normalization, patch safety, sandbox, probe, targeted validation, eligibility - was unreachable.

NEW ORDERING. candidate authored -> safe_minimal/patch safety -> exact candidate sandbox -> paired post-probe and preservation probe -> targeted validation -> oracle assessment -> candidate verification receipt -> execution policy and human review -> mutation only if separately authorized. The read-only branch stops after the receipt and the existing auto_patch_disabled denial; there is no executor call, no apply path and no authority setter anywhere inside it.

READ-ONLY. Every candidate byte exists only in a disposable managed sandbox built by the existing primitives. No git stash, reset or clean. The real repository is opened for reading and is byte-identical before and after, which the tests assert on core/code_dna.py on every run.

EXACT CANDIDATE BINDING. The fingerprint is candidate_fingerprint_from_payload, the existing OPS.PATCH.2 primitive; no second algorithm was invented. Stale evidence is dropped before anything is measured, and the receipt is discarded with the evidence it reduced whenever the candidate is rewritten.

AVAILABILITY-AWARE RESULT. Closed vocabulary verified/rejected/inconclusive/unavailable/stale/invalid. Precedence is invalid > stale > rejected > unavailable > inconclusive > verified: evidence that cannot be trusted is never reported as a finding about the candidate. The single accepted limitation is OPS.VALIDATE.3 answering no_relevant_existing_checks, which is a completed selection rather than absent evidence; it is recorded in accepted_limitations and can never verify a candidate on its own because the paired probe must still support it.

PAIRED PROBE GOVERNS. A regressed preservation case is read before the closed paired status, so a receipt whose statuses disagree can never resolve permissively. primary fixed is never flattened into verified.

SAFE_MINIMAL UNCHANGED. Shape safety accepting the known wrong candidate is the correct answer and stays that way; patching/patch_gates.py and policy/decision_helper.py are pinned frozen. The semantic rejection belongs to candidate verification.
CONFIDENCE IS NOT AN INPUT. The smoke carried confidence=0.4. The reducer never reads a confidence field, and a test sweeps 0.0 to 1.0 and asserts the receipt is byte-identical.

HUMAN REVIEW SEMANTICS. candidate_visible_for_debugging, candidate_review_ready and human_review_eligible are three separate facts. A rejected candidate stays visible with its evidence, is never described as review-ready, and the user-facing message says so in words.

EXEC.APPROVAL COMPATIBILITY. EXEC.APPROVAL.LIVE.1 is byte-identical. The binding is by omission: only a verified, eligible candidate is frozen into a human_apply_review receipt, and the frozen Apply path already refuses any grounded_defect candidate that has none. No second approval system exists.

AUTHORITY DELTA ZERO. candidate_verification_authority_effect=none. A verified receipt grants no execution authority, no write authority, no auto-apply and no approval; it only permits the candidate to be described as review-ready. There is no model call, no network call and no repository traversal anywhere in the reducer, and no model call was added to the read-only branch: it verifies the candidate the run already authored.

EXEC.POLICY COMPATIBILITY. core/execution_eligibility_policy.py is byte-identical. Verification only ever narrows: human_review_eligible is forced false when verification is not verified, and no eligibility is created that the frozen policy did not already grant.

VALIDATION SEMANTICS UNCHANGED. OPS.VALIDATE.3's selector, commands and budgets are untouched and the 30-second full-validation timeout was not raised. Full self-repo validation may still be inconclusive with validation_budget_exhausted, which the bounded profile already accepts as a stated limitation.

SCOPE. T1/T2/T3 disposable auto-patch flows and T4 explicit-change human approval keep their existing control flow exactly; the mutation-enabled path is not entered by the new function, which a test asserts. T5 analysis_only returns at the WAITER read-only guard before this branch. No model call, no network call, no repository traversal and no new cleanup phase were added.

FROZEN BOUNDARIES. tests/fixtures/candidate_verify_live1_frozen_boundaries.json pins by whole-file digest every evidence producer this phase orchestrates, every authority/eligibility/approval surface, patch basis and safety, safe_minimal, the sandbox and apply primitives, validation command selection, CONTROL ranking, RETRIEVE recall, BehavioralExpectation and core/code_dna.py.

REGISTRY NAMING. CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 is a direct live phase in the existing OPS track; CANDIDATE.* is a phase-id namespace only, adding no schema dimension. It has no PLAN, READINESS or CLOSE siblings and is not report-only.
phases.summary: Live lifecycle fix separating candidate verification from execution. AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED controls mutation, and until this phase it silently controlled verification too: core/pipeline.py::maybe_run_auto_patch returned at the kill-switch check before candidate sandbox validation, the paired post-probe, defect-closure assessment, targeted baseline/candidate validation, oracle assessment and the exact candidate fingerprint - while the authored candidate was still rendered for a human. The T6 smoke paid for that: the branch-reorder candidate reached the user with needs_escalation=false, confidence=0.4 and no evidence of any kind, because everything that would have measured it lived past the return. CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 adds core/candidate_verification.py, a pure reducer over receipts the existing phases already produce, and moves the boundary in core/pipeline.py so an authored candidate is verified read-only before the no-execution-authority return. The new branch runs existing patch safety, the OPS.PATCH.2 exact candidate sandbox, the DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.3 paired post-probe, OPS.VALIDATE.3 targeted validation and the VALIDATE.ORACLE.LIVE.1 role assessment, all on disposable sandbox copies, then reduces them into a closed status: verified, rejected, inconclusive, unavailable, stale or invalid. A candidate is verified only when every required available component supports it; missing evidence never becomes a pass, and integrity and freshness outrank a substantive verdict. The exact T6 branch-reorder candidate now measures safe_minimal accepted, sandbox applied, primary fixed, preservation regressed, verification rejected, needs_escalation true, human_review_eligible false and no human_apply_review receipt; the width-distinguishing positive control measures verified, so verification opens as well as closes. Both end with execution_authorized false and final_repository_changed false under AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED=false. No provider call, no network call, no repository mutation, no auto-apply, no approval-semantics change, no safe_minimal change, no OPS.VALIDATE selector or command change, and _classify_indent stays deliberately broken.

notes: TWO EXECUTION QUESTIONS. Whole-repository validation asks whether the repository/test suite is healthy. A defect probe asks whether one specifically claimed behavior can be reproduced. Both are execution evidence and neither substitutes for the other. A validation_budget_exhausted receipt remains outcome=inconclusive even when a separate bounded probe reports reproduced.

INDEPENDENT ORACLE. Allowed provenance is a closed set: explicit_user_reproducer, existing_repository_test, repository_contract/specification and deterministic_task_fact_adapter. input_basis and expected_behavior_basis are separately typed. model_authored input or expectation, ambiguous provenance, or a test produced by the same patch author is invalid_probe and can never enter PATCH.BASIS.

MODEL MAY NOT DEFINE BOTH SIDES. There is no model call in derivation or execution. The only live adapter is a reusable indentation-width family: a literal preserved N-space indentation is classified as M-space fact deterministically produces nested text with exactly N spaces per depth and expects Nspace. It contains no _classify_indent-specific branch.

TYPED STATIC EXECUTION. Contracts contain JSON args/kwargs only; execution kind selects static worker code. Shell authority, arbitrary command strings, exec, eval and python -c are absent. The safe argv runner provides a bounded timeout, secret-scrubbed environment, process kill/reap and the existing fresh bytecode-cache context.

SIDE EFFECTS. The isolated worker refuses writes whose resolved target is inside the named repository, network connection constructors and child processes. Pytest runs only one already-known path::node selector with plugin autoload and cacheprovider disabled. Mutation/network/tool refusal is inconclusive, not evidence. No repository copy or traversal is introduced.

CURRENT SOURCE. The pre-patch immutable contract records the exact target source digest acquired after localization; execution refuses if those bytes changed and records the digest it actually imported. A fresh isolated PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX is mandatory for a verdict. The same immutable semantic contract may run at execution_stage=post_patch against new bytes, but a post-patch receipt never retroactively grounds the pre-patch defect.

PATCH.BASIS ONLY. reproduced plus independent provenance, pre_patch stage, exact candidate binding and current-source freshness becomes kind=bounded_defect_reproduction at the existing PATCH.BASIS.LIVE.1 boundary. patch_basis=grounded_defect remains non-authorizing. CONTROL and candidate state keep write_authority=false and patch_application_authority=false; patch safety, AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED, execution authorization, human approval, validation and rollback remain the only later gates.

RESULT VOCABULARY. reproduced, not_reproduced, inconclusive, invalid_probe and unavailable are exhaustive. Timeout and tool/import/call failure are inconclusive. No confidence score exists. Telemetry exposes defect_probe_attempted, defect_probe_basis, defect_probe_target, defect_probe_result, defect_probe_observed, defect_probe_expected_basis and defect_probe_freshness plus the structured receipt.

ROUTE COMPATIBILITY. analysis_only and explicit_change never probe. A defect route with passed or genuine failed baseline never probes, preserving T1/T2/T3. No adapter means unavailable without discovery. Existing validation/review behavior, targeted candidate sandbox validation and full-suite timeout truthfulness are unchanged.

T6 ACCEPTANCE. The exact target remains core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent. Current execution observes 4space for the deterministic realistically nested two-space fixture while the independently preserved task expectation is 2space, so probe_result=reproduced and patch_basis_source=bounded_defect_reproduction. core/code_dna.py is forbidden and unchanged.

FROZEN DELTAS. Global 30-second validation timeout, validation selection, affected-test optimization, retrieval, identifier recall, ranking, graph/index lifecycle, _classify_indent, patch generation, patch safety, write authority, execution policy, answer grounding and network behavior are unchanged. No new model verifier, TDD oracle or targeted-validation acceptance policy is introduced.

REGISTRY NAMING. DEFECT is an ID namespace in the existing OPS track, following PATCH, EXEC, RETRIEVE and ANSWER. It adds no track and no PLAN, READINESS or CLOSE siblings. All nine explicitly frozen live prerequisites are recorded.
phases.summary: Live bounded execution-evidence path for a defect-repair task whose whole-repository baseline validation is truthful but inconclusive. A frozen typed contract separates whole-repository validation from one already-localized behavioral reproduction and carries probe_basis, input_basis, expected_behavior_basis, exact target binding, invocation kind, structured JSON inputs, expected equality relation, a <=10 second timeout and a read-only/no-network side-effect policy. Only explicit user reproducers, pre-existing repository tests, repository contracts/specifications and deterministic adapters from preserved literal task facts may supply the oracle; model-authored expectations, model-authored inputs, missing provenance and same-patch-author generated tests are invalid and cannot establish grounded_defect. The production adapter runs only for a preservation-passed defect_repair route after inconclusive baseline validation, only when canonical recall already supplied an eligible exact source target, and performs no discovery or traversal when no adapter exists. Execution is a static worker under the existing safe argv validation runner, with OPS.VALIDATE.2's fresh isolated PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX, no shell text, exec, eval or python -c, and guards that refuse repository mutation, network access and child processes. A timeout, import/call/tool failure, missing freshness or refused side effect is inconclusive. A reproduced pre-patch receipt may feed PATCH.BASIS.LIVE.1 as bounded_defect_reproduction only when its independent provenance, current-source freshness and exact candidate binding all validate; passing validation remains passing, validation_budget_exhausted remains inconclusive, and neither fact is rewritten. Reproduction establishes only the observed bounded behavior - never repository health, patch correctness, sole cause or write authority. Fast T1/T2/T3 executed-failure flows, analysis and explicit-change routes, CONTROL safety, patch safety, AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED, human approval, execution authorization, post-patch validation and rollback remain unchanged. _classify_indent remains deliberately unfixed; the T6 task deterministically derives nested text with two spaces per depth, executes core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent and records observed=4space, expected=2space, probe_result=reproduced without running the broad suite. Zero model calls, zero network, zero retrieval/ranking change, zero global-timeout change, zero affected-test optimization and no parallel authority route; not report-only.

notes: PRIMARY INVARIANT. The fingerprinted immutable probe P runs before the patch on current source and after the exact candidate C only in a disposable managed sandbox. Target, invocation kind, structured input, expected relation/result, provenance and execution constraints cannot change between receipts.

IDENTITY. Probe fingerprints exclude timestamps/run IDs. Candidate fingerprints reuse OPS.PATCH.2 canonical patch-plan semantics. Candidate refinement makes post-probe evidence stale and the pipeline removes only the candidate-probe telemetry group.

SAFETY AND MATERIALIZATION. Existing patch basis, exact target/source grounding and patch safety remain earlier gates. Unsafe candidates are never sandboxed. Safe candidates use the real patching.patch_plan_executor.apply_patch_plan primitive, preserving OPS.PATCH.1 byte semantics; no simplified apply helper exists.

ORACLE INTEGRITY. explicit user requirements and deterministic preserved task facts remain immutable outside the candidate. Existing-test and repository-contract expectations require source-artifact bindings, and a candidate touching one is invalid_comparison. model_authored input/expectation remains invalid even if a candidate makes it pass.

RESULTS. reproduced to expected is fixed; the identical wrong observation is still_reproduced; a different wrong observation is changed_but_unresolved. Timeout, worker/import/tool failure, missing freshness and cleanup failure are inconclusive. No confidence score exists.

SEPARATE FACTS. defect_closure_status=fixed does not mean full_validation=passed or targeted_validation=passed. targeted failure does not rewrite post_probe=fixed, and fixed does not rewrite targeted failure. PATCH.BASIS remains grounded only by the pre-patch DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.1 reproduction.

AUTHORITY DELTA ZERO. candidate_probe_authority_effect=none. fixed is not execution_authorized, write_authority, auto_apply_allowed, approval_ready or human approval. No policy branch consumes closure status to authorize a real repository write.

FRESHNESS AND DISPOSAL. The existing managed sandbox copier/marker cleanup and OPS.VALIDATE.2 isolated PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX are reused. Timings separately record sandbox creation, patch apply, post-probe execution, cleanup and total. Real repository bytes are never candidate targets or copied back.

A deterministic normal patch plan changes only sandbox bytes; the identical probe then observes 2space and records fixed. The two structurally selected defect-preservation tests pass on baseline and fail on candidate, and both facts remain visible. Real core/code_dna.py remains deliberately broken and byte-identical.

ROUTE COMPATIBILITY. analysis_only and explicit_change do not enter this closure path. Ordinary meaningful T1/T2/T3 repository validation remains sufficient and unchanged. No feature probe, model-generated TDD, verifier model, retrieval, graph traversal, selection policy or validation-score aggregation is added.
