notes: PRIMARY INVARIANT. A candidate may not receive defect-closure status merely because the originally failing behavior became correct. When the typed fact/subject adapter can deterministically construct one, it must also preserve a bounded counter-case where baseline behavior was already correct.

SUBJECT ADAPTER. behavior subject -> optional deterministic preservation cases, and nothing else. indentation_style maps expected=2space/observed=4space to a width-4 fixture expecting 4space. Every other subject, every fact whose values the adapter cannot read, and every legacy transport that carries no typed fact returns no cases at all; that is the truthful answer, never an approximation.

FIXTURE REUSE. _nested_indentation_fixture is reused exactly, at the claimed observed width. No second indentation fixture generator exists, the module asserts as much about its own source, and the DEFECT.FACT.LIVE.1 AST pin on that function still holds.

BASELINE PRECONDITION. Each counter-case runs read-only against the real repository at pre_patch stage first. Only a not_reproduced baseline is promoted to an oracle. A baseline that fails the counter-case yields preservation status unavailable with reason baseline_did_not_satisfy_the_counter_case, and is never read as a regression.

ORACLE INTEGRITY. A counter-case must share the primary probe's target binding, invocation kind, expected relation, side-effect policy, probe/input/expectation bases and expectation source paths, and must not share its fingerprint. Anything else is refused as counter_case_is_not_bound_to_the_primary_probe, so DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.2's existing rule against a candidate editing its own oracle artifact covers both halves of the pair identically.

PAIRED RESULT. The defect case and the preservation cases are represented separately, each with expected, baseline_observed, candidate_observed and status, and then closed into paired_status. fixed is never overloaded: fixed_and_preserved, fixed (no oracle available) and fixed_but_regressive are three distinct values. Only a fixed primary is qualified by preservation; a primary that did not close keeps DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.2's own answer.

PROVENANCE. The primary expectation stays explicit_user_fact. The preservation expectation is system_derived_behavior_preservation, PreservationCaseResult raises if anything tries to give it user provenance, and the contract's provenance_reference states in words that its expected value is what the unpatched code already produces and not a user requirement.

DOWNSTREAM COMPATIBILITY. defect_closure_status stays the field existing consumers read and is made truthful rather than reinterpreted: fixed_and_preserved records fixed, no oracle records the primary status unchanged, fixed_but_regressive records itself. core/execution_eligibility_policy.py is byte-identical - the regressive status falls through its existing else branch to BLOCK_POST_PROBE_NOT_FIXED/INELIGIBLE. VALIDATE.ORACLE gained one description branch and nothing else.

SAME SANDBOX. core/candidate_defect_probe.py gained an optional preservation_probes parameter that runs already-validated contracts against the same applied bytes the primary post-probe saw, and the fixed_but_regressive status. It never reads a preservation receipt; deriving meaning belongs to core/paired_defect_probe.py. With no preservation probes supplied it behaves exactly as before, which T1/T2/T3 and every unsupported subject exercise.

PATCH BASIS. A preservation regression prevents candidate closure and approval readiness only. The pre-patch reproduction is a fact about the repository, not about the candidate, so grounded_defect survives a regressive candidate untouched.

AUTHORITY DELTA ZERO. paired_probe_authority_effect=none. Neither fixed_and_preserved nor any other paired status grants human_review_eligible, write_authority, execution_authorized or auto-apply. Telemetry is additive and bounded: no source dumps, no confidence, no score, no authority field.

T6 DOGFOOD. The exact branch-reorder candidate measures primary expected 2space / baseline 4space / candidate 2space / fixed, preservation expected 4space / baseline 4space / candidate 2space / regressed, paired fixed_but_regressive, closure fixed_but_regressive, human_review_eligible false. The width-distinguishing fixture candidate measures fixed_and_preserved. Both run only in disposable sandboxes; real core/code_dna.py stays deliberately broken and byte-identical.

FROZEN BOUNDARIES. tests/fixtures/defect_probe_live3_frozen_boundaries.json pins by whole-file digest the probe execution engine and worker, BehavioralExpectation extraction, core/code_dna.py, every authority and eligibility surface, OPS.VALIDATE.3, patch basis and safety, CONTROL ranking, RETRIEVE recall and the sandbox/apply primitives, and pins by AST digest the DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.2 comparison-integrity rules. CONTROL.LOCALIZE.LIVE.2's whole-file digest for core/candidate_defect_probe.py was re-pinned; this fixture is the finer-grained invariant it carried.
SCOPE. No no-auto-patch candidate verification is begun here, no generic counter-case is invented for a future subject, and _classify_indent is not repaired.
REGISTRY NAMING. DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.3 is a direct live phase in the existing OPS track. It has no PLAN, READINESS or CLOSE siblings and is not report-only.
phases.summary: Live oracle fix for candidate defect closure. DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.2 asked one question of a candidate - does the bounded input the user's claim was adapted from now produce the value the user asked for - and the exact T6 branch-reorder candidate answers it correctly while destroying behavior that was already right: reversing the 4space/2space prefix branches makes the two-space fixture classify as 2space and the four-space fixture classify as 2space too, so the single expected-value probe reported fixed and EXEC.POLICY.LIVE.1 reached human_review_eligible. DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.3 adds core/paired_defect_probe.py, a subject adapter that maps a typed behavioral subject to zero or more deterministic preservation counter-cases. indentation_style is the only production subject, so it is the only entry: the counter-case is the collision partner the fact already exposes - the claimed observed_value probed at its own width through the SAME frozen _nested_indentation_fixture, expecting itself. A counter-case is only an oracle when the unpatched repository already satisfies it; a baseline that fails or reaches no verdict yields an explicit unavailable preservation status with a reason and is never counted as a regression. The two cases are represented separately and closed into paired_status: fixed_and_preserved, fixed (no oracle available), fixed_but_regressive, still_reproduced, changed_but_unresolved, inconclusive, invalid_comparison, unavailable. Only a fixed primary is qualified by preservation. Preservation expectations carry system_derived_behavior_preservation provenance and may never claim explicit_user_fact. The exact T6 wrong candidate now measures primary fixed, preservation regressed, paired fixed_but_regressive, closure fixed_but_regressive and human_review_eligible false; the width-distinguishing positive control measures fixed_and_preserved, so the oracle opens as well as it closes. Probe execution, BehavioralExpectation extraction, retrieval, CONTROL ranking, candidate authoring, safe_minimal, patch basis, validation and every authority setter stay frozen, core/defect_probe.py stays byte-identical, and _classify_indent stays deliberately broken.

notes: PRIMARY SUBJECT INVARIANT. For subject_kind=indentation_style, classification refers to the base indentation unit and not to the absolute number of leading spaces on any observed line. An indentation unit of 2 spaces covers depths 2, 4, 6, 8 and so on; a unit of 4 spaces covers 4, 8, 12, 16. A repository does not stop being 2-space because its acquired sample contains no line indented by exactly two spaces.

BOUNDED MATRIX, NOT PROPERTY TESTING. Four fixed cases for the one supported subject. No random values, no Hypothesis, no generated unbounded depth search, no combinatorial exploration, no generic test generation, no fuzzing. Case ids are stable and encode no temporary path, candidate fingerprint or run identifier.

CASE ROLES. primary_defect is the user's own claim and keeps explicit_user_fact provenance; defect_generalization and preservation_generalization are system_derived_subject_invariant; the original preservation case keeps DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.3's system_derived_behavior_preservation. A system-derived case may never be labelled as something the user stated, and the constructor refuses to build one that is.

DEPTH-ONLY MEANS DEPTH-ONLY. The 2space generalization sample is indented only at depths 3 and 4 (6 and 8 spaces) and the 4space sample only at depths 2 and 3 (8 and 12 spaces), so neither contains a line at exactly one indentation unit, and neither contains a line at the collision partner's unit either. This is pinned structurally in tests rather than trusted.

BASELINE SEMANTICS. The primary case remains the factual reproduction anchor for PATCH.BASIS.LIVE.1: observed 4space, expected 2space, reproduced. The 2space defect-generalization case also fails on the baseline, which is valid and creates no second user claim. Both preservation cases are satisfied by the baseline, which is what makes them oracles at all; a preservation case the baseline already fails is reported unavailable with its reason and never counted as a regression.

REDUCTION PRECEDENCE. Fixed and fail-closed: a preservation regression on a baseline-satisfied case, then no cases at all, then any required case with no verdict, then no defect case closed (still_reproduced or unresolved_matrix_failure by how the failures look), then some closed and some not (partially_fixed), and only a clean sweep reaches fixed_and_preserved. One passing case never speaks for another.

MEASURED ACCEPTANCE. The Round-8 ceiling candidate - which measures the leading-space width but recognises only a line indented by exactly one unit - reads fixed_and_preserved under the pre-LIVE.4 pair and fixed_but_regressive under the matrix: primary fixed, deep 2space changed_but_unresolved (None), ordinary 4space preserved, deep 4space regressed (None). The known inverted branch-reorder candidate stays fixed_but_regressive. The exact no-op candidate is still rejected by PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.1 before any sandbox or matrix work, and the matrix producer is never entered for it. A test-only unit-inferring positive control reaches fixed_and_preserved, so the oracle opens as well as closes.

ONE SANDBOX. Every case runs against the same applied candidate bytes in the single managed sandbox DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.2 creates, through the existing bounded static probe worker. The primary case's baseline and candidate observations are read off the closure receipt rather than re-executed, so the added cost is three companion baseline probes and three companion candidate probes and no second patch application.

FROZEN. safe_minimal, PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.1, DEFECT.FACT.LIVE.1 extraction, CONTROL.LOCALIZE.LIVE.2, RETRIEVE.LIVE.4, OPS.VALIDATE.3 targeted-validation budgets (3 files, 8 checks, selector, commands) and the EXEC.AUTH/POLICY/APPROVAL boundaries are untouched and pinned by whole-file digest in tests/fixtures/defect_probe_live4_frozen_boundaries.json. _classify_indent is not fixed here and the positive control is test-only, never applied to production and never made available to a model.

AUTHORITY. Matrix success or failure is verification evidence only. It cannot set write_authority, execution_authorized or approval_ready, and CANDIDATE.VERIFY / EXEC.POLICY / EXEC.APPROVAL boundaries are unchanged. No execution authority, no model call, no network call, no repository traversal.

SCOPE. T1/T2/T3 keep current probe and validation behavior with no extra probes for unrelated defect types; T4's explicit-change path is unchanged and builds no matrix; T5 analysis_only is unchanged. PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.2 is deliberately not begun here: the verifier had to be able to reject the measured oracle-overfitting candidate first.
phases.summary: Round-8 black-box evidence established a concrete ceiling in the DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.3 two-case behavioral oracle for the indentation_style subject. A measured candidate passes the ordinary nested 2-space case (expected 2space, observed 2space) and the ordinary nested 4-space preservation case (expected 4space, observed 4space), and still classifies nothing at all when the sample's indentation begins only at depth >= 3 for 2space or depth >= 2 for 4space. fixed_and_preserved under the two-point oracle was therefore not sufficiently discriminating: the oracle was measuring absolute indentation depth where the subject invariant is the base indentation unit, so 2, 4, 6, 8 all belong to one style and a repository does not stop being 2-space because its acquired sample carries no line indented by exactly two spaces. This phase widens that oracle and nothing else. A new pure module core/behavioral_matrix.py builds one bounded deterministic four-case matrix for the single supported subject: indentation_style.primary.2space (primary_defect, explicit_user_fact), indentation_style.generalize.2space.deep (defect_generalization, system_derived_subject_invariant), indentation_style.preserve.4space (preservation, system_derived_behavior_preservation - DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.3's own case, byte-identical) and indentation_style.preserve.4space.deep (preservation_generalization, system_derived_subject_invariant). No random values, no Hypothesis, no generated depth search, no combinatorial exploration: the depth-only shapes are derived as the shallowest bounded depth pair whose widths land on neither unit the typed fact names, which reproduces exactly the depths Round 8 measured. Ordinary cases keep going through the frozen constructors so their bytes cannot drift, and the depth-selectable fixture primitive reproduces core.defect_probe._nested_indentation_fixture byte-for-byte at every supported width. Reduction is closed and fail-closed in a fixed order: a preservation regression on a baseline-satisfied case, then missing verdicts, then how the unclosed defect cases look, and only a clean sweep reaches fixed_and_preserved; partially_fixed exists so a candidate that satisfies the user's own claim and fails its own subject invariant cannot be rounded up to fixed. CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 consumes the matrix reduction where matrix evidence is bound to the exact candidate, and every subject without a matrix keeps DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.3's paired semantics unchanged. One candidate sandbox, the existing static probe worker, the existing candidate fingerprint primitive; safe_minimal, targeted-validation budgets, BehavioralExpectation extraction, RETRIEVE, CONTROL and every authority boundary are untouched, _classify_indent is not repaired, and no model call, network call or repository traversal is added.
phases.title: Depth-Variant Behavioral Discrimination Matrix

notes: THE CEILING IS MEASURED, NOT HYPOTHESISED. The Round-9 substance is reconstructed from the captured provider response and run through the behavioral oracle as a test candidate, independently of its malformed revision envelope. Pre-LIVE.5 it reaches fixed_and_preserved on the four LIVE.4 cases; post-LIVE.5 those same four still pass, the skew case returns 4space against an expected 2space, and the matrix reduces to partially_fixed. That red/green pair over identical candidate bytes, identical contract and identical repository is the primary proof and it is a test, not a claim.

THE EXPECTATION IS DERIVABLE FROM THE SOURCE, AND THE CODE ENFORCES IT. skew_consistent_units returns the members of the subject's classification vocabulary that divide the fixture's own widths. For two spaces only 2 survives, so 2space is the single answer the shape admits; for four spaces both 2 and 4 survive, because a four-space line is equally consistent with a two-space style indented twice. The adapter requires the case only in the unambiguous direction and omits it in the other rather than deciding it by preference, which is why the 4space mirror is a control test and the production matrix is not enlarged for symmetry. No style guide, PEP 8, internet knowledge, repository convention or user preference is consulted anywhere.

FIVE BAD CANDIDATES, FIVE DIFFERENT REJECTIONS, AND THE SEPARATION IS PINNED. An exact no-op never reaches the matrix at all - PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.1 rejects it at mutation-effect for zero probes and zero sandboxes. The inverted reorder regresses the ordinary 4space preservation case. The Round-8 ceiling classifies neither depth-only sample. The Round-9 candidate fails only the distribution-skew case. The unit-inferring control passes all five. Each of those four rejections names a different case, which is what makes the matrix a diagnostic rather than a single pass/fail bit.

THE ORACLE IS NEVER SOLUTION-AWARE. Nothing in core/behavioral_matrix.py reads candidate bytes: the module references no ast, inspect, compile, exec, eval or tokenize, and contains none of the words gcd, lstrip, histogram, divisor, modulo or most_common. A test runs a deliberately odd implementation - a while loop counting columns, then a hand-rolled smallest-then-divisibility check - and it passes on behavior alone. No implementation hint is synthesized for any author: the revision request may learn that a candidate returned 4space for this required case and may not learn to use GCD, to measure the minimum width or to stop voting by frequency.

ONE SANDBOX, TWO ADDED PROBES. The fifth case is another bounded input to the existing execution primitive. core/defect_probe.py, the defect probe worker and sandbox execution semantics are byte-identical and pinned; the matrix still creates exactly one applied candidate sandbox, still reuses the primary case's pre-patch baseline rather than re-probing it, and the cost delta is one baseline probe plus one candidate probe. All five cases bind to the same candidate fingerprint, the same target binding and the same original-source digest, with no new fingerprint primitive.

THE ONLY PRODUCTION CHANGE IS THE MATRIX MODULE, AND THE CONTAINMENT IS REVERSIBLE. core/behavioral_matrix.py went from 18 to 21 top-level definitions: three added (indentation_skew_fixture, skew_consistent_units, _skew_contract), none removed, three changed (_indentation_matrix_cases for the appended case, BehavioralMatrixReceipt for the additive discrimination_phase_ids field, behavioral_matrix_guardrails for three new flags). tests/fixtures/defect_probe_live5_frozen_boundaries.json ships the nine reversal hunks, so a test reconstructs the pre-phase file from the shipped one and asserts its sha256 equals the digest PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.1 pinned - the re-pin is a proof rather than a bumped hash. core/pipeline.py and core/candidate_verification.py are frozen: there is no Round-9 branch anywhere.

SCHEMA VERSION IS DELIBERATELY NOT BUMPED. Inspection first: schema_version in this repository tags structural wire shape, and the precedent that proves it is core/content_acquisition.py, where a receipt whose schema_version does not match refuses to construct. Nothing validates or branches on behavioral_matrix_live_4_v1, and this phase removes no field and changes no field's type - it adds an entry to a list that was always variable-length, plus one additive discrimination_phase_ids key inside the one canonical structure. So the version stays, a stored LIVE.4 receipt is not reinterpreted, and phase visibility is carried by data instead: case_count 5, the new case id, and discrimination_phase_ids naming DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.4 and DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.5. No duplicate telemetry subtree and no second LIVE.5-specific receipt.

EVERYTHING FROZEN STAYED FROZEN. safe_minimal keeps its builtin and member policy, its local novelty caps and its identifier classification, and lstrip is still not allowed - the known unit-inferring local-only candidate remains sufficient to prove the task is expressible. Targeted validation keeps its 3-file cap, its 8-node-per-check cap, its selector, its commands and its timeout/budget. PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.1's authoring logic is unchanged: the new failing case simply appears in CandidateRevisionEvidence.failed_cases with its case_id, role, provenance, expected, candidate_observed and status, which is the mechanism that already existed.

REGISTRY NAMING. DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.5 is an implementation slice inside the existing OPS track alongside DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.1 through .4. DEFECT.* remains a phase-id namespace only, adding no track and no schema dimension, so core/phase_registry.py needed no edit.

KNOWN LIMITATION: ONE SUBJECT, AND NOW ONE MORE SHAPE OF IT. indentation_style is still the only production subject with a matrix, so the discrimination this phase adds generalizes to no other defect family yet. A subject without an adapter keeps DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.3's paired semantics exactly as they were.

KNOWN LIMITATION: THE SKEW CASE IS ONE-DIRECTIONAL BY CONSTRUCTION. A fact claiming the larger width - 4-space misclassified as 2-space - gets four cases rather than five, because [4, 8, 8] admits both vocabulary units and an ambiguous case would have to be decided by something outside the source. That is the honest answer rather than a gap to paper over, and widening the vocabulary is what would change it.

KNOWN LIMITATION: THE REVISION SCHEMA BUG IS STILL OPEN. Round 9 also established that the revision prompt does not include the normal patch candidate output contract, so Candidate1 came back in a malformed envelope. That is a real authoring bug and it is deliberately not fixed here; this phase reconstructs the candidate's substance to measure it and leaves the envelope alone. The next planned phase is PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.2 - Self-Contained Authoring Contract Parity.
phases.summary: Round 9 authored a revised candidate that passes every one of DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.4's four behavioral cases and still does not infer the base indentation unit. Its substance measures the real leading width of each line and then votes on the absolute width - indent % 4 == 0 scores 4space, indent % 2 == 0 scores 2space - so it is right whenever the correct width family happens to hold a majority, which every LIVE.4 fixture gave it. A deterministic diagnostic found the smallest shape where it does not: one line at one indentation unit and two at two, positive widths [2, 4, 4], true unit 2, absolute-width votes 4space two to 2space one. Baseline 4space, Candidate1 4space, expected 2space, and the existing unit-inferring positive control 2space. That is the measured ceiling this phase closes: the base indentation unit is not the most frequent classified absolute indentation width. The production matrix for indentation_style goes from four bounded cases to exactly five - primary 2space, deep-only 2space generalization, ordinary 4space preservation, deep-only 4space preservation generalization, and the new indentation_style.generalize.2space.skew, role defect_generalization, provenance system_derived_subject_invariant - a system-derived generalization of the defect behavior, not a second user claim - expected 2space. The four LIVE.4 case ids, contracts and positions are untouched and the fifth is appended, never inserted. Its fixture is real parseable Python built by the same width-times-depth arithmetic as the frozen generator, with the line bodies made structural: a function holding a branch holding two assignments, ast.parse succeeds, min positive width 2, width 2 present, count(4) greater than count(2), every width divisible by 2, max depth 2, exactly three indented lines and nesting changing by at most one level per adjacent structural step. The expectation is derived from the bounded source and nothing else: within the subject's own classification vocabulary a base unit must divide every indentation width present, 4 does not divide 2, so an actual two-space witness leaves 2space as the only value the sample admits. skew_consistent_units enforces that, which is why the mirrored [4, 8, 8] shape - where both 2 and 4 survive - is a regression control here and never a required production case. No ratio ladder, no 1:3 or 1:4 variant, no randomized or generated case, no property testing, no search. The Round-9 candidate is now partially_fixed rather than fixed_and_preserved and CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 rejects it for subject_invariant_not_closed through the integration LIVE.4 already built; the unit-inferring control passes all five and stays fixed_and_preserved. The five known bad candidates still fail for five different reasons: exact no-op at mutation-effect before any matrix work, inverted reorder at preservation regression, Round-8 ceiling at the depth variants, Round-9 at distribution skew. One candidate sandbox for the whole matrix, one added baseline probe and one added candidate probe, the same candidate fingerprint and target binding on every case, and no change to core/defect_probe.py, the probe worker, sandbox execution semantics, candidate authoring, safe_minimal, targeted validation, CONTROL, RETRIEVE or any authority module. No model call, no network call, no repository traversal. The oracle inspects behavior only and never candidate implementation text, so a strange implementation producing the correct bounded behavior still passes. _classify_indent is not fixed, and no execution authority is granted: passing all five cases leaves execution_authorized, write_authority, approval_ready and human_review_eligible exactly where they were.
phases.title: Distribution-Skew Indentation Unit Discrimination

notes: PRIMARY STATE MACHINE. human_review_eligible, human_approval_received, execution_authorized, execution_attempted and patch_applied are separate facts. eligible != approved, approved != authorized and authorized != persisted.

EXACT HUMAN ACTION. The existing Apply / Review Patch button emits human_action_kind=apply plus the candidate and eligibility receipt fingerprints from the displayed immutable review receipt. Opening a candidate, viewing a diff, continuing chat, model confidence or human_review_eligible=true creates no approval.

CANDIDATE AND RECEIPT BINDING. HumanApplyReviewReceipt and HumanApplyAuthorization are frozen typed records. C1 approval cannot authorize C2, and bounded review requires the exact eligible bounded_evidence_human_review assessment fingerprint rather than a missing, legacy or unassessed receipt.

FRESHNESS REVALIDATION. Apply derives the canonical repository identity again and re-digests only candidate targets plus known probe/selected-check source paths recorded at review. An unrelated file does not invalidate the receipt; an unreadable binding fails conservatively. There is no repository traversal or whole-repository hash.

PATCH SAFETY. The existing core.patch_safety gate runs at the human Apply boundary and its verdict is candidate/repository/path-bound. A human action cannot bypass a blocked or mismatched verdict, the refusal keeps the route's established safety-gate wording and the gate's own reasons, and the existing lifecycle chokepoint still runs before the executor.

PRE-MUTATION AUTHORIZATION. The route constructs an authorized HumanApplyAuthorization before calling Executor or run_patch_plan_with_artifacts. Multi-file lifecycle persistence writes human_apply_authorization.json before apply_patch_plan is called, proving authorization precedes mutation rather than being recorded retroactively.

AUTHORITY SOURCE. Successful manual application reuses EXEC.AUTH.LIVE.1's manual_apply_action vocabulary. Approval remains authority only; it is never fed backward into CLAIM, PATCH.BASIS, defect evidence, validation evidence or model prompts.

DENIAL VOCABULARY. The closed reasons are not_human_review_eligible, approval_missing, candidate_mismatch, eligibility_receipt_stale, source_state_stale, patch_safety_mismatch, repository_identity_mismatch, policy_profile_mismatch and inconsistent_input.

COMPATIBILITY. T1/T2/T3 auto flows are unchanged and never routed through human review. T4 explicit_change_manual_review uses exact candidate/repository/source/safety binding but requires no DEFECT.PROBE or bounded eligibility receipt. Old non-bounded manual artifacts remain usable through an explicit legacy compatibility marker; old grounded-defect artifacts cannot bypass the new bounded receipt.

EXECUTION OUTCOME. Human approval authorizes an attempt, not persistence. Existing execution-time validation remains in force; failure rolls back through OPS.PATCH.1 and reports authorized=true, attempted=true, mutation_observed=true, rollback=true and final_repository_changed=false.

PERSISTENCE AND FOLLOW-UP. The pre-execution receipt is stored in replay artifacts before mutation. The terminal authorization and EXEC.AUTH outcome update the existing web session patch/history surface, so a click alone is never rendered as applied.

T6 DOGFOOD. The exact _classify_indent candidate is first applied in an isolated repository fixture with an eligible bounded receipt, fresh candidate/repository/source/safety bindings and manual_apply_action authorization. Stale source, C1/C2 mismatch, ineligible policy and safety-blocked variants remain non-mutating. The real _classify_indent remains intentionally broken until all isolated and broad acceptance checks are green.

DELTAS. Zero model calls, Zero network calls, no repository traversal, no retrieval or evidence producer rerun, and no bounded auto-apply. Only existing execution-time validation remains. Authorization/freshness overhead is bounded to deterministic hashing, one identity derivation, one existing safety evaluation and known-path digests, negligible relative to patch execution.
REGISTRY NAMING. EXEC.APPROVAL.LIVE.1 is a direct live phase in the existing OPS track with sole prerequisite EXEC.POLICY.LIVE.1. It has no PLAN, READINESS or CLOSE siblings and is not report-only.
phases.summary: Live human authority boundary that binds the existing explicit Apply action to the exact candidate and review receipt shown to the human. The bounded_evidence_human_review route requires an eligible, current EXEC.POLICY.LIVE.1 assessment and revalidates candidate identity, eligibility receipt identity, canonical repository identity, bounded known-path source state, probe/check bindings and the existing patch-safety verdict before creating a typed pre-mutation authorization with authority_source=manual_apply_action. Stale, mismatched, ineligible and safety-blocked actions remain non-mutating. T4 explicit-change review uses the same exact Apply boundary without acquiring defect-evidence prerequisites; legacy non-bounded artifacts keep their established manual semantics. T1/T2/T3 automatic execution policy is unchanged. This adds no bounded auto-apply, model call, network call, repository traversal or evidence/validation generation, and is not report-only: successful authorization enters the existing real executor and preserves its validation and rollback policy.

notes: Three subjects, never collapsed. Component authority asks whether this component may authorize a write - CONTROL: no, WAITER: no, patch basis: no - and is what write_authority, patch_application_authority and the planning-stage human_approval_required have always answered. Execution authorization asks whether a later runtime gate permitted this exact mutation, and which one. Execution fact asks what was attempted, what moved and what survived. execution_authorized=true never implies patch_applied=true, and execution_attempted=true never implies bytes remain on disk.

No field was redefined. write_authority=false in a historical artifact still means the component could not authorize writes; it is not reinterpreted as no write happened. authority_scope=control_or_planning names that subject out loud beside the old fields, and every new fact lives under a new key, so old artifacts stay loadable and semantically readable exactly as written.

The authorization decision points are exactly two in the automatic path, both inside core.pipeline.maybe_run_auto_patch and both unchanged: plan_policy.auto_apply_allowed immediately before run_patch_plan_with_artifacts, and policy.auto_apply_allowed or the is_low_risk_single_file_patch override immediately before run_self_correct_loop. Authorization is read where it was already made; no new gate, token or approval mechanism was introduced.

Observation never authorizes. CHECK.LIVE.1's digest_known_paths and derive_observed_change_records are reused to say what happened, after the fact, over the paths the operation already named. No CHECK.LIVE shadow verdict was promoted into execution authority, no frozen CHECK.1 semantics were altered, and causality is not reversed.

Bounded observation scope is declared, not hidden. final_state_observation reports plan_named_paths when every named path was typed, incomplete when one could not be, and unavailable when no digest could be taken; the executor's own receipt answers in the latter two cases and the payload says so. No repository traversal, git status scan, index build or graph walk was added for telemetry.

Telemetry is derived, never self-reported. The factual sources are the policy object that made the decision, the executor's typed result (applied_ops, rollback_performed, ExecutionResult.phase and validation_outcome), the bounded observed-change records, and the OPS.VALIDATE.1 categorical outcome. Model prose claiming a patch was applied is not consulted anywhere, and worker declarations are not used to decide whether mutation occurred, so WORKER.DECL.2B stays parked.

Authority monotonicity holds. AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED=false, a read-only route, patch safety, CTX.PATCH/CTX.APPLY, needs_escalation, confidence thresholds and human approval all remain absolute denials, and each is recorded as a typed execution_authorization_denied_reason rather than being widened. Sandbox validation passing (OPS.PATCH.2), a legitimate patch_basis (PATCH.BASIS.LIVE.1) and model confidence remain non-authorizing by construction.

Execution behaviour delta is zero. With the telemetry ignored or deleted, every decision to apply, refuse, validate or roll back is byte-for-byte the same; the phase reconciles facts, not behaviour. Zero model calls, zero network calls, no timeout re-categorisation - the typed validation fact is reported exactly as OPS.VALIDATE.1 currently produces it, leaving OPS.VALIDATE.2 the next phase.
EXEC.* is an ID namespace inside the existing OPS track, following the PATCH.* precedent. No registry track was added and no schema field grew.

Known gap: core.pipeline.execute_subtask (mission-mode subtask apply) calls the Executor directly and produces a subtask record rather than the operator-visible run payload; it is left uncovered rather than given telemetry that would have no reader.
phases.summary: Live production truthfulness fix for the separate black-box finding that T1/T2/T3 runs genuinely rewrote repository files, passed validation and left the bytes on disk while the final operator-visible payload still reported write_authority=false, patch_application_authority=false and human_approval_required=true. None of those fields was wrong; all three answer a different question. They are written by core.control_engine.enforce_control_grounding_on_payload and core.pipeline._record_patch_safety_handoff, and their subject is CONTROL and the candidate it hands on, not the mutation a later gate authorized. So they are preserved verbatim and given an explicit authority_scope=control_or_planning, and three subjects are now reported separately: component authority (unchanged), execution authorization (execution_authorized, execution_authority_source, human_approval_required_for_execution) and execution fact (execution_attempted, mutation_observed, patch_applied, application_status, rollback_performed, final_repository_changed, final_validation_outcome). The authority-source vocabulary is a closed enum of gates that actually exist in production - grounded_defect_auto_apply_policy (policy.auto_apply_allowed), low_risk_grounded_single_file_policy (core.pipeline.is_low_risk_single_file_patch) and manual_apply_action - and a typed dataclass refuses the collapses the field test produced: authorized does not imply attempted, attempted does not imply applied, and applied requires the change to survive on disk with no rollback. final_repository_changed is derived from CHECK.LIVE.1's bounded before/after digests of exactly the paths the operation names, falling back to the executor's own receipt and saying so when a path could not be typed; a run whose writes were rolled back reports final_repository_changed=false, and an executor that succeeds without changing bytes reports application_status=no_op rather than applied. Both apply paths are covered - multi-file patch_plan and the single-file Executor/self-correct loop - plus the human Dream apply action, and every non-executing route (analysis, clarification, wrong target, harmful test candidate, explicit change awaiting approval, AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED=false, harness-blocked) records why nothing was attempted. Candidate sandbox validation, patch basis and model confidence remain non-authorizing. No authorization policy, patch-safety rule, auto-apply rule, human-approval rule, execution behaviour, retrieval, indexing, traversal, timeout semantics, model call or network call was changed, no historical field was removed or redefined, and this is not report-only.

notes: PRIMARY DISTINCTION. Evidence facts, named policy eligibility and execution authorization are separate typed subjects. policy_eligible=true != execution_authorized=true. human_review_eligible=true is not human approval, and no field in this phase grants execution or patch application authority.

PROFILES. full_validation_required is eligible only when the existing required full-repository outcome is passed; failed, inconclusive and unavailable are ineligible. bounded_evidence_human_review is a human-review-only profile and no bounded_auto_apply or user risk-budget profile exists.

PURE REDUCER. core.execution_eligibility_policy.evaluate_execution_eligibility consumes mappings of existing receipts only. It has no filesystem, graph, subprocess, model, network, probe, validation or retrieval operation. Pipeline timing surrounds the pure call without changing its deterministic assessment.

CLOSED VOCABULARIES. Status is eligible, ineligible, insufficient_evidence or inconsistent_input. Requirements and blocking reasons are validated closed IDs, with no confidence or hidden reasoning. Old artifacts without a receipt read as legacy_unassessed, never eligible.

FULL VALIDATION. A completed genuine failure blocks the bounded profile and cannot be overridden by targeted evidence. Only inconclusive plus category=validation_budget_exhausted is accepted as full_validation_budget_exhausted; missing_tool, invalid_command, unsupported environment and sandbox failure are not accepted. The full-validation fact remains inconclusive and the repository is never described as validated.

TARGETED FAILURES. targeted_validation=failed remains failed. It may coexist with bounded human-review eligibility only when the baseline passed, evidence is unmodified and fresh, every failed relevant selected check has a current candidate/probe/check-set-bound assessment, and every such failure is defect_preservation_oracle. The conflict is recorded in accepted_evidence_conflicts rather than converted to a pass.

REGRESSION AND CONFLICTS. Any failed candidate_regression_oracle is ineligible. conflict_unresolved, insufficient_basis, unrelated-but-possibly-regressive, per-check outcome uncertainty or missing assessment is insufficient evidence and cannot be ignored. Candidate-modified or selected_validation_check_modified evidence is a hard invalid block.

IDENTITY AND FRESHNESS. Patch-safety, DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.2, OPS.VALIDATE.3 and VALIDATE.ORACLE candidate fingerprints must equal the exact candidate. Pre/closure/oracle probe fingerprints and targeted/oracle check-set fingerprints must match. Existing source digests and explicit repository_identity_mismatch categories fail stale/inconsistent rather than combining evidence from different states.

PATCH SAFETY. Existing core.patch_safety remains a hard gate for both profiles. The live adapter binds its already-computed verdict to the current candidate at the handoff; blocked, refused or independently safety-denied execution cannot be rehabilitated by probe, targeted or oracle evidence.

AUTHORITY DELTA ZERO. The live reducer runs only on the existing non-authorizing grounded-defect human-review handoff, after execution_authorized=false and human_approval_required_for_execution=true are already recorded. Its telemetry says authority_effect=none and auto_apply_effect=none, and no authorization branch consumes human_review_eligible.

T6. The exact _classify_indent candidate is applied only in managed disposable sandboxes. Pre-probe reproduced 4space, the same post-probe observed expected 2space/fixed, targeted baseline passed, candidate targeted validation failed, and both failed unchanged tests were defect_preservation_oracle. The strict profile is ineligible, bounded human review is eligible, execution remains unauthorized, auto apply false, patch_applied false and real core/code_dna.py byte-identical.

COMPATIBILITY. T1/T2/T3 meaningful full-validation paths do not enter the bounded handoff. T4 explicit_change keeps OPS.PATCH.2 plus human approval and receives no defect policy. T5 analysis and no-patch-basis/no-candidate routes do not invent eligibility. AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED, manual Apply, CHECK/WORKER, CTX, ANSWER.GROUND and retrieval semantics are unchanged.

DELTAS. Zero model calls, network calls, repository or graph traversals, validation calls, retrieval calls and authority widening are added by the evaluator. It is effectively negligible beside existing probes/tests, and _classify_indent remains intentionally broken in the real repository.

REGISTRY NAMING. EXEC.POLICY.LIVE.1 is a direct live policy phase in the existing OPS track with sole prerequisite VALIDATE.ORACLE.LIVE.1. It has no EXEC.POLICY.PLAN, EXEC.POLICY.READINESS or EXEC.POLICY.CLOSE siblings.
phases.summary: Live deterministic policy reduction over immutable evidence produced by CONTROL.SAFETY.LIVE.1, WAITER.LIVE.1, PATCH.BASIS.LIVE.1, OPS.PATCH.1/.2, OPS.VALIDATE.1/.2/.3, EXEC.AUTH.LIVE.1, RETRIEVE.LIVE.1/.2/.3, ANSWER.GROUND.LIVE.1, DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.1/.2 and VALIDATE.ORACLE.LIVE.1. The closed profiles full_validation_required and bounded_evidence_human_review preserve evidence facts exactly while deciding only eligibility. full_validation_required accepts only outcome=passed. The bounded human-review profile accepts full-validation inconclusive only for validation_budget_exhausted when an independently grounded pre-probe reproduced, the same immutable probe is fixed by the exact sandboxed candidate, patch safety passed, candidate/probe/check-set/source bindings are fresh, targeted evidence is valid, and every failed selected check has a current defect_preservation_oracle assessment. Genuine full-suite failure, candidate_regression_oracle, unresolved or insufficient-basis failures, tampered checks, model-only oracle provenance, stale fingerprints, repository mismatch, unsafe candidates and unfixed probes fail closed. eligible never means execution_authorized, human_review_eligible never means approved, and the phase grants no auto-apply or write authority. It adds no model, network, traversal, validation or retrieval call and is not report-only because its live typed result changes truthful human-review eligibility presentation without authorizing mutation.

notes: SIGNATURE EVOLUTION, NOT A FIX. _classify_indent(text, *, language: str | None = None) -> Optional[str]. language is keyword-only so no accidental positional caller silently changes meaning; the body is byte-identical to before this phase apart from the signature and docstring line, and ignores language completely. The known T6 defect (2-space source misread as 4-space) reproduces identically whether language is omitted, None, 'python', or anything else.

LANGUAGE BELONGS TO THE WALKED FILE, NEVER THE CLASSIFIER'S OWN FILE. compute_dna's new _language_for_suffix(suffix) reuses config.LANGUAGE_MAP -- the same authoritative table _code_extensions() already reads -- so a .go file is declared 'go' even while being classified by a function defined in a .py file. No suffix inference happens inside _classify_indent itself; compute_dna alone decides language, exactly as before this phase for every other per-file decision it already makes.

REPAIR SEAM: AVAILABLE, NOT ACTIVATED. core/code_dna.py imports core.indentation_observation.observe_source_indentation and .assess_indentation_observation at module scope -- unused by the current body, and proved unused by a monkeypatch that raises AssertionError if either name is called during a real _classify_indent invocation. No duplicated tokenizer or GCD logic anywhere in core/code_dna.py; core/indentation_observation.py remains the one semantic authority, byte-identical to INDENT.SEMANTICS.1's shipped version.

EVERY CANDIDATE CONTRACT NOW CARRIES LANGUAGE. build_python_function_probe gained a generic kwargs parameter with no indentation-specific special-casing; omitting it reproduces the prior exact wire shape for every other caller in the repository. The four indentation-contract construction sites (core/defect_probe.py's build_probe_contract_from_behavior_fact, core/paired_defect_probe.py's _indentation_preservation_cases, core/behavioral_matrix.py's _depth_only_contract/_skew_contract/_declared_input_cases) each pass kwargs={'language': ...} using the language already fixed or already threaded at that call site -- never a second guess. core/defect_probe_worker.py needed zero changes: _run_python_function already does function(*args, **kwargs). Probe fingerprints differ by declared language alone because identity_payload already echoes structured_input in full.

EXPRESSIBILITY PROOF: REJECTED, HONESTLY. A test-only candidate (return assess_indentation_observation(observe_source_indentation(text, language=language)).value) passes all eight matrix cases in-process. Run through the real, unmodified patch_gates._enforce_safe_minimal with the same target function and the same source-visible names a real patch would have: REJECTED, reason novel_external_reference, blocking_reasons [novel_external_reference, unresolved_novel_identifier], novel_identifiers [assess_indentation_observation, observe_source_indentation, language, value]. T6_REPAIR_EXPRESSIBLE_UNDER_CURRENT_POLICY = false. safe_minimal itself was not modified, loosened, or even inspected for a workaround.

THE BLOCKER IS PARTLY STRUCTURAL, NOT ONLY THE REPAIR SEAM. A second, minimal probe -- a body that only does `if language == 'python': return None` before falling through to the unchanged legacy body, with zero repair-seam calls -- is independently rejected the same way: unresolved_novel_identifier, novel_identifiers=['language']. safe_minimal's allowed-identifier set is built only from target_snippet, the function BODY text captured without its `def` line, so language -- the parameter this very phase added to the signature -- is invisible to the gate the instant a patch merely uses it. This is recorded as a blocker for a future policy phase to evaluate, not solved here: solving it would be exactly the safe_minimal widening this phase is explicitly forbidden from doing.

FROZEN-BOUNDARY MAINTENANCE, NOT RE-PINNING. indent_semantics1_frozen_boundaries.json's own note states its values are never re-pinned. This phase's evidence lives entirely in a new reversal receipt, tests/fixtures/indent_runtime1_reversal.json (schema indent_runtime1_reversal_v1, four files, difflib.get_grouped_opcodes(3) hunks on raw decoded bytes), prepended to tests/_harness_maintenance.py::LATER_RECEIPTS. Every existing frozen-boundary test already routed through before_later_receipts/before_harness_remediation sees through this phase's edits without modification. Two of INDENT.SEMANTICS.1's own tests that read core/behavioral_matrix.py's raw bytes directly (a pre-existing gap, not introduced here) were updated to route through the same helper; an index-0-specific LATER_RECEIPTS ordering assertion was replaced with a relative-order check that survives every future phase's own prepend, not just this one's.

A REAL REGRESSION, FOUND AND FIXED. build_probe_contract_from_behavior_fact and _indentation_preservation_cases are shared, generic adapters also used against an arbitrary indentation classifier CONTROL localizes in a real user's own repository, not only against core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent -- proved by existing fixtures that build probes against a hand-written classify_indent() with no language parameter. Unconditionally adding the language kwarg at construction time broke those (inconclusive instead of reproduced). Fixed in core/defect_probe_worker.py::_run_python_function: checks inspect.signature(function).bind(*args, **kwargs) before calling, falls back to function(*args) on TypeError, so every existing generic-target test keeps working exactly as before while core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent receives language.

TWO SNAPSHOT CONVENTIONS, ONE ANSWER. This repository tests candidates against safe_minimal with target_snippet built two different ways: body-only (this phase's own suite and tests/test_indent_semantics1.py) and full-function-source-with-signature (tests/test_patch_minimal_novelty_live.py's T6_TARGET/_with_body). Under body-only, the bare `language` parameter is itself flagged unresolved_novel_identifier, independent of the repair seam. Under full-source, `language` is already present in target_snippet's own text and is not flagged; only the two repair-seam names remain novel. Both conventions were measured rather than one assumed, and both land on the same overall verdict: rejected, novel_external_reference. T6_REPAIR_EXPRESSIBLE_UNDER_CURRENT_POLICY = false either way.

A CAUGHT LINE-ENDING TRAP. Editing core/code_dna.py (mixed 276 CRLF / 71 LF lines) silently normalized the whole file to uniform CRLF as a side effect of an unrelated string edit -- the exact failure mode [[cattus-phase-workflow]] recorded on a different file during INDENT.SEMANTICS.1. Caught immediately by comparing CRLF/LF line counts before and after each edit, and repaired with a content-preserving restore (reuse each unchanged line's original terminator; new lines keep the file's dominant CRLF) before any digest was computed or pinned, so the shipped diff is exactly the intended semantic change.

FROZEN: _classify_indent's algorithm, compute_dna's per-file loop logic besides the one-line language transport, core/indentation_observation.py, safe_minimal and its novelty policy, PATCH.AUTHOR's prompts and contract, ANSWER.COHERENCE presentation, targeted validation's file/check caps, execution authority (EXEC.POLICY/APPROVAL/AUTH.LIVE.1), CONTROL routing and retrieval ranking code, and every id/role/provenance/expected-value/fixture-byte of the eight-case matrix. A real functional regression was found and fixed along the way: build_probe_contract_from_behavior_fact and core/paired_defect_probe.py's _indentation_preservation_cases are shared, generic adapters CONTROL also uses against an arbitrary indentation classifier in a real user's own repository, not only against core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent -- proved by existing fixtures in tests/test_paired_defect_probe.py and tests/test_defect_fact_live.py that build probes against a hand-written classify_indent() with no language parameter. Unconditionally adding kwargs={'language': ...} at construction time broke those (the worker called an arbitrary target with an unexpected keyword and the probe came back inconclusive). Fixed in core/defect_probe_worker.py::_run_python_function, which now checks inspect.signature(function).bind(*args, **kwargs) before calling and falls back to function(*args) when the real target does not accept the extra keyword -- checked via signature binding, never a bare call-and-catch, so a TypeError the target's own logic raises is never mistaken for an unsupported keyword and silently retried. The expressibility proof (Section 7 of this phase's design doc) measures two different target_snippet conventions this repository already uses for candidate testing: body-only (tests/test_indent_semantics1.py's and this phase's own convention) and full-function-source-with-signature (tests/test_patch_minimal_novelty_live.py's T6_TARGET/_with_body convention). Under body-only, language itself is also flagged novel (unresolved_novel_identifier) because target_snippet never includes the def line; under full-source, language is already present in target_snippet's own text and is not flagged. Either way the overall verdict is unchanged: rejected, novel_external_reference, because the two repair-seam names remain genuinely novel under both conventions. T6_REPAIR_EXPRESSIBLE_UNDER_CURRENT_POLICY = false either way. Fixing the regression surfaced three more legitimately-superseded assertions in earlier phases' own suites, none of them previously routed through the before_later_receipts/before_harness_remediation chain (a pre-existing gap, not introduced here, made visible because this is the first phase since those suites shipped to touch these files again): tests/test_defect_fact_live.py's test_probe_execution_surface_is_pinned_ast_identical (DEFECT.FACT.LIVE.1) read core/defect_probe.py's raw bytes directly against a function-level pin; tests/test_answer_coherence_live1.py's test_the_real_classify_indent_is_untouched (ANSWER.COHERENCE.LIVE.1) compared live inspect.getsource(_classify_indent) against a Round-10 recorded snapshot; both now route through before_later_receipts, with the reconstructed CRLF text normalized to LF to match how each pin was originally captured via read_text() -- the opposite-direction sibling of the usual CRLF trap. tests/test_patch_minimal_novelty_live.py's SIGNATURE_CHANGE_SOURCE built its candidate by string-replacing the old, now-nonexistent signature literal, a silent no-op that turned three tests' 'reject a signature change' scenario into an unrelated 'reject a body change' scenario; fixed to search for the live target's own current first line instead of a stale hardcoded string.
phases.title: Language Context Transport & Repair Boundary

notes: OBSERVATION IS NOT ASSESSMENT. SourceIndentationObservation records what was seen, by which observer and how strongly; SourceIndentationAssessment reads it into the closed vocabulary 2space, 4space, tab or None and keeps the observation, so a structural 4space and a heuristic 4space are different evidence and never collapse into one untyped value.

LANGUAGE BELONGS TO THE INPUT. A case declares the language of the text it hands the function under test. It is never inferred from the target file: core/code_dna.py is Python, and _classify_indent still classifies Go, TypeScript and HTML for compute_dna. The Go case targets core/code_dna.py and is observed as go, heuristic_physical, language_not_python. Tokenizer acceptance is not evidence of Python - HTML tokenizes into INDENT events that mirror its markup - so only declared python input reaches tokenize.

PYTHON STRUCTURAL OBSERVER. stdlib tokenize, not ast: ast cannot parse four of the five historical fixtures, which tokenize reads. INDENT carries the absolute prefix of a new level; the step is the suffix it adds to its parent's prefix, from a stack popped on every DEDENT, so levels 0, 4, 8 are the steps 4 and 4. A step of pure spaces is a space step, pure tabs a tab step, anything else or a prefix that does not extend its parent is counted as mixed and never normalized into a guessed width. Steps seen before a tokenize failure are discarded with it.

CLAIM STRENGTH IS EVIDENCE, NOT AUTHORITY. The physical fallback (non-Python, unknown, or failed Python tokenization) reads leading-space widths and leading tabs exactly as the generic raw-width reference did, keeps the strict tab majority, maps units exactly, and is always heuristic_physical; the observation type refuses to label it structural. The Go compatibility case uses it as a fixed preservation expectation, and no heuristic reading is used to derive a structural expectation.

MATRIX: EIGHT FIXED CASES. A primary.2space, B generalize.2space.deep, C preserve.4space, D preserve.4space.deep and E generalize.2space.skew keep their contracts byte for byte (pinned by path-independent digests recorded before the change) and are declared python; the structural reference reads 2space, 2space, 4space, 4space, 2space. F preserve.4space.continuation, G preserve.4space.multiline_string and H preserve.tab.go are appended. The baseline satisfies F, G and H, so each is a real preservation oracle. Each case receipt reports input_language, observation_tier, claim_strength, fallback_reason and reference_assessment, and no fixture text.

RED-GREEN. The pre-phase reference model, raw physical widths, calls the continuation sample and the 4-space docstring sample 2space; the Python structural reference calls both 4space. Round 10's any-evidence candidate (one width 2 mod 4 decides 2space), admitted by safe_minimal, is fixed_and_preserved on the five historical cases and fixed_but_regressive on eight, regressing F and G. A Python-only reading closes seven cases and regresses H.

T6 IS NOT CLAIMED WINNABLE. The only body known to close all eight cases is a test-only structural control that tokenizes every input as Python - the language guess the contract forbids, which reads a plain-text outline's parenthesis as a bracket - and safe_minimal refuses it as novel_import; the legacy raw-width control is refused as novel_external_reference. Whether the production fix needs caller language transport, a signature change, a wrapper or a per-language adapter is future design.

SCHEMA AND VISIBILITY. behavioral_matrix receipt schema_version bumps to behavioral_matrix_live_4_v2 because every case record gained five fields, following core/evidence_verification.py's precedent; nothing is renamed or removed, and a stored v1 receipt keeps saying what it said. discrimination_phase_ids appends INDENT.SEMANTICS.1; phase_id stays DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.4; no second subtree. INDENT is registered as an ID namespace inside the existing OPS track.

LIFECYCLE SUITES DECLARE THEIR ORACLE. Under eight cases no candidate the frozen safe_minimal gate admits is known to close the matrix, so suites whose subject is the lifecycle after verification - revision recovery, answer coherence of a verified candidate, the public runner's verified path - declare the five-case LIVE.5 oracle through tests/_matrix_history.py; the product always runs every case. Round 10 replayed under eight cases differs from the recorded revision request by exactly three appended preserved-case lines.

CONTROL RETRIEVAL ON THE SELF-REPO. This repository is T6's own corpus, and CONTROL orders entry candidates by repository specificity times the share of an identifier the prompt explains, then exact overlap. The module's first names (IndentationObservation, IndentationAssessment, observe_indentation) were two-token exact 'indentation' identifiers: on the real 20,952-node population they tied core/code_dna.py::_classify_indent for the Round-5 T6 prompt and won on exact overlap, pushing the target to rank 7, outside the six-entry cap, with the oracle offered as the place to fix T6 - caught by RETRIEVE.LIVE.4's real-population test, which passed 43/43 on the reverted tree. The three names gained a word (SourceIndentationObservation, SourceIndentationAssessment, observe_source_indentation) and the target is back inside the cap at rank 4 with no oracle symbol in the top ten; tests/test_indent_semantics1.py pins that every matching name explains a smaller share than the target. The phase still adds seven exact 'indentation' symbols (df 11 -> 18), so the incidental 'point' now leads and RETRIEVE.LIVE.4's ROUND5_TOP_SIX snapshot tuple was updated, the precedent's kind of move. No retrieval or CONTROL code changed.

FROZEN: _classify_indent, compute_dna, probe execution, safe_minimal and novelty, targeted validation and its caps, candidate verification's reducer, revision prompts and budget, answer coherence, answer grounding, CONTROL routing, retrieval and every authority module. core/behavioral_matrix.py and core/phase_registry.py are the only production files changed besides the new module; tests/fixtures/indent_semantics1_reversal.json rebuilds both pre-phase files and sits first in LATER_RECEIPTS. No execution authority is granted, no model call, no network call, no repository traversal; passing all eight cases is verification evidence only.
phases.summary: An oracle and semantic-contract phase, not the T6 fix. The indentation_style subject is the block indentation unit, but every earlier oracle observed every physical line with leading whitespace, which for Python mixes block indentation with continuation alignment, multi-line string interiors, comment-only and whitespace-only rows. Measured: def f(a, / b): / pass reads as physical widths 6 and 4, raw unit 2, while its only block step is 4; core/code_dna.py reads raw unit 2 from docstring rows while all 57 of its tokenize INDENT steps are 4. The observation set was contaminated, not the unit inference. New core/indentation_observation.py is the one observation authority: typed immutable SourceIndentationObservation (language, observation_tier python_structural | heuristic_physical, claim_strength structural | heuristic_physical, structural space and tab steps, mixed-step count, physical widths and tab lines only on the fallback tier, tokenizer_status, closed fallback_reason) and SourceIndentationAssessment (value 2space | 4space | tab | None, closed basis, space unit, observation carried so equal values from different tiers are not equal evidence). observe_source_indentation(text, *, language) dispatches on the language the INPUT declares, never on a file path and never by trying Python first: declared python uses stdlib tokenize, derives each step as the suffix a child INDENT prefix adds to its parent's with a stack popped on DEDENT, so continuation, string-interior, comment and blank rows contribute nothing; a TokenError, IndentationError, TabError or ValueError downgrades to the physical reading with fallback_reason python_tokenize_failed; every other or undeclared language gets the generic raw-width reading with the weaker claim. The reference assessment maps pure space steps by their common unit, exactly 2 -> 2space and 4 -> 4space and anything else None, pure tab steps to tab, mixed evidence and no evidence to None. The behavioral matrix carries input_language on every case and the reference reading beside it; the five DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.5 cases keep ids, bytes, expectations, roles and provenance and are declared python, and three fixed preservation_generalization cases are appended: indentation_style.preserve.4space.continuation and .preserve.4space.multiline_string (system_derived_subject_invariant, python, 4space) and .preserve.tab.go (system_derived_behavior_preservation, go, tab, heuristic_physical) - eight cases. Candidate execution still calls _classify_indent(text) with no language. The Round-10 any-evidence false positive, which safe_minimal admits and the five-case oracle accepted, now fails the continuation and multi-line string cases and is fixed_but_regressive; the Round-10 branch reorder still regresses 4space preservation first; a Python-only reading fails the Go case; the legacy raw-width control fails both Python structural cases; a test-only tokenize-first structural control closes all eight but guesses Python for every input and safe_minimal refuses it as a novel import, so T6 is not shown implementable under the current signature and search space. _classify_indent and compute_dna are unchanged, no execution authority is granted, no model call, no network call, no repository traversal.

notes: OPS.PATCH.1 shipped 2026-08-31 as the first phase of the product-recovery sprint triggered by the 2026-08-30 black-box field test. It is a live production bug fix, not an audit, plan, preview or shadow experiment: it changes the executor that real multi-file patch runs go through.

Defect: patching/patch_plan_executor.py read targets with Path.read_text() and wrote create, replace and rollback with Path.write_text(). read_text() collapses CRLF and lone CR to LF; write_text() opens in text mode with newline=None and translates every LF back to os.linesep. On Windows an LF file therefore became fully CRLF on any touch, and on POSIX a CRLF file would become fully LF. Because rollback used the same write, a failed validation restored the original characters but not the original bytes.

Field-test shape: a correct five-operation feature plan applied, validation then failed for unrelated validation plumbing, rollback ran, and three files were left with roughly 117 changed lines carrying zero semantic difference.

Fix, existing files: the original bytes are captured with read_bytes() and strictly decoded before any mutation. Matching still runs against the universal-newline view read_text() used to produce, so which snippets ground is unchanged; the match span is then mapped back into the raw text and only that region is spliced, so every byte outside it is carried through untouched. The inserted snippet is rendered in the newline convention of the region it replaces, falling back to the file's own - the same heuristic patch_engine.py already used.

Fix, created files: the payload's own newline bytes are written verbatim through write_bytes(). A model payload containing a line feed keeps that line feed on Windows; the host OS no longer converts it. This is the phase's explicit created-file newline policy.

Fix, rollback: the captured original bytes are restored with write_bytes(), which preserves encoding, UTF-8 BOM and exact terminators without a lossy decode/re-encode round trip. A created file is deleted, restoring its original absence rather than an empty stub. Rollback entries are now registered before their write, so a write that fails part way through is still reversed. LIFO ordering is unchanged, which is what makes several operations on one file collapse back to the state before the first of them.

Deliberately unchanged: literal snippet grounding (no whitespace, newline-fuzzy or AST fallback matching was added), operation ordering, LIFO rollback, patch safety, target eligibility, AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED, write authorization, CTX.PATCH/CTX.APPLY, human approval, CONTROL confidence, localization ranking and every validation policy including the pytest command, zero-test handling, output classification and TypeScript detection. A forced validation failure is used only as a test fixture to exercise rollback.

Deltas: zero repository traversal (only files the plan itself names are opened, each read once), zero model calls, zero network calls, zero new authority. CHECK.1 and CHECK.LIVE.1 are untouched; a rolled-back run now simply presents a final observed state equal to the original one, which is a factual improvement the shadow reconciliation sees on its own without any special-casing.

Scope limits: file content bytes and file existence are what this phase preserves. Timestamps, ACLs, extended attributes and inode identity are out of scope and were never promised by the executor. Directories created for a create_file op are not removed on rollback, which is pre-existing behaviour. Targets that are not valid UTF-8 are still rejected before any write, as they were before.

Registry schema limitation: automation_level has no value expressing 'human-authored production bug fix'. Its five values describe how much power an automation is granted (LOCAL_0_OBSERVE through AUTO_4_AUTO_MERGE), and all 140 prior phases sit at LOCAL_0_OBSERVE or LOCAL_1_PREPARE with writes_real_repo=false. LOCAL_1_PREPARE is recorded as the closest honest value, and writes_real_repo=true carries the fact that actually matters here, rather than mislabelling a live fix as observation-only. Product recovery is prioritising live_wired and dogfood_demonstrated work over additional report-only planning layers; no new registry capability model was built for this phase.

Benchmark blind spot: the existing 54 benchmark cases did not catch this because byte-level newline fidelity was never an asserted dimension - cases compare semantic outcomes, and universal-newline reads hide a line-ending-only diff entirely. Those cases were not altered here. A future product black-box suite should assert bytes.

Prerequisite CHECK.LIVE.1 rather than WORKER.DECL.2B: CHECK.LIVE.1 documents and exercises the live patch-plan lifecycle around apply, validation, rollback and final observation that this fix sits inside. WORKER.DECL.2B remains active and untouched.
phases.summary: Live production fix to the real multi-file patch write path. Black-box field testing on 2026-08-30 found that patching/patch_plan_executor.py created, replaced and rolled back through Path.write_text(), whose default text mode translates every LF to os.linesep, so on Windows an LF repository silently became CRLF the moment a patch touched it, and a failed validation rolled back through the same translation, leaving a line-ending-only diff where it claimed to have restored the original. Create, replace and rollback are now byte-oriented: the original bytes of an existing target are captured before mutation and restored verbatim on rollback, encoding, BOM and terminators included; a replace is spliced into the raw text so only the requested region's bytes differ and the file keeps its own newline convention, mixed files included; a created file is written with the model payload's own newline bytes and is absent again after rollback. Snippet matching still runs against the identical universal-newline view read_text() produced, so literal grounding, operation ordering, LIFO rollback, patch safety, write authorization, human approval and validation policy are all unchanged. The phase adds no repository traversal, no model call, no network call and no new authority, and it is not report-only: it modifies the executor that production runs use.

notes: Four questions stay separate. patch_basis answers why a change may be considered; target/source grounding answers where a concrete proposal may operate; candidate sandbox validation answers whether the final candidate is materializable and valid; existing patch safety, CTX.PATCH/CTX.APPLY, AUTO_PATCH_ENABLED, runtime authorization and human approval answer whether it may write. candidate_validation = passed != write_authority.

The final-candidate boundary is core.pipeline._record_patch_safety_handoff, the last point at which an explicit-change candidate is stable: the payload there is exactly what the human is handed, and nothing downstream rewrites it. Sandbox validation runs on that candidate, after patch safety, never on a draft a later refinement replaced.

Existing machinery is reused, not replaced: core.sandbox_self_evolution_runner.create_managed_sandbox / cleanup_managed_sandbox builds and deletes the disposable copy, patching.patch_plan_executor.apply_patch_plan applies the plan with real production semantics and OPS.PATCH.1 byte fidelity, and the OPS.VALIDATE.1 command the surrounding run already selected is passed in rather than guessed. No sandbox_v2, feature_clone_engine or candidate_virtual_repo was created.

No git stash, git reset or git clean anywhere in the path. The sandbox is a copy of the working tree as it stands — the state the candidate was produced against, not an unrelated HEAD checkout — so unrelated user work in a dirty worktree is preserved exactly.

Three-way typed outcome only: passed, failed, inconclusive. No candidate_quality_score, regression_score or confidence. Sandbox unavailable, no validation command, zero tests collected and an unavailable tool are inconclusive and fail closed; a candidate that cannot be applied, and validation that actually fails, are failed.

candidate_validation_fingerprint is a sha256 over the canonical JSON of the plan's materially-significant operations, reusing the existing fingerprint idiom rather than inventing a cryptographic subsystem. A refinement changes the fingerprint, the stored verdict stops matching, and the stale keys are dropped rather than travelling forward: no silent reuse, and revalidation is required.

A failed candidate stays reviewable with its diagnostics preserved and approval_ready=false; it is never described as clean, validated, working or ready to apply. A failing refinement does not automatically resurrect an earlier passing draft — validation-based plan selection is deliberately not introduced here.

Ordering is enforced: patch basis, then target/source grounding, then patch safety, then sandbox materialization, then validation. A test-path rewrite and an arbitrary/unrequested target are refused before any sandbox exists, so sandbox validation cannot be used to legitimise a path the earlier gates reject even if the corrupted test would pass.

Scope is explicit_change task shape with explicit_change_request basis. The grounded-defect auto-apply path is untouched, and a grounded_defect reaching the same handoff keeps its existing behaviour. analysis_only and needs_clarification create no sandbox, apply no patch and run no validation.

Real-repository mutation delta is zero: byte-identical before and after, whether the candidate passes or fails. Validation side effects (__pycache__, test caches, build output) live and die inside the disposable sandbox and are never copied back. Cleanup failure may leave a temp directory but never mutates the source repository.

Known limitations recorded rather than fixed here. Validation timeout classification keeps its existing OPS.VALIDATE.1 semantics and is left for OPS.VALIDATE.2. Passing repository validation is a coherence/regression fact, not proof the user's feature request was satisfied — old tests know nothing about a new CLI flag or list column — and CHECK.2 remains unwired. Sandbox apply and validation share one measured timing span because they occur inside one call to the production primitive.
Historical explicit-change artifacts without candidate-validation metadata remain loadable and read back as legacy_unvalidated, never as passed. They are not rewritten.

Cost is reported, not hidden: sandbox_create_sec, candidate_apply_and_validation_sec, cleanup_sec and total_sec travel with the result. For the T4-class small repository this is low-second work; no such promise is made for large repositories. No second repository analysis, index build or graph traversal was added — only the sandbox copy the existing mechanism performs.
Zero added model calls and zero added network calls. No verification LLM, no generated tests, no pip/npm/pnpm/yarn install and no npx network fetch. Not report-only.

Immediate next safety/observability phase: EXEC.AUTH.LIVE.1 — Execution Authority & Outcome Telemetry Reconciliation, for the separate rerun finding that T1/T2/T3 payloads reported write_authority=false, patch_application_authority=false and human_approval_required=true while files had actually been written. Deliberately out of scope here.
phases.summary: Live production candidate-verification phase triggered by the post-PATCH.BASIS six-task black-box rerun, in which an explicit-change task routed correctly, carried a legitimate explicit_change_request patch basis, and passed target/source grounding and patch safety while its final two-operation plan was internally incoherent: store.py passed priority= into a Task whose models.py was never changed, and applying that exact plan to a disposable copy failed every existing test with TypeError: Task.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'priority'. No production gate had executed the candidate anywhere before describing it as approval-ready. The FINAL explicit-change candidate — the exact payload handed to the human, after any reviewer/refinement step, after patch basis, target/source grounding and patch safety — is now materialized in a disposable managed sandbox built by the existing sandbox primitive, applied there with the real patching.patch_plan_executor semantics, and validated with the repository's own OPS.VALIDATE.1 command. The result is passed, failed or inconclusive, never a score, and is bound to a sha256 fingerprint of the candidate, so a later refinement invalidates the earlier result instead of inheriting it. A failed or inconclusive candidate stays reviewable for diagnostics but is never approval_ready, and a failing refinement never resurrects an earlier passing draft. No git stash, reset or clean is used, so unrelated work in a dirty worktree is preserved exactly; the real repository stays byte-identical whether the candidate passes or fails, and sandbox side effects are never copied back. Passing candidate validation is not write authority: explicit_change_request still requires human approval and is still never auto-applied, and passing the repository's existing tests does not prove the user's feature request was satisfied. Grounded-defect auto-apply, analysis and clarification routes are untouched. Zero added model calls, zero network calls, no generated tests, no dependency installation, no retrieval/indexing change, no timeout-semantics change, and not report-only.
